findings.title: Unescaped shell execution vulnerable to Command Injection (CWE-78)
findings.body: Executing shell commands with unsanitized PHP variables allows arbitrary **Command Injection (CWE-78)**. Sanitize arguments using `escapeshellarg()` or use a dedicated process library like Symfony `Process`.

findings.title: Direct output of superglobal input causes Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
findings.body: Echoing user-supplied superglobals (`$_GET`, `$_POST`) directly into the HTML response causes **Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79)**. Wrap output in `htmlspecialchars($val, ENT_QUOTES, "UTF-8")`.

findings.title: Unsafe C string function vulnerable to buffer overflow
findings.body: Using unbounded buffer functions (`strcpy`, `strcat`, `sprintf`, `gets`) is a classic source of **Buffer Overflow (CWE-120)** and arbitrary code execution. In modern C++, use `std::string`, `std::format` (C++20), or `snprintf` with explicit destination bounds.

findings.title: C++ Raw `new` allocation without RAII smart pointer
findings.body: Manual memory management using raw `new` risks memory leaks and double-free bugs on exceptions. In modern C++ (C++11/14/20), prefer `std::make_unique<T>()` or `std::make_shared<T>()` to enforce RAII ownership.

findings.title: Catching exception by value causes object slicing
findings.body: Catching exceptions by value slices derived exception objects, discarding polymorphic error information and copy-constructing an exception. Catch by `const &` instead (`catch (const std::exception& e)`).

findings.title: Python mutable default argument retains state across function calls
findings.body: Default argument values in Python are evaluated once when the function is defined. Using mutable defaults (`[]`, `{}`) causes state to be shared across all invocations (**Common Python Bug**). Use `None` as the default and assign a new instance inside the function body.

findings.title: Python SQL Injection via f-string or string formatting
findings.body: Interpolating variables into SQL queries via Python f-strings or `%` format strings causes **SQL Injection (CWE-89)**. Use database cursor parameterized queries with placeholders (`%s` or `?`) and a parameter tuple/list.
findings.suggestionCode: query = "SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = %s", (tenant_id,)

findings.title: Python `shell=True` or `os.system()` allows command injection
findings.body: Invoking shell commands with `shell=True` or `os.system()` invites **Command Injection (CWE-78)** if arguments contain untrusted user input. Pass arguments as a list of strings (`["cmd", arg1, arg2]`) with `shell=False`.

findings.title: Bare `except:` catches SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt
findings.body: A bare `except:` catches `KeyboardInterrupt` (Ctrl+C) and `SystemExit`, preventing normal application termination and masking unexpected syntax or type errors. Catch `Exception` explicitly.

+import sqlite3

+from typing import List, Dict, Any
+
+def get_customers(tenant_id: str, filters: dict = {}) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    conn = sqlite3.connect("app.db")
+    cursor = conn.cursor()
+    # Raw f-string SQL query

+    cursor.execute(query)
+    rows = cursor.fetchall()
+    return [{"id": r[0], "name": r[1], "email": r[2]} for r in rows]
+
+def export_backup_report(output_path: str, table_name: str) -> None:
+    try:
+        cmd = f"sqlite3 app.db .dump {table_name} > {output_path}"
+        subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, check=True)
+    except:
+        pass

+name: OpenRabbit AI PR Review
+

+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

+  issues: write

+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.comment.body, '@openrabbit') }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout Repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Setup Node.js 22
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:

+          cache: 'npm'

+

+            --title "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" \
+            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
+            --pr "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" \
+            --post-github "${{ github.repository }}#${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
+        env:

+          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
+          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}

+# 🐇 OpenRabbit
+
+**Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer, Walkthrough Generator & Interactive PR Companion**  
+*An open-source, self-hostable, multi-provider BYOK alternative to CodeRabbit.*
+
+---
+
+## ✨ Why OpenRabbit?
+
+Code reviews shouldn't require surrendering your proprietary source code to a closed SaaS or paying per-seat enterprise fees. **OpenRabbit** brings the signature capabilities developers love about CodeRabbit into a fast, transparent, open-source platform:
+
+1. **🧭 Two-Stage PR Walkthroughs**:
+   - Executive Summary & Release Notes grouped by module
+   - File-by-File Walkthrough Table with component detection & impact badges (`🟢 Low`, `🟡 Med`, `🔴 High`)
+   - Auto-generated **Mermaid Sequence Diagrams** (`sequenceDiagram`) visualizing how PR changes interact at runtime
+   - **Review Effort Score** (`1/5` to `5/5`) & Risk Assessment
+   - Configurable **Rabbit Poem** summarizing every PR 🐇🥕
+   - Updates a single sticky comment (`<!-- openrabbit-walkthrough -->`) on new commits instead of spamming your PR!
+2. **📝 Line-by-Line Inline Code Reviews with One-Click Committable Suggestions**:
+   - Pinpoints exact diff lines and emits GitHub (` ```suggestion `) and GitLab (` ```suggestion:-0+0 `) committable code blocks.
+   - Combines a built-in deterministic **Static + AST Security/Concurrency Analyzer** with **Multi-Provider LLMs**.
+3. **💬 Interactive `@openrabbit` PR Chat & Commands**:
+   - Reply in any PR or inline review thread with:
+     - `@openrabbit explain` — Deep-dive explanation of the hunk & execution flow
+     - `@openrabbit test` — Generates ready-to-run unit test suites (`Vitest`/`Jest`) for the modified functions
+     - `@openrabbit fix` — Produces a committable replacement patch
+     - `@openrabbit docstring` — Generates JSDoc/TSDoc for changed symbols
+     - `@openrabbit resolve` — Marks the review discussion resolved
+4. **🔑 Multi-Provider BYOK + 100% Private Local Mode**:
+   - **OpenAI** (`gpt-4o`, `o3-mini`, or any compatible endpoint like Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter)
+   - **Anthropic Claude** (`claude-3-7-sonnet-latest`)
+   - **Google Gemini** (`gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`)
+   - **Ollama** (`qwen2.5-coder`, `deepseek-r1`, `llama3.3` for 100% air-gapped private reviews)
+   - **Built-in Static/AST Heuristic Engine** (works immediately with zero API keys!)
+5. **⚙️ Drop-in `.openrabbit.yaml` & `.coderabbit.yaml` Compatibility**:
+   - Supports `profile: chill | assertive | security-focused`, glob `path_filters`, and per-directory `path_instructions`.
+
+---
+
+## 🏗️ Architecture
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+  subgraph Triggers["Triggers & Sources"]
+    GH["GitHub Webhook / Action"]
+    GL["GitLab MR Webhook"]
+    CLI["OpenRabbit CLI (git diff)"]
+    UI["Interactive Web Studio"]
+  end
+
+  subgraph Core["OpenRabbit Core Engine"]
+    DP["Unified Diff & Symbol Parser"]
+    CFG[".openrabbit.yaml Matcher"]
+    AST["Static & Security AST Rules"]
+    LLM["Multi-Provider LLM Router"]
+    CHAT["@openrabbit Chat Engine"]
+  end
+
+  subgraph Outputs["Outputs"]
+    WK["Sticky PR Walkthrough + Mermaid Diagram"]
+    INL["Inline Review + Committable Suggestions"]
+    DASH["Analytics & Rule Studio Dashboard"]
+  end
+
+  Triggers --> DP
+  DP --> CFG
+  CFG --> AST
+  CFG --> LLM
+  AST --> WK
+  LLM --> WK
+  AST --> INL
+  LLM --> INL
+  CHAT --> INL
+  WK --> Outputs
+  INL --> Outputs
+```
+
+---
+
+## 🚀 Quickstart
+
+### 1. Run a Terminal PR Review (`openrabbit review`)
+
+```bash
+# Install dependencies
+npm install
+
+# Run a live terminal review on a sample PR (or your local uncommitted git diff)
+npm run review -- --demo auth-jwt-sqli
+
+# Review your staged git changes
+npx tsx src/cli/index.ts review --staged
+
+# Ask @openrabbit to generate unit tests from the CLI
+npx tsx src/cli/index.ts chat "@openrabbit generate unit tests"
+```
+
+### 2. Launch the Interactive Web Dashboard & Webhook Server (`openrabbit serve`)
+
+```bash
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Then open **`http://localhost:3847`** to explore:
+- **🔎 PR Review Studio**: Paste any `git diff`, switch between curated PR scenarios, inspect the rendered **Mermaid Sequence Diagram**, click **✨ Apply Fix to Diff & Re-Verify** on committable suggestions, and chat with `@openrabbit` inline!
+- **📊 Reviews & Analytics**: Track PRs reviewed, critical vulnerabilities caught, and engineering hours saved.
+- **⚙️ `.openrabbit.yaml` Studio**: Visually configure `chill` vs `assertive` profiles, `path_instructions`, and BYOK LLM providers.
+- **🔌 Webhook Simulator**: Test GitHub (`pull_request`, `issue_comment`) and GitLab (`Merge Request Hook`) webhooks with one click.
+
+---
+
+## ⚙️ Configuration (`.openrabbit.yaml`)
+
+```yaml
+language: en-US
+profile: chill # chill | assertive | security-focused
+tone_instructions: Be constructive, concise, and high-signal.
+reviews:
+  high_level_summary: true
+  poem: true
+  sequence_diagrams: true
+  collapse_walkthrough: false
+  path_filters:
+    - "!dist/**"
+    - "!*.lock"
+  path_instructions:
+    - path: "src/api/**"
+      instructions: "Verify authentication checks, input validation, and parameterized SQL queries."
+    - path: "**/*.tsx"
+      instructions: "Check for React hook dependency bugs and memory leaks."
+chat:
+  auto_reply: true
+llm:
+  provider: auto # auto | openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama | heuristic
+  temperature: 0.2
+```
+
+---
+
+## 🧪 Running Tests & Building
+
+```bash
+# Run the automated unit & webhook integration test suite
+npm test
+
+# Compile TypeScript to dist/
+npm run build
+```

+/* global mermaid */
+(function () {
+  let templates = [];
+  let currentReview = null;
+  let currentParsedDiff = null;
+
+  if (typeof mermaid !== 'undefined') {
+    mermaid.initialize({
+      startOnLoad: false,
+      theme: 'dark',
+      securityLevel: 'loose',
+    });
+  }
+
+  function escapeHtml(str) {
+    return String(str ?? '')
+      .replace(/&/g, '&')
+      .replace(/</g, '<')
+      .replace(/>/g, '>')
+      .replace(/"/g, '"');
+  }
+
+  function formatInlineMarkdown(text) {
+    return escapeHtml(text)
+      .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
+      .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
+  }
+
+  // Tab Navigation
+  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach((btn) => {
+    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      const target = btn.getAttribute('data-tab');
+      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('active'));
+      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('active'));
+      btn.classList.add('active');
+      const panel = document.getElementById(`tab-${target}`);
+      if (panel) panel.classList.add('active');
+      if (target === 'history') {
+        loadHistoryAndAnalytics();
+      }
+    });
+  });
+
+  async function initApp() {
+    try {
+      const [statusRes, tplRes, revRes] = await Promise.all([
+        fetch('/api/status').then((r) => r.json()),
+        fetch('/api/templates').then((r) => r.json()),
+        fetch('/api/reviews').then((r) => r.json()),
+      ]);
+
+      // Engine badge
+      const engineEl = document.getElementById('activeEngineText');
+      if (statusRes.activeProvider) {
+        engineEl.textContent = `Engine: ${statusRes.activeProvider.provider}/${statusRes.activeProvider.model}`;
+      }
+
+      // Populate Rules & Providers tab
+      renderProvidersStatus(statusRes.providers || []);
+      populateConfigForm(statusRes.config, statusRes.yamlConfig);
+
+      // Populate Sample Templates
+      templates = tplRes.templates || [];
+      renderTemplatePills();
+
+      // Load first template into editor & show initial seeded review
+      if (templates.length > 0) {
+        selectTemplate(templates[0], false);
+      }
+
+      if (revRes.reviews && revRes.reviews.length > 0) {
+        await loadReviewById(revRes.reviews[0].id);
+      } else if (templates.length > 0) {
+        await executeReview();
+      }
+
+      renderAnalyticsAndHistory(revRes.reviews || [], revRes.analytics || {});
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('Failed to initialize OpenRabbit UI:', err);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function renderTemplatePills() {
+    const container = document.getElementById('templatePills');
+    container.innerHTML = '';
+    templates.forEach((tpl, index) => {
+      const btn = document.createElement('button');
+      btn.className = `template-pill ${index === 0 ? 'active' : ''}`;
+      btn.setAttribute('data-tpl-id', tpl.id);
+      btn.innerHTML = `
+        <div class="template-pill-title">
+          <span>${escapeHtml(tpl.name)}</span>
+          <span class="mono-hint">#${tpl.prNumber}</span>
+        </div>
+        <div class="template-pill-desc">${escapeHtml(tpl.description)}</div>
+      `;
+      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.template-pill').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('active'));
+        btn.classList.add('active');
+        selectTemplate(tpl, true);
+      });
+      container.appendChild(btn);
+    });
+  }
+
+  function selectTemplate(tpl, autoRun) {
+    document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value = tpl.prTitle;
+    document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value = tpl.repository;
+    const diffArea = document.getElementById('textareaDiff');
+    diffArea.value = tpl.diff;
+    updateDiffLineCounter();
+    if (autoRun) {
+      executeReview();
+    }
+  }
+
+  function updateDiffLineCounter() {
+    const val = document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value || '';
+    const count = val.trim() ? val.split('\n').length : 0;
+    document.getElementById('diffLineStats').textContent = `${count} lines`;
+  }
+
+  document
+    .getElementById('textareaDiff')
+    .addEventListener('input', updateDiffLineCounter);
+
+  async function executeReview() {
+    const btn = document.getElementById('btnRunReview');
+    const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+    btn.disabled = true;
+    btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> Analyzing Diff & Generating Walkthrough...';
+
+    try {
+      const diff = document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value;
+      const prTitle = document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value;
+      const repository = document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value;
+      const profile = document.getElementById('selectProfile').value;
+      const provider = document.getElementById('selectProvider').value;
+
+      const res = await fetch('/api/review', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          diff,
+          prTitle,
+          repository,
+          profile,
+          provider,
+          source: 'playground',
+        }),
+      });
+      const data = await res.json();
+      if (data.error) {
+        alert(data.error);
+        return;
+      }
+      currentReview = data.review;
+      currentParsedDiff = data.parsedDiff;
+      renderReviewStudio(currentReview, currentParsedDiff);
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('Review error:', err);
+    } finally {
+      btn.disabled = false;
+      btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+    }
+  }
+
+  document.getElementById('btnRunReview').addEventListener('click', executeReview);
+
+  document.getElementById('btnReviewLocalGit').addEventListener('click', async () => {
+    const btn = document.getElementById('btnReviewLocalGit');
+    btn.textContent = '⏳ Reading git diff...';
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch('/api/review/local', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({}),
+      });
+      const data = await res.json();
+      if (data.empty) {
+        alert(data.message);
+        return;
+      }
+      if (data.review) {
+        document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value = data.review.prTitle;
+        document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value = data.review.repository;
+        document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value = data.review.rawDiff || '';
+        updateDiffLineCounter();
+        currentReview = data.review;
+        currentParsedDiff = data.parsedDiff;
+        renderReviewStudio(currentReview, currentParsedDiff);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      btn.textContent = '📂 Review Local Git Diff';
+    }
+  });
+
+  async function loadReviewById(id) {
+    const res = await fetch(`/api/reviews/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
+    if (!res.ok) return;
+    const data = await res.json();
+    currentReview = data.review;
+    currentParsedDiff = data.parsedDiff;
+    if (currentReview.rawDiff) {
+      document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value = currentReview.rawDiff;
+      document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value = currentReview.prTitle;
+      document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value = currentReview.repository;
+      updateDiffLineCounter();
+    }
+    renderReviewStudio(currentReview, currentParsedDiff);
+  }
+
+  async function renderReviewStudio(review, parsedDiff) {
+    const w = review.walkthrough;
+    document.getElementById('viewPrTitle').textContent = review.prTitle;
+    document.getElementById('viewRepoTag').textContent = `${review.repository}${
+      review.prNumber ? ` #${review.prNumber}` : ''
+    }`;
+    document.getElementById('viewEngineTag').textContent = `${review.providerUsed}/${review.modelUsed} (${review.durationMs}ms)`;
+
+    document.getElementById('kpiEffort').textContent = `Effort: ${w.effortScore}/5 (~${w.estimatedMinutes}m)`;
+    const kpiRisk = document.getElementById('kpiRisk');
+    kpiRisk.textContent = `Risk: ${w.riskLevel.toUpperCase()}`;
+    kpiRisk.style.color =
+      w.riskLevel === 'critical'
+        ? '#fb7185'
+        : w.riskLevel === 'high'
+        ? '#fbbf24'
+        : '#4ade80';
+
+    document.getElementById('kpiFindings').textContent = `${review.findings.length} Finding${
+      review.findings.length === 1 ? '' : 's'
+    }`;
+
+    document.getElementById('viewExecutiveSummary').innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(
+      w.executiveSummary
+    );
+
+    document.getElementById('rawMarkdownPre').textContent =
+      review.markdownWalkthrough || '';
+
+    // File Walkthrough Table
+    const tbody = document.getElementById('viewFileWalkthroughTable');
+    document.getElementById('viewFileCountHint').textContent = `${w.fileSummaries.length} file(s) changed (+${review.stats.additions}/-${review.stats.deletions})`;
+    tbody.innerHTML = w.fileSummaries
+      .map((f) => {
+        const impactBadge =
+          f.impact === 'high'
+            ? '<span class="sev-badge critical">HIGH</span>'
+            : f.impact === 'medium'
+            ? '<span class="sev-badge warning">MED</span>'
+            : '<span class="sev-badge praise">LOW</span>';
+        return `
+          <tr>
+            <td><code>${escapeHtml(f.path)}</code></td>
+            <td>${escapeHtml(f.component)}</td>
+            <td><span style="color:#4ade80">+${f.additions}</span> / <span style="color:#fb7185">-${f.deletions}</span></td>
+            <td>${impactBadge}</td>
+            <td>${formatInlineMarkdown(f.summary)}</td>
+          </tr>
+        `;
+      })
+      .join('');
+
+    // Poem & Security Advisories
+    document.getElementById('viewPoem').textContent =
+      w.poem || 'Hop onward to merge with a confident mind! 🐇🥕';
+
+    const secBox = document.getElementById('viewSecurityBox');
+    const secList = document.getElementById('viewSecurityList');
+    if (w.securityConcerns && w.securityConcerns.length > 0) {
+      secBox.classList.remove('hidden');
+      secList.innerHTML = w.securityConcerns
+        .map((s) => `<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`)
+        .join('');
+    } else {
+      secBox.classList.add('hidden');
+    }
+
+    // Render Mermaid Diagram
+    const mermaidEl = document.getElementById('mermaidContainer');
+    if (w.mermaidDiagram && typeof mermaid !== 'undefined') {
+      try {
+        const renderId = `mermaid-svg-${Date.now()}`;
+        const { svg } = await mermaid.render(renderId, w.mermaidDiagram);
+        mermaidEl.innerHTML = svg;
+      } catch {
+        mermaidEl.innerHTML = `<pre class="code-preview">${escapeHtml(
+          w.mermaidDiagram
+        )}</pre>`;
+      }
+    } else {
+      mermaidEl.innerHTML = `<pre class="code-preview">${escapeHtml(
+        w.mermaidDiagram || ''
+      )}</pre>`;
+    }
+
+    // Severity breakdown legend
+    document.getElementById('viewSeverityBreakdown').innerHTML = `
+      <span class="sev-badge critical">${review.stats.criticalCount} Critical</span>
+      <span class="sev-badge warning">${review.stats.warningCount} Warning</span>
+      <span class="sev-badge suggestion">${review.stats.suggestionCount} Suggestion</span>
+      <span class="sev-badge nitpick">${review.stats.nitpickCount} Nitpick</span>
+    `;
+
+    // Render Annotated Diff with Inline Findings
+    renderAnnotatedDiffWithFindings(parsedDiff, review.findings);
+  }
+
+  function renderAnnotatedDiffWithFindings(parsedDiff, findings) {
+    const container = document.getElementById('annotatedDiffContainer');
+    container.innerHTML = '';
+
+    if (!parsedDiff || !parsedDiff.files || parsedDiff.files.length === 0) {
+      container.innerHTML = `<div class="code-preview">No diff hunks available to display.</div>`;
+      return;
+    }
+
+    parsedDiff.files.forEach((file) => {
+      const fileBlock = document.createElement('div');
+      fileBlock.className = 'diff-file-block';
+
+      const fileFindings = (findings || []).filter((f) => f.file === file.newPath);
+
+      fileBlock.innerHTML = `
+        <div class="diff-file-header">
+          <div>
+            <strong>📄 ${escapeHtml(file.newPath)}</strong>
+            <span class="mono-hint" style="margin-left:8px">${escapeHtml(file.language)}</span>
+            ${
+              file.symbolsChanged && file.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+                ? `<span class="mono-tag" style="margin-left:8px">Symbols: ${escapeHtml(
+                    file.symbolsChanged.join(', ')
+                  )}</span>`
+                : ''
+            }
+          </div>
+          <div>
+            <span style="color:#4ade80">+${file.additions}</span>
+            <span style="color:#fb7185; margin-left:6px">-${file.deletions}</span>
+            <span class="mono-tag" style="margin-left:8px">${fileFindings.length} comment(s)</span>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      `;
+
+      const linesWrap = document.createElement('div');
+
+      file.hunks.forEach((hunk) => {
+        const hunkHeader = document.createElement('div');
+        hunkHeader.className = 'diff-hunk-header';
+        hunkHeader.textContent = hunk.header;
+        linesWrap.appendChild(hunkHeader);
+
+        hunk.lines.forEach((line) => {
+          const row = document.createElement('div');
+          row.className = `diff-line-row ${line.type}`;
+          const oldLn = line.oldLineNumber !== undefined ? line.oldLineNumber : '';
+          const newLn = line.newLineNumber !== undefined ? line.newLineNumber : '';
+          const sign = line.type === 'add' ? '+' : line.type === 'del' ? '-' : ' ';
+
+          row.innerHTML = `
+            <span class="diff-ln">${oldLn}</span>
+            <span class="diff-ln">${newLn}</span>
+            <span class="diff-sign">${sign}</span>
+            <span class="diff-code">${escapeHtml(line.content)}</span>
+          `;
+          linesWrap.appendChild(row);
+
+          // Check if any InlineFinding attaches to this newLineNumber
+          if (line.type !== 'del' && line.newLineNumber !== undefined) {
+            const matching = fileFindings.filter(
+              (f) => f.startLine === line.newLineNumber
+            );
+            matching.forEach((finding) => {
+              linesWrap.appendChild(createInlineFindingCard(finding));
+            });
+          }
+        });
+      });
+
+      fileBlock.appendChild(linesWrap);
+      container.appendChild(fileBlock);
+    });
+  }
+

+
+function parseFlags(args: string[]): Record<string, string | boolean> {
+  const flags: Record<string, string | boolean> = {};
+  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
+    const arg = args[i];
+    if (arg.startsWith('--')) {
+      const key = arg.slice(2);
+      const next = args[i + 1];
+      if (next && !next.startsWith('--')) {
+        flags[key] = next;
+        i++;
+      } else {
+        flags[key] = true;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return flags;
+}
+
+export function renderTerminalReview(result: ReviewResult): string {
+  const lines: string[] = [];
+  const w = result.walkthrough;
+
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.orange}━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}🐇 OPENRABBIT PR WALKTHROUGH:${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.bold}${result.prTitle}${ANSI.reset}`

+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.dim}Repo: ${result.repository} · Engine: ${result.providerUsed}/${result.modelUsed} · Time: ${result.durationMs}ms${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.orange}━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(`${ANSI.bold}📋 Executive Summary${ANSI.reset}`);
+  lines.push(`   ${w.executiveSummary.replace(/\*\*/g, '')}`);
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(
+    `   ${ANSI.bold}Effort:${ANSI.reset} ${renderEffortBar(w.effortScore)} (~${
+      w.estimatedMinutes

+      w.riskLevel === 'critical'
+        ? `${ANSI.red}${ANSI.bold}CRITICAL${ANSI.reset}`
+        : w.riskLevel === 'high'
+        ? `${ANSI.yellow}${ANSI.bold}HIGH${ANSI.reset}`
+        : w.riskLevel === 'moderate'
+        ? `${ANSI.yellow}MODERATE${ANSI.reset}`
+        : `${ANSI.green}LOW${ANSI.reset}`
+    }   ${ANSI.bold}Changes:${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.green}+${
+      result.stats.additions
+    }${ANSI.reset}/${ANSI.red}-${result.stats.deletions}${ANSI.reset} (${
+      result.stats.filesReviewed
+    } files)`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+
+  if (w.fileSummaries.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(`${ANSI.bold}🧭 File Changes Walkthrough${ANSI.reset}`);
+    for (const f of w.fileSummaries) {
+      const badge =
+        f.impact === 'high'
+          ? `${ANSI.red}[HIGH]${ANSI.reset}`
+          : f.impact === 'medium'
+          ? `${ANSI.yellow}[MED] ${ANSI.reset}`

+      );
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}🔎 Inline Code Review Findings (${result.findings.length})${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+
+  for (const finding of result.findings) {

+        ? `${ANSI.red}${ANSI.bold}🛑 CRITICAL${ANSI.reset}`
+        : finding.severity === 'warning'

+        : finding.severity === 'suggestion'

+        : finding.severity === 'praise'

+    lines.push(
+      `  ┌─ ${sevBadge} ${ANSI.magenta}[${finding.category}]${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.bold}${finding.title}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    lines.push(
+      `  │  ${ANSI.cyan}${finding.file}:${finding.startLine}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    lines.push(`  │  ${finding.body.replace(/\*\*/g, '')}`);
+
+    if (finding.originalCode) {

+    }
+    if (finding.suggestionCode) {

+      }
+    }

+  }
+
+  if (w.poem) {
+    lines.push('');

+      lines.push(`   ${ANSI.italic}${ANSI.orange}❝ ${pLine}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  lines.push('');
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}

+      rawDiff,

+      repository,
+      prNumber: flags.pr ? Number(flags.pr) : undefined,
+      source: 'cli',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    const store = new ReviewStore();
+    await store.addReview(result);
+
+    // Optional: post directly to a live GitHub PR if --post-github owner/repo#123 is passed
+    if (typeof flags['post-github'] === 'string' && process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN) {
+      const match = flags['post-github'].match(/^([^/]+)\/([^#]+)#(\d+)$/);
+      if (match) {
+        const [, owner, repo, prNumStr] = match;
+        const prNum = Number(prNumStr);
+        await upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+          owner,
+          repo,
+          prNum,
+          result.markdownWalkthrough,
+          process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+        );
+        if (result.findings.length > 0 && result.commitSha) {
+          await postGitHubInlineReview(
+            owner,
+            repo,
+            prNum,
+            result.commitSha,
+            result.findings,
+            process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+          );
+        }
+        console.log(
+          `${ANSI.green}✔ Posted walkthrough & inline comments to GitHub PR ${flags['post-github']}${ANSI.reset}`
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (format === 'json') {
+      console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
+    } else if (format === 'markdown') {
+      console.log(result.markdownWalkthrough);
+    } else {
+      console.log(renderTerminalReview(result));
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'chat') {
+    printBanner();
+    const query =
+      argv
+        .slice(1)
+        .filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--'))
+        .join(' ') || '@openrabbit explain';
+    const { config } = loadConfig(process.cwd());
+    const localGit = getLocalGitDiff();
+    const diff = localGit.diff.trim() || SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff;
+
+    const res = await handlePRChat({ query, diff }, config);
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.cyan}🤖 @openrabbit (${res.commandDetected} · ${res.providerUsed}/${res.modelUsed}):${ANSI.reset}\n`
+    );
+    console.log(res.replyMarkdown);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'providers') {
+    printBanner();
+    console.log(`${ANSI.bold}Configured LLM Providers (BYOK):${ANSI.reset}\n`);
+    for (const p of getProvidersStatus()) {
+      const status = p.configured
+        ? `${ANSI.green}● Ready${ANSI.reset}`
+        : `${ANSI.gray}○ Missing API Key${ANSI.reset}`;
+      console.log(
+        `  ${status}  ${ANSI.bold}${p.name}${ANSI.reset} (${ANSI.cyan}${p.id}${ANSI.reset}, default: \`${p.defaultModel}\`)`
+      );
+      console.log(`           ${ANSI.dim}${p.description}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+    console.log('');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  // Help output
+  printBanner();
+  console.log(`${ANSI.bold}Usage:${ANSI.reset}
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit review${ANSI.reset} [options]       Run AI PR walkthrough & line-by-line review
+    ${ANSI.dim}--staged${ANSI.reset}                        Review staged git changes
+    ${ANSI.dim}--base <branch>${ANSI.reset}                 Review branch diff against base (e.g. main)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--file <patch>${ANSI.reset}                  Review a specific .diff / .patch file
+    ${ANSI.dim}--demo [id]${ANSI.reset}                     Run against a sample PR diff (auth-jwt-sqli | react-billing-hook | clean-stream-worker)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--profile <mode>${ANSI.reset}                Override profile (chill | assertive | security-focused)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--provider <llm>${ANSI.reset}                Override LLM (auto | openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama | heuristic)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--format <fmt>${ANSI.reset}                  Output format (terminal | markdown | json)
+
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit chat "<query>"${ANSI.reset}          Ask @openrabbit to explain, write unit tests, or fix code
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit serve${ANSI.reset} [--port 3847]    Start Webhook Bot Server & Interactive Web Dashboard
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit init${ANSI.reset}                   Generate a .openrabbit.yaml config file in current repo
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit providers${ANSI.reset}              List supported BYOK LLM providers and readiness status
+`);
+}
+
+// Run CLI when invoked directly
+const isDirectExecution =
+  process.argv[1] &&
+  (process.argv[1].endsWith('cli/index.ts') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli\\index.ts') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli/index.js') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli\\index.js'));
+
+if (isDirectExecution) {
+  runCli().catch((err) => {
+    console.error(`${ANSI.red}Error:${ANSI.reset}`, err);
+    process.exit(1);
+  });
+}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import YAML from 'yaml';
+import type { OpenRabbitConfig, PathInstruction } from '../types/index.js';
+
+export const DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG: OpenRabbitConfig = {
+  language: 'en-US',
+  profile: 'chill',
+  tone_instructions:
+    'Be constructive, concise, and high-signal. Prioritize real bugs, security vulnerabilities, race conditions, and performance bottlenecks over stylistic nitpicks.',
+  early_access: true,
+  reviews: {
+    high_level_summary: true,
+    poem: true,
+    review_status: true,
+    collapse_walkthrough: false,
+    sequence_diagrams: true,
+    auto_review: {
+      enabled: true,
+      drafts: false,
+      base_branches: ['main', 'master', 'develop'],
+    },
+    path_filters: [
+      '!dist/**',
+      '!node_modules/**',
+      '!*.lock',
+      '!package-lock.json',
+      '!pnpm-lock.yaml',
+      '!**/*.min.js',
+      '!**/*.snap',
+    ],
+    path_instructions: [
+      {
+        path: 'src/api/**',
+        instructions:
+          'Verify authentication checks, input validation, rate limiting, and SQL/command injection safety on all endpoints.',
+      },
+      {
+        path: '**/*.tsx',
+        instructions:
+          'Check for React hook dependency array bugs, stale closures, memory leaks in useEffect, and accessibility attributes.',
+      },
+      {
+        path: 'tests/**',
+        instructions:
+          'Ensure tests cover edge cases, error paths, and avoid brittle timing assumptions.',
+      },
+    ],
+  },
+  chat: {
+    auto_reply: true,
+  },
+  llm: {
+    provider: 'auto',
+    temperature: 0.2,
+  },
+};
+
+const CONFIG_FILENAMES = [
+  '.openrabbit.yaml',
+  '.openrabbit.yml',
+  'openrabbit.yaml',
+  '.coderabbit.yaml',
+  '.coderabbit.yml',
+];
+
+export function loadConfig(workspaceDir: string = process.cwd()): {
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig;
+  configPath: string | null;
+} {
+  for (const filename of CONFIG_FILENAMES) {
+    const candidate = path.join(workspaceDir, filename);
+    if (fs.existsSync(candidate)) {
+      try {
+        const raw = fs.readFileSync(candidate, 'utf8');
+        const parsed = YAML.parse(raw) || {};
+        return {
+          config: mergeConfig(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG, parsed),
+          configPath: candidate,
+        };
+      } catch (err) {
+        console.warn(`Warning: Failed to parse ${candidate}, using defaults.`, err);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    config: structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG),
+    configPath: null,
+  };
+}
+
+export function parseYamlConfig(yamlContent: string): OpenRabbitConfig {
+  const parsed = YAML.parse(yamlContent) || {};
+  return mergeConfig(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG, parsed);
+}
+
+export function serializeConfigToYaml(config: OpenRabbitConfig): string {
+  const header = `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://openrabbit.dev/schema/v1.json
+# ============================================================================
+# OpenRabbit Configuration (.openrabbit.yaml)
+# Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer & Interactive PR Companion
+# ============================================================================
+
+`;
+  return header + YAML.stringify(config, { indent: 2 });
+}
+
+export function mergeConfig(
+  base: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  override: Record<string, any>
+): OpenRabbitConfig {
+  const merged = structuredClone(base);
+
+  if (typeof override.language === 'string') merged.language = override.language;
+  if (
+    override.profile === 'chill' ||
+    override.profile === 'assertive' ||
+    override.profile === 'security-focused'
+  ) {
+    merged.profile = override.profile;
+  }
+  if (typeof override.tone_instructions === 'string') {
+    merged.tone_instructions = override.tone_instructions;
+  }
+  if (typeof override.early_access === 'boolean') {
+    merged.early_access = override.early_access;
+  }
+
+  if (override.reviews && typeof override.reviews === 'object') {
+    const r = override.reviews;
+    if (typeof r.high_level_summary === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.high_level_summary = r.high_level_summary;
+    if (typeof r.poem === 'boolean') merged.reviews.poem = r.poem;
+    if (typeof r.review_status === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.review_status = r.review_status;
+    if (typeof r.collapse_walkthrough === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.collapse_walkthrough = r.collapse_walkthrough;
+    if (typeof r.sequence_diagrams === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.sequence_diagrams = r.sequence_diagrams;
+
+    if (r.auto_review && typeof r.auto_review === 'object') {
+      if (typeof r.auto_review.enabled === 'boolean')
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.enabled = r.auto_review.enabled;
+      if (typeof r.auto_review.drafts === 'boolean')
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.drafts = r.auto_review.drafts;
+      if (Array.isArray(r.auto_review.base_branches))
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.base_branches = r.auto_review.base_branches;
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(r.path_filters)) {
+      merged.reviews.path_filters = r.path_filters;
+    }
+    if (Array.isArray(r.path_instructions)) {
+      merged.reviews.path_instructions = r.path_instructions.filter(
+        (item: any) => item && typeof item.path === 'string' && typeof item.instructions === 'string'
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (override.chat && typeof override.chat === 'object') {
+    if (typeof override.chat.auto_reply === 'boolean') {
+      merged.chat.auto_reply = override.chat.auto_reply;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (override.llm && typeof override.llm === 'object') {
+    if (override.llm.provider) merged.llm.provider = override.llm.provider;
+    if (override.llm.model !== undefined) merged.llm.model = override.llm.model;
+    if (typeof override.llm.temperature === 'number') {
+      merged.llm.temperature = override.llm.temperature;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return merged;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Converts a glob pattern like `src/api/**` or `*.lock` into a RegExp.
+ */
+export function globToRegex(glob: string): RegExp {
+  const normalized = glob.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  let regexStr = '^';
+  let i = 0;
+  while (i < normalized.length) {
+    const c = normalized[i];
+    if (c === '*') {
+      if (normalized[i + 1] === '*') {
+        if (normalized[i + 2] === '/') {
+          regexStr += '(?:.+/)?';
+          i += 3;
+          continue;
+        } else {
+          regexStr += '.*';
+          i += 2;
+          continue;
+        }
+      } else {
+        regexStr += '[^/]*';
+      }
+    } else if (c === '?') {
+      regexStr += '[^/]';
+    } else if ('.+^$()|[]\\{}'.includes(c)) {
+      regexStr += '\\' + c;
+    } else {
+      regexStr += c;
+    }
+    i++;
+  }
+  regexStr += '$';
+  return new RegExp(regexStr, 'i');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a file path should be included according to `reviews.path_filters`.
+ * Supports positive globs (`src/**`) and negative exclusion globs (`!dist/**`).
+ */
+export function shouldReviewFile(filePath: string, pathFilters: string[]): boolean {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  if (!pathFilters || pathFilters.length === 0) return true;
+
+  const positiveFilters = pathFilters.filter((f) => !f.startsWith('!'));
+  const negativeFilters = pathFilters
+    .filter((f) => f.startsWith('!'))
+    .map((f) => f.slice(1));
+
+  // Check exclusions first
+  for (const neg of negativeFilters) {
+    if (globToRegex(neg).test(normalized) || globToRegex(`**/${neg}`).test(normalized)) {
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // If positive filters exist, file must match at least one
+  if (positiveFilters.length > 0) {
+    return positiveFilters.some((pos) => globToRegex(pos).test(normalized));
+  }
+
+  return true;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns all matching path_instructions for a given file path.
+ */
+export function getMatchingPathInstructions(
+  filePath: string,
+  instructions: PathInstruction[]
+): PathInstruction[] {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  return (instructions || []).filter((inst) =>
+    globToRegex(inst.path).test(normalized)
+  );
+}

+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  serializeConfigToYaml,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import type {
+  ChatCommandType,
+  ChatRequest,
+  ChatResponse,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+import { parseUnifiedDiff } from './diff-parser.js';
+import {
+  generateLLMCompletion,
+  resolveActiveProvider,
+} from './llm-provider.js';
+
+export function detectChatCommand(query: string): ChatCommandType {
+  const cleaned = query
+    .replace(/@openrabbit\b/gi, '')
+    .replace(/@coderabbitai\b/gi, '')
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+
+  if (/\b(?:test|tests|unit\s+test|spec|vitest|jest)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'test';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:fix|patch|refactor|suggestion|apply)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'fix';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:docstring|jsdoc|tsdoc|comment|document)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'docstring';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:explain|how\s+does|walk\s+me\s+through|why)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'explain';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:summary|summarize|tldr|walkthrough)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'summary';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:config|configuration|yaml|rules)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'config';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:resolve|lgtm|fixed|done)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'resolve';
+  }
+  return 'question';
+}
+
+export async function handlePRChat(
+  req: ChatRequest,
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig = DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG
+): Promise<ChatResponse> {
+  const commandDetected = detectChatCommand(req.query);
+  const active = resolveActiveProvider(config.llm.provider, config.llm.model);
+
+  if (commandDetected === 'config') {
+    return {
+      commandDetected,
+      replyMarkdown: `### ⚙️ Active \`.openrabbit.yaml\` Configuration\n\n\`\`\`yaml\n${serializeConfigToYaml(
+        config
+      )}\`\`\``,
+      providerUsed: active.provider,
+      modelUsed: active.model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (commandDetected === 'resolve') {
+    return {
+      commandDetected,
+      replyMarkdown: `✅ **Thread Resolved!** Thanks for addressing this finding. I've marked this review discussion as resolved. 🐇🥕`,
+      providerUsed: active.provider,
+      modelUsed: active.model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (active.provider !== 'heuristic') {
+    try {
+      const systemPrompt = `You are @openrabbit, an interactive AI Pull Request assistant embedded in GitHub/GitLab and the OpenRabbit CLI.
+Detected command intent: ${commandDetected.toUpperCase()}
+Tone instructions: ${config.tone_instructions}
+Respond in clear, high-signal GitHub Flavored Markdown. When suggesting code fixes, use \`\`\`suggestion blocks or language-tagged code blocks.`;
+
+      const contextParts: string[] = [];
+      if (req.prTitle) contextParts.push(`PR Title: ${req.prTitle}`);
+      if (req.file) contextParts.push(`Target File: ${req.file}${req.line ? `:${req.line}` : ''}`);
+      if (req.findingContext) {
+        contextParts.push(
+          `Inline Finding Context: [${req.findingContext.severity.toUpperCase()}] ${req.findingContext.title}\n${req.findingContext.body}\nOriginal Code: ${req.findingContext.originalCode || 'N/A'}\nSuggested Code: ${req.findingContext.suggestionCode || 'N/A'}`
+        );
+      }
+      if (req.diff) {
+        contextParts.push(`Diff Context:\n\`\`\`diff\n${req.diff.slice(0, 6000)}\n\`\`\``);
+      }
+
+      const userPrompt = `${contextParts.join('\n\n')}\n\nDeveloper Query: ${req.query}`;
+
+      const llmRes = await generateLLMCompletion({
+        systemPrompt,
+        userPrompt,
+        temperature: 0.2,
+        preferredProvider: active.provider,
+        preferredModel: active.model,
+      });
+
+      return {
+        commandDetected,
+        replyMarkdown: llmRes.content,
+        suggestedCode: req.findingContext?.suggestionCode,
+        providerUsed: llmRes.provider,
+        modelUsed: llmRes.model,
+      };
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn(
+        '[OpenRabbit Chat] External LLM call failed, using deterministic response builder:',
+        (err as Error).message
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  return buildHeuristicChatResponse(req, commandDetected);
+}
+
+function buildHeuristicChatResponse(
+  req: ChatRequest,
+  command: ChatCommandType
+): ChatResponse {
+  const parsed = req.diff ? parseUnifiedDiff(req.diff) : null;
+  const targetFile =
+    req.file ||
+    req.findingContext?.file ||
+    parsed?.files[0]?.newPath ||
+    'src/module.ts';
+  const symbols =
+    parsed?.files.flatMap((f) => f.symbolsChanged).filter(Boolean) || [];
+  const primarySymbol = symbols[0] || 'targetHandler';
+
+  if (command === 'test') {
+    const testCode = `import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { ${primarySymbol} } from './${targetFile.split('/').pop()?.replace(/\.[jt]sx?$/, '') || 'module'}';
+
+describe('${primarySymbol} (${targetFile})', () => {
+  it('handles valid inputs and resolves expected state cleanly', async () => {
+    const result = await ${primarySymbol}({ id: 'usr_101', role: 'member' });
+    expect(result).toBeDefined();
+  });
+
+  it('rejects malformed or malicious payloads safely (regression check)', async () => {
+    await expect(
+      ${primarySymbol}({ id: "' OR 1=1 --", role: 'admin' })
+    ).rejects.toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it('cleans up async resources when aborted or on error', async () => {
+    const spy = vi.fn();
+    await expect(${primarySymbol}(null as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)).rejects.toThrow();
+    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});`;
+
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'test',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 🧪 Generated Unit Test Suite for \`${targetFile}\``,
+        '',
+        `Here is a comprehensive test suite covering the happy path, security/input validation boundary cases, and error handling for \`${primarySymbol}\`:`,
+        '',
+        '```typescript',
+        testCode,
+        '```',
+        '',
+        `<sub>🐇 *Generated by OpenRabbit · Run via \`npm test\` or copy into \`tests/${
+          targetFile.split('/').pop()?.replace(/\.[jt]sx?$/, '') || 'module'
+        }.test.ts\`*</sub>`,
+      ].join('\n'),
+      suggestedCode: testCode,
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'fix') {
+    const fixedCode =
+      req.findingContext?.suggestionCode ||
+      `// Validated and parameterized implementation for ${primarySymbol}\nconst sanitizedInput = String(input).trim();\nconst result = await db.query('SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE id = $1', [sanitizedInput]);`;
+
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'fix',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 🔧 Committable Fix for \`${targetFile}\`${
+          req.line ? ` (Line ${req.line})` : ''
+        }`,
+        '',
+        req.findingContext
+          ? `Addressing **${req.findingContext.title}** (\`[${req.findingContext.category}]\`):`
+          : `Here is a safe, drop-in replacement patch for \`${targetFile}\`:`,
+        '',
+        '```suggestion',
+        fixedCode,
+        '```',
+        '',
+        `#### Why this fix works:`,
+        `- Eliminates unsafe runtime behavior while preserving the existing function signature.`,
+        `- Prevents unhandled edge cases and ensures strict input safety.`,
+      ].join('\n'),
+      suggestedCode: fixedCode,
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'docstring') {
+    const docBlock = `/**
+ * Executes \`${primarySymbol}\` with validated inputs and structured error propagation.
+ *
+ * @param params - Verified request parameters for ${targetFile}
+ * @returns Promise resolving to the processed domain payload
+ * @throws {Error} When input validation or downstream I/O fails
+ */`;
+
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'docstring',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 📖 Generated TSDoc / JSDoc for \`${primarySymbol}\``,
+        '',
+        '```suggestion',
+        docBlock,
+        '```',
+      ].join('\n'),
+      suggestedCode: docBlock,
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'explain') {
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'explain',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 🔍 Deep-Dive Explanation: \`${targetFile}\``,
+        '',
+        req.findingContext
+          ? `**Context:** ${req.findingContext.title} (\`${req.findingContext.severity.toUpperCase()}\` · \`${req.findingContext.category}\`)\n\n${req.findingContext.body}`
+          : `This change modifies **\`${targetFile}\`**${
+              symbols.length > 0
+                ? ` across symbol(s) ${symbols.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`
+                : ''
+            }.`,
+        '',
+        `#### Execution & Control Flow`,
+        `1. **Entry Point:** Caller invokes \`${primarySymbol}\` with incoming parameters.`,
+        `2. **Hazard / Invariant Check:** ${
+          req.findingContext?.originalCode
+            ? `Line \`${req.findingContext.originalCode.trim()}\` executes directly on the hot path.`
+            : `Modified lines update state and interact with downstream I/O.`
+        }`,
+        `3. **Recommendation:** ${
+          req.findingContext?.suggestionCode
+            ? `Applying the committable suggestion replaces the vulnerable pattern with \`${req.findingContext.suggestionCode.trim()}\`.`
+            : `Ensure boundary inputs and async rejections are handled deterministically.`
+        }`,
+      ].join('\n'),
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+    };
+  }
+
+  // Default question / summary response
+  return {
+    commandDetected: command,
+    replyMarkdown: [
+      `### 🐇 OpenRabbit Assistant`,
+      '',
+      `Regarding your question on \`${targetFile}\`:`,
+      `> *"${req.query.replace(/@openrabbit\s*/i, '')}"*`,
+      '',
+      req.findingContext
+        ? `- **Finding:** ${req.findingContext.title}\n- **Analysis:** ${req.findingContext.body}\n- **Recommended Patch:** \`${
+            req.findingContext.suggestionCode || 'See inline suggestion above'
+          }\``
+        : `- **Files in scope:** ${
+            parsed?.files.map((f) => `\`${f.newPath}\``).join(', ') ||
+            `\`${targetFile}\``
+          }\n- **Symbols modified:** ${
+            symbols.length > 0
+              ? symbols.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')
+              : 'Module-level changes'
+          }`,
+      '',
+      `💡 *You can also run \`@openrabbit test\` to generate unit tests, \`@openrabbit fix\` for a committable patch, or \`@openrabbit docstring\` for documentation.*`,

+import type { DiffHunk, DiffLine, FileDiff, ParsedDiff } from '../types/index.js';
+
+const EXTENSION_LANGUAGE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
+  ts: 'TypeScript',
+  tsx: 'TypeScript (React)',
+  js: 'JavaScript',
+  jsx: 'JavaScript (React)',
+  mjs: 'JavaScript',
+  cjs: 'JavaScript',
+  py: 'Python',
+  go: 'Go',
+  rs: 'Rust',
+  java: 'Java',
+  kt: 'Kotlin',
+  rb: 'Ruby',
+  php: 'PHP',
+  cs: 'C#',
+  cpp: 'C++',
+  c: 'C',
+  h: 'C/C++ Header',
+  swift: 'Swift',
+  sql: 'SQL',
+  sh: 'Shell',
+  yaml: 'YAML',
+  yml: 'YAML',
+  json: 'JSON',
+  md: 'Markdown',
+  css: 'CSS',
+  html: 'HTML',
+};
+
+export function detectLanguage(filePath: string): string {
+  const ext = filePath.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
+  return EXTENSION_LANGUAGE_MAP[ext] || 'Code';
+}
+
+export function inferComponentName(filePath: string): string {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  const parts = normalized.split('/');
+  if (parts.length === 1) return 'Root';
+  if (parts[0] === 'src' && parts.length >= 3) {
+    return parts[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + parts[1].slice(1);
+  }
+  return parts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + parts[0].slice(1);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Extracts function, class, method, or hook names from hunk headers and diff lines.
+ */
+export function extractChangedSymbols(hunks: DiffHunk[]): string[] {
+  const symbols = new Set<string>();
+  const patterns = [
+    /(?:export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/,
+    /(?:export\s+)?class\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/,
+    /(?:export\s+)?interface\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/,
+    /(?:export\s+)?const\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\([^)]*\)|[A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s*=>/,
+    /^\s*(?:async\s+)?([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(?::\s*[^{]+)?\{/,
+    /def\s+([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(/,
+    /func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(/,
+    /fn\s+([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*[<(]/,
+  ];
+
+  for (const hunk of hunks) {
+    if (hunk.sectionHeading) {
+      for (const regex of patterns) {
+        const m = hunk.sectionHeading.match(regex);
+        if (m && m[1] && !['if', 'for', 'while', 'switch', 'catch'].includes(m[1])) {
+          symbols.add(m[1]);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    for (const line of hunk.lines) {
+      for (const regex of patterns) {
+        const m = line.content.match(regex);
+        if (m && m[1] && !['if', 'for', 'while', 'switch', 'catch'].includes(m[1])) {
+          symbols.add(m[1]);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return Array.from(symbols).slice(0, 12);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Parses a standard unified git diff string into structured FileDiff and DiffHunk objects.
+ */
+export function parseUnifiedDiff(rawDiff: string): ParsedDiff {
+  if (!rawDiff || !rawDiff.trim()) {
+    return {
+      files: [],
+      totalAdditions: 0,
+      totalDeletions: 0,
+      totalFiles: 0,
+    };
+  }
+
+  const normalized = rawDiff.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
+  const lines = normalized.split('\n');
+  const files: FileDiff[] = [];
+
+  let currentFile: FileDiff | null = null;
+  let currentHunk: DiffHunk | null = null;
+  let oldLineCounter = 0;
+  let newLineCounter = 0;
+  let currentPatchLines: string[] = [];
+
+  const flushFile = () => {
+    if (currentFile) {
+      currentFile.rawPatch = currentPatchLines.join('\n').trim();
+      currentFile.symbolsChanged = extractChangedSymbols(currentFile.hunks);
+      files.push(currentFile);
+    }
+    currentFile = null;
+    currentHunk = null;
+    currentPatchLines = [];
+  };
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+    const line = lines[i];
+
+    if (line.startsWith('diff --git ')) {
+      flushFile();
+      const match = line.match(/^diff --git a\/(.+?) b\/(.+)$/);
+      const oldPath = match ? match[1] : 'unknown';
+      const newPath = match ? match[2] : oldPath;
+      currentFile = {
+        oldPath,
+        newPath,
+        status: 'modified',
+        language: detectLanguage(newPath),
+        additions: 0,
+        deletions: 0,
+        hunks: [],
+        rawPatch: '',
+        symbolsChanged: [],
+      };
+      currentPatchLines.push(line);
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    // Support diffs that start directly with --- a/file and +++ b/file without `diff --git`
+    if (!currentFile && line.startsWith('--- ')) {
+      const nextLine = lines[i + 1] || '';
+      if (nextLine.startsWith('+++ ')) {
+        const oldRaw = line.slice(4).trim().replace(/^a\//, '');
+        const newRaw = nextLine.slice(4).trim().replace(/^b\//, '');
+        const resolvedPath = newRaw === '/dev/null' ? oldRaw : newRaw;
+        currentFile = {
+          oldPath: oldRaw,
+          newPath: resolvedPath,
+          status:
+            oldRaw === '/dev/null'
+              ? 'added'
+              : newRaw === '/dev/null'
+              ? 'deleted'
+              : 'modified',
+          language: detectLanguage(resolvedPath),
+          additions: 0,
+          deletions: 0,
+          hunks: [],
+          rawPatch: '',
+          symbolsChanged: [],
+        };
+        currentPatchLines.push(line);
+        continue;
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (!currentFile) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    currentPatchLines.push(line);
+
+    if (line.startsWith('new file mode')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'added';
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('deleted file mode')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'deleted';
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('rename from ')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'renamed';
+      currentFile.oldPath = line.slice('rename from '.length).trim();
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('rename to ')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'renamed';
+      currentFile.newPath = line.slice('rename to '.length).trim();
+      currentFile.language = detectLanguage(currentFile.newPath);
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('--- ')) {
+      const oldRaw = line.slice(4).trim();
+      if (oldRaw === '/dev/null') {
+        currentFile.status = 'added';
+      } else {
+        currentFile.oldPath = oldRaw.replace(/^a\//, '');
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('+++ ')) {
+      const newRaw = line.slice(4).trim();
+      if (newRaw === '/dev/null') {
+        currentFile.status = 'deleted';
+      } else {
+        currentFile.newPath = newRaw.replace(/^b\//, '');
+        currentFile.language = detectLanguage(currentFile.newPath);
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    // Hunk header: @@ -oldStart,oldLines +newStart,newLines @@ optional section
+    if (line.startsWith('@@ ')) {
+      const hunkMatch = line.match(
+        /^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@(.*)$/
+      );
+      if (hunkMatch) {
+        const oldStart = parseInt(hunkMatch[1], 10);
+        const oldLines = hunkMatch[2] !== undefined ? parseInt(hunkMatch[2], 10) : 1;
+        const newStart = parseInt(hunkMatch[3], 10);
+        const newLines = hunkMatch[4] !== undefined ? parseInt(hunkMatch[4], 10) : 1;
+        const sectionHeading = hunkMatch[5]?.trim() || undefined;
+
+        oldLineCounter = oldStart;
+        newLineCounter = newStart;
+
+        currentHunk = {
+          header: line,
+          oldStart,
+          oldLines,
+          newStart,
+          newLines,
+          sectionHeading,
+          lines: [],
+        };
+        currentFile.hunks.push(currentHunk);
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    if (currentHunk) {
+      if (line.startsWith('+')) {
+        const diffLine: DiffLine = {
+          type: 'add',
+          content: line.slice(1),
+          newLineNumber: newLineCounter++,
+        };
+        currentHunk.lines.push(diffLine);
+        currentFile.additions++;
+      } else if (line.startsWith('-')) {
+        const diffLine: DiffLine = {
+          type: 'del',
+          content: line.slice(1),
+          oldLineNumber: oldLineCounter++,
+        };
+        currentHunk.lines.push(diffLine);
+        currentFile.deletions++;
+      } else if (line.startsWith(' ')) {
+        const diffLine: DiffLine = {
+          type: 'context',
+          content: line.slice(1),
+          oldLineNumber: oldLineCounter++,
+          newLineNumber: newLineCounter++,
+        };
+        currentHunk.lines.push(diffLine);
+      } else if (line.startsWith('\\ No newline at end of file')) {
+        // Ignore marker
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  flushFile();
+
+  const totalAdditions = files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.additions, 0);
+  const totalDeletions = files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.deletions, 0);
+
+  return {
+    files,
+    totalAdditions,
+    totalDeletions,
+    totalFiles: files.length,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats a FileDiff with explicit new-file line numbers so LLMs can pinpoint
+ * exact lines for GitHub/GitLab inline review comments and committable suggestions.
+ */
+export function formatAnnotatedFileDiff(file: FileDiff): string {
+  const out: string[] = [];
+  out.push(`### File: \`${file.newPath}\` (${file.status}, +${file.additions}/-${file.deletions}, ${file.language})`);
+  if (file.symbolsChanged.length > 0) {
+    out.push(`Symbols modified: ${file.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`);
+  }
+
+  for (const hunk of file.hunks) {
+    out.push(hunk.header);
+    for (const line of hunk.lines) {
+      if (line.type === 'add') {
+        out.push(`L${String(line.newLineNumber).padEnd(4, ' ')} + | ${line.content}`);
+      } else if (line.type === 'del') {
+        out.push(`OLD${String(line.oldLineNumber).padEnd(2, ' ')} - | ${line.content}`);
+      } else {
+        out.push(`L${String(line.newLineNumber).padEnd(4, ' ')}   | ${line.content}`);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return out.join('\n');
+}

+import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
+
+export interface LocalGitDiffOptions {
+  cwd?: string;
+  staged?: boolean;
+  baseBranch?: string;
+  commitRange?: string;
+}
+
+export function getLocalGitDiff(options: LocalGitDiffOptions = {}): {
+  diff: string;
+  branch: string;
+  repoName: string;
+  author: string;
+  description: string;
+} {
+  const cwd = options.cwd || process.cwd();
+
+  const safeExec = (cmd: string): string => {
+    try {
+      return execSync(cmd, {
+        cwd,
+        encoding: 'utf8',
+        stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'],
+      }).trim();
+    } catch {
+      return '';
+    }
+  };
+
+  const branch = safeExec('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD') || 'main';
+  const remoteUrl = safeExec('git config --get remote.origin.url');
+  let repoName = 'local/openrabbit';
+  if (remoteUrl) {
+    const match = remoteUrl.match(/[:/]([^/:]+\/[^/.]+?)(?:\.git)?$/);
+    if (match) repoName = match[1];
+  } else {
+    const topLevel = safeExec('git rev-parse --show-toplevel');
+    if (topLevel) {
+      const folder = topLevel.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop();
+      if (folder) repoName = `local/${folder}`;
+    }
+  }
+  const author = safeExec('git config user.name') || 'developer';
+
+  let diff = '';
+  let description = '';
+
+  if (options.commitRange) {
+    diff = safeExec(`git diff ${options.commitRange}`);
+    description = `Commit range ${options.commitRange}`;
+  } else if (options.baseBranch) {
+    diff = safeExec(`git diff ${options.baseBranch}...HEAD`);
+    description = `Branch diff against ${options.baseBranch}`;
+  } else if (options.staged) {
+    diff = safeExec('git diff --staged');
+    description = 'Staged changes (git diff --staged)';
+  } else {
+    // Try unstaged + staged against HEAD, or fallback to last commit
+    diff = safeExec('git diff HEAD');
+    description = 'Working tree changes (git diff HEAD)';
+    if (!diff) {
+      diff = safeExec('git diff --staged');
+      description = 'Staged changes';
+    }
+    if (!diff) {
+      diff = safeExec('git show --format= HEAD');
+      description = 'Latest commit (HEAD)';
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    diff: diff ? diff + '\n' : '',
+    branch,
+    repoName,
+    author,
+    description,
+  };
+}

+        return {

+          suggestionCode: `${indent}const intervalId = ${line.trim()}\n${indent}// Ensure clearInterval(intervalId) is called during cleanup`,
+        };
+      }
+      return {
+        body: 'Ensure this subscription or interval is paired with a corresponding `clearInterval` / `removeEventListener` cleanup handler to prevent memory leaks.',
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'type-explicit-any',
+    title: 'Avoid explicit `any` type annotation to preserve type safety',
+    severity: 'nitpick',
+    category: 'type-safety',
+    matchLine: (line, file) =>
+      file.language.includes('TypeScript') &&
+      /:\s*any\b|<any>|as\s+any\b/.test(line),
+    buildFinding: (line) => ({
+      body: 'Using `any` disables TypeScript compile-time checks and allows unsafe property access to propagate silently. Prefer `unknown` with type narrowing or a dedicated interface/generic type.',
+      suggestionCode: line
+        .replace(/:\s*any\b/g, ': unknown')
+        .replace(/as\s+any\b/g, 'as unknown'),
+    }),
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'maint-leftover-debug',
+    title: 'Leftover debugging statement (`console.log` / `debugger`)',
+    severity: 'nitpick',
+    category: 'maintainability',
+    matchLine: (line, file) =>
+      !file.newPath.includes('cli') &&
+      !file.newPath.includes('test') &&
+      (/\bdebugger\s*;?/.test(line) || /\bconsole\.log\s*\(/.test(line)),
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      return {
+        body: 'Debug statements or raw `console.log` calls in production code can leak sensitive payloads to stdout and clutter structured logs. Remove before merging or route through a structured logger.',
+        suggestionCode: line.includes('debugger')
+          ? `${indent}// debugger removed`
+          : line.replace(/console\.log\(/, 'logger.debug('),
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'bug-empty-catch',
+    title: 'Empty or silent `catch` block swallows runtime exceptions',
+    severity: 'warning',
+    category: 'bug',
+    matchLine: (line, _file, contextLines) => {
+      if (!/\bcatch\b/.test(line)) return false;
+      const joined = contextLines.join(' ');
+      return /catch\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*\{\s*\}/.test(joined);
+    },
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      return {
+        body: 'Swallowing exceptions in an empty `catch` block hides unexpected failures and makes production debugging difficult. Log the error with context or rethrow a domain-specific error.',
+        suggestionCode: `${indent}} catch (error) {\n${indent}  console.error('Operation failed:', error);\n${indent}  throw error;\n${indent}}`,
+      };
+    },
+  },
+];

+/**
+ * Generates high-signal inline findings using deterministic static analysis
+ * and `.openrabbit.yaml` path instruction checks.
+ */
+export function runHeuristicInlineReview(
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig
+): InlineFinding[] {
+  const findings: InlineFinding[] = [];
+  const seenKeys = new Set<string>();
+
+  for (const file of files) {
+    if (file.status === 'deleted') continue;
+
+    for (const hunk of file.hunks) {
+      const addedLinesWithIndex = hunk.lines
+        .map((l, idx) => ({ line: l, idx }))
+        .filter((item) => item.line.type === 'add' && item.line.newLineNumber);
+
+      for (const { line, idx } of addedLinesWithIndex) {
+        const lineNum = line.newLineNumber!;
+        const contextSlice = hunk.lines
+          .slice(Math.max(0, idx - 3), Math.min(hunk.lines.length, idx + 4))
+          .map((l) => l.content);
+
+        for (const rule of HEURISTIC_RULES) {
+          // Filter nitpicks if profile is 'chill'
+          if (config.profile === 'chill' && rule.severity === 'nitpick') {
+            continue;
+          }
+
+          if (rule.matchLine(line.content, file, contextSlice)) {
+            const dedupeKey = `${file.newPath}:${rule.id}:${Math.floor(lineNum / 5)}`;
+            if (seenKeys.has(dedupeKey)) continue;
+            seenKeys.add(dedupeKey);
+
+            const details = rule.buildFinding(
+              line.content,
+              lineNum,
+              file,
+              contextSlice
+            );
+
+            findings.push({
+              id: `finding-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+              file: file.newPath,
+              startLine: lineNum,
+              endLine: lineNum,
+              severity: rule.severity,
+              category: rule.category,
+              title: rule.title,
+              body: details.body,
+              suggestionCode: details.suggestionCode,
+              originalCode: line.content,
+              ruleMatched: rule.id,
+            });
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  // If a PR has clean additions and no issues were flagged, add a constructive architectural observation or praise
+  if (findings.length === 0 && files.length > 0) {
+    const primaryFile = files.find((f) => f.hunks.length > 0) || files[0];
+    const firstHunk = primaryFile.hunks[0];
+    const firstAdd = firstHunk?.lines.find((l) => l.type === 'add');
+    const targetLine = firstAdd?.newLineNumber || firstHunk?.newStart || 1;
+
+    findings.push({
+      id: `finding-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+      file: primaryFile.newPath,
+      startLine: targetLine,
+      endLine: targetLine,
+      severity: 'praise',
+      category: 'architecture',
+      title: 'Clean, well-structured implementation with no high-risk anti-patterns',
+      body: `Reviewed **+${primaryFile.additions}/-${primaryFile.deletions}** lines in \`${primaryFile.newPath}\`${
+        primaryFile.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+          ? ` affecting ${primaryFile.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`
+          : ''
+      }. No security vulnerabilities, unawaited promises, or unsafe type coercions were detected.`,
+    });
+  }
+
+  return findings;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Generates a complete CodeRabbit-style PR Walkthrough (Summary, Release Notes,
+ * File Table, Mermaid Sequence Diagram, Poem, and Risk Score) from the parsed diff.
+ */
+export function buildHeuristicWalkthrough(
+  prTitle: string,
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  findings: InlineFinding[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig
+): PRWalkthrough {
+  const fileSummaries: FileWalkthroughSummary[] = files.map((file) => {
+    const component = inferComponentName(file.newPath);
+    const fileFindings = findings.filter((f) => f.file === file.newPath);
+    const hasCritical = fileFindings.some((f) => f.severity === 'critical');
+    const hasWarning = fileFindings.some((f) => f.severity === 'warning');
+    const churn = file.additions + file.deletions;
+
+    const impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' =
+      hasCritical || churn > 80 ? 'high' : hasWarning || churn > 25 ? 'medium' : 'low';
+
+    let summary = '';
+    if (file.status === 'added') {
+      summary = `Introduces new ${file.language} module${
+        file.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+          ? ` defining ${file.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`
+          : ''
+      } (+${file.additions} lines).`;
+    } else if (file.status === 'deleted') {
+      summary = `Removes legacy ${file.language} file (-${file.deletions} lines).`;
+    } else if (file.symbolsChanged.length > 0) {
+      summary = `Updates ${file.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')} in ${component} (+${file.additions}/-${file.deletions}).`;
+    } else {
+      summary = `Refines ${component.toLowerCase()} logic and configuration (+${file.additions}/-${file.deletions} lines).`;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      path: file.newPath,
+      status: file.status,
+      additions: file.additions,
+      deletions: file.deletions,
+      component,
+      summary,
+      impact,
+    };
+  });
+
+  const totalAdditions = files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.additions, 0);
+  const totalDeletions = files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.deletions, 0);
+  const components = Array.from(new Set(fileSummaries.map((f) => f.component)));
+
+  const criticalFindings = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical');
+  const warningFindings = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'warning');
+
+  const riskLevel: PRWalkthrough['riskLevel'] =
+    criticalFindings.length > 0
+      ? 'critical'
+      : warningFindings.length >= 2
+      ? 'high'
+      : warningFindings.length === 1 || totalAdditions + totalDeletions > 150
+      ? 'moderate'
+      : 'low';
+
+  const totalChurn = totalAdditions + totalDeletions;
+  const effortScore: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 =
+    totalChurn > 400 || criticalFindings.length >= 2
+      ? 5
+      : totalChurn > 200 || criticalFindings.length === 1
+      ? 4
+      : totalChurn > 75 || warningFindings.length >= 1
+      ? 3
+      : totalChurn > 20
+      ? 2
+      : 1;
+
+  const estimatedMinutes = Math.max(2, Math.min(45, Math.ceil(totalChurn / 18) + findings.length * 2));
+
+  // Build Mermaid sequence diagram reflecting the actual components/files changed
+  const mermaidDiagram = generateMermaidDiagramForDiff(files, fileSummaries);
+
+  // Build rabbit poem
+  const poem = config.reviews.poem
+    ? generateRabbitPoem(files, criticalFindings.length, warningFindings.length)
+    : '';
+
+  const executiveSummary = `This pull request modifies **${files.length} file${
+    files.length === 1 ? '' : 's'
+  }** across **${components.join(', ') || 'the repository'}** (+${totalAdditions}/-${totalDeletions} lines). ${
+    criticalFindings.length > 0
+      ? `OpenRabbit identified **${criticalFindings.length} critical issue(s)** and **${warningFindings.length} warning(s)** that should be addressed prior to merge.`
+      : warningFindings.length > 0
+      ? `OpenRabbit surfaced **${warningFindings.length} actionable warning(s)** with committable code suggestions.`
+      : `The changes are clean and well-scoped with no blocking defects found.`
+  }`;
+
+  const releaseNotes = [
+    {
+      category: files.some((f) => f.status === 'added') ? 'New Features & Modules' : 'Enhancements & Refactoring',
+      items: fileSummaries.slice(0, 5).map((f) => `${f.component}: ${f.summary}`),
+    },
+  ];
+
+  const securityConcerns = findings
+    .filter((f) => f.category === 'security')
+    .map((f) => `${f.file}:L${f.startLine} — ${f.title}`);
+
+  return {
+    title: prTitle || 'Pull Request Review',
+    executiveSummary,
+    releaseNotes,
+    fileSummaries,
+    mermaidDiagram,
+    poem,
+    effortScore,
+    estimatedMinutes,
+    riskLevel,
+    securityConcerns,
+  };
+}
+
+function sanitizeMermaidId(raw: string): string {
+  return raw.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'Node';
+}
+
+function generateMermaidDiagramForDiff(
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  summaries: FileWalkthroughSummary[]
+): string {
+  if (files.length === 0) {
+    return `sequenceDiagram\n  participant Dev as Developer\n  participant OR as OpenRabbit\n  Dev->>OR: Submit Pull Request\n  OR-->>Dev: Walkthrough & Inline Review`;
+  }
+
+  const lines: string[] = ['sequenceDiagram', '  autonumber', '  actor Caller as Caller / Client'];
+
+  const topFiles = files.slice(0, 4);
+  topFiles.forEach((f, idx) => {
+    const shortName = f.newPath.split('/').pop() || f.newPath;
+    const participantId = `M${idx}_${sanitizeMermaidId(shortName)}`;
+    lines.push(`  participant ${participantId} as ${shortName}`);
+  });
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < topFiles.length; i++) {
+    const f = topFiles[i];
+    const shortName = f.newPath.split('/').pop() || f.newPath;
+    const participantId = `M${i}_${sanitizeMermaidId(shortName)}`;
+    const symbolLabel =
+      f.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+        ? `${f.symbolsChanged[0]}()`
+        : `${summaries[i]?.status || 'update'} (+${f.additions}/-${f.deletions})`;
+
+    if (i === 0) {
+      lines.push(`  Caller->>+${participantId}: Invoke ${symbolLabel}`);
+    } else {
+      const prevShort = topFiles[i - 1].newPath.split('/').pop() || topFiles[i - 1].newPath;
+      const prevId = `M${i - 1}_${sanitizeMermaidId(prevShort)}`;
+      lines.push(`  ${prevId}->>+${participantId}: Call ${symbolLabel}`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (let i = topFiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+    const f = topFiles[i];
+    const shortName = f.newPath.split('/').pop() || f.newPath;
+    const participantId = `M${i}_${sanitizeMermaidId(shortName)}`;
+    if (i === 0) {
+      lines.push(`  ${participantId}-->>-Caller: Return result`);
+    } else {
+      const prevShort = topFiles[i - 1].newPath.split('/').pop() || topFiles[i - 1].newPath;
+      const prevId = `M${i - 1}_${sanitizeMermaidId(prevShort)}`;
+      lines.push(`  ${participantId}-->>-${prevId}: Propagate state`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+function generateRabbitPoem(
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  criticalCount: number,
+  warningCount: number
+): string {
+  const firstFile = files[0]?.newPath.split('/').pop() || 'the codebase';
+  if (criticalCount > 0) {
+    return [
+      `A twitch of the ear at \`${firstFile}\` in flight,`,
+      `Green lines of ambition, bold changes in sight—`,
+      `Yet traps in the burrow lurk under the clover,`,
+      `Let's patch up the hazards before hopping over! 🐇🛡️`,
+    ].join('\n');
+  }
+  if (warningCount > 0) {
+    return [
+      `Through hunks of \`${firstFile}\` the swift rabbit hops,`,
+      `Inspecting each promise and loop before stops.`,
+      `A few gentle tweaks make the burrow secure—`,
+      `Commit the suggestions for code clean and pure! 🐇✨`,
+    ].join('\n');
+  }
+  return [
+    `Across \`${firstFile}\` the fresh patches gleam,`,
+    `As crisp as a carrot beside a clear stream.`,
+    `No tangles or snares in the logic we find—`,
+    `Hop onward to merge with a confident mind! 🐇🥕`,
+  ].join('\n');
+}

+export function resolveActiveProvider(

+  const envProvider = (process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_PROVIDER as LLMProviderType) || preferred;

+  if (target === 'openai' && process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) {

+        process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL ||

+    };

+      provider: 'gemini',

+        messages: [
+          { role: 'system', content: req.systemPrompt },
+          { role: 'user', content: req.userPrompt },
+        ],
+      }),
+    });
+
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      const errText = await res.text();
+      throw new Error(`Ollama API error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
+    }
+    const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+    return {
+      content: data.message?.content || '',
+      provider: 'ollama',
+      model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  throw new Error('Heuristic provider handles analysis directly without remote LLM calls.');
+}
