+import type {
+  InlineFinding,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+  PRWalkthrough,
+  ReviewSeverity,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+
+export const WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER = '<!-- openrabbit-walkthrough -->';
+
+const SEVERITY_BADGES: Record<ReviewSeverity, { icon: string; label: string }> = {
+  critical: { icon: '🛑', label: 'Critical' },
+  warning: { icon: '⚠️', label: 'Warning' },
+  suggestion: { icon: '💡', label: 'Suggestion' },
+  nitpick: { icon: '🧹', label: 'Nitpick' },
+  praise: { icon: '🙌', label: 'Praise' },
+};
+
+export function renderEffortBar(score: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5): string {
+  const filled = '🟦'.repeat(score);
+  const empty = '⬜'.repeat(5 - score);
+  return `${filled}${empty} (${score}/5)`;
+}
+
+export function formatWalkthroughMarkdown(
+  walkthrough: PRWalkthrough,
+  findings: InlineFinding[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  meta?: { provider: string; model: string; durationMs: number }
+): string {
+  const actionableCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'praise').length;
+  const criticalCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical').length;
+  const warningCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'warning').length;
+
+  const lines: string[] = [WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER];
+  lines.push(`## 🐇 OpenRabbit PR Walkthrough`);
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(walkthrough.executiveSummary);
+  lines.push('');
+
+  // Release Notes / Summary by Category
+  if (walkthrough.releaseNotes && walkthrough.releaseNotes.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(`### 📋 Summary by OpenRabbit`);
+    for (const group of walkthrough.releaseNotes) {
+      lines.push(`- **${group.category}**`);
+      for (const item of group.items) {
+        lines.push(`  - ${item}`);
+      }
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  // Review Status & Effort Header
+  lines.push(
+    `| Metric | Value |`
+  );
+  lines.push(`| :--- | :--- |`);
+  lines.push(`| **Review Effort** | ${renderEffortBar(walkthrough.effortScore)} (~${walkthrough.estimatedMinutes} min) |`);
+  lines.push(
+    `| **Risk Assessment** | **${walkthrough.riskLevel.toUpperCase()}** ${
+      criticalCount > 0
+        ? `(${criticalCount} critical, ${warningCount} warnings)`
+        : warningCount > 0
+        ? `(${warningCount} warnings)`
+        : '(No blocking issues)'
+    } |`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `| **Actionable Comments** | **${actionableCount}** inline finding${
+      actionableCount === 1 ? '' : 's'
+    } |`
+  );
+  if (meta) {
+    lines.push(
+      `| **Engine** | \`${meta.provider}/${meta.model}\` (${(
+        meta.durationMs / 1000
+      ).toFixed(2)}s) |`
+    );
+  }
+  lines.push('');
+
+  // Collapsible Walkthrough details
+  const openAttr = config.reviews.collapse_walkthrough ? '' : ' open';
+  lines.push(`<details${openAttr}>`);
+  lines.push(`<summary><strong>🧭 Detailed File Walkthrough (${walkthrough.fileSummaries.length} files)</strong></summary>`);
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(`| File | Component | Changes | Impact | Summary |`);
+  lines.push(`| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |`);
+  for (const f of walkthrough.fileSummaries) {
+    const impactIcon =
+      f.impact === 'high' ? '🔴 High' : f.impact === 'medium' ? '🟡 Med' : '🟢 Low';
+    lines.push(
+      `| \`${f.path}\` | ${f.component} | \`+${f.additions}/-${f.deletions}\` | ${impactIcon} | ${f.summary} |`
+    );
+  }
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(`</details>`);
+  lines.push('');
+
+  // Mermaid Sequence Diagram
+  if (config.reviews.sequence_diagrams && walkthrough.mermaidDiagram) {
+    lines.push(`<details open>`);
+    lines.push(`<summary><strong>🔄 Sequence Diagram</strong></summary>`);
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push('```mermaid');
+    lines.push(walkthrough.mermaidDiagram.trim());
+    lines.push('```');
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push(`</details>`);
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  // Security callout if any
+  if (walkthrough.securityConcerns && walkthrough.securityConcerns.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(`> [!WARNING]`);
+    lines.push(`> **Security Advisories Detected**`);
+    for (const sec of walkthrough.securityConcerns) {
+      lines.push(`> - ${sec}`);
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  // Poem
+  if (config.reviews.poem && walkthrough.poem) {
+    lines.push(`### 🥕 Poem`);
+    for (const poemLine of walkthrough.poem.split('\n')) {
+      lines.push(`> ${poemLine}`);
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  lines.push(`---`);
+  lines.push(
+    `<sub>💬 **Tip:** Mention \`@openrabbit explain\`, \`@openrabbit test\`, \`@openrabbit fix\`, or ask any question in a review comment! Configured via \`.openrabbit.yaml\`.</sub>`
+  );
+
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats an individual inline finding as a GitHub/GitLab PR review comment
+ * with a one-click committable suggestion block.
+ */
+export function formatInlineCommentMarkdown(
+  finding: InlineFinding,
+  platform: 'github' | 'gitlab' = 'github'
+): string {
+  const sev = SEVERITY_BADGES[finding.severity] || SEVERITY_BADGES.suggestion;
+  const lines: string[] = [];
+
+  lines.push(
+    `${sev.icon} **${sev.label}** · \`[${finding.category}]\` — **${finding.title}**`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(finding.body);
+
+  if (finding.suggestionCode && finding.suggestionCode.trim().length > 0) {
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push('**📝 Committable Suggestion:**');
+    if (platform === 'gitlab') {
+      lines.push('```suggestion:-0+0');
+    } else {
+      lines.push('```suggestion');
+    }
+    lines.push(finding.suggestionCode);
+    lines.push('```');
+  }
+
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(
+    `<sub>🤖 *OpenRabbit${
+      finding.ruleMatched ? ` · Rule \`${finding.ruleMatched}\`` : ''
+    } · Reply \`@openrabbit explain\` or \`@openrabbit test\`*</sub>`
+  );
+
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}

+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  getMatchingPathInstructions,
+  shouldReviewFile,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import type {
+  FileDiff,
+  InlineFinding,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+  PRWalkthrough,
+  ReviewResult,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+import { formatAnnotatedFileDiff, parseUnifiedDiff } from './diff-parser.js';
+import {
+  buildHeuristicWalkthrough,
+  runHeuristicInlineReview,
+} from './heuristic-analyzer.js';
+import {
+  generateLLMCompletion,
+  resolveActiveProvider,
+} from './llm-provider.js';
+import { formatWalkthroughMarkdown } from './markdown-formatter.js';
+
+export interface RunReviewOptions {
+  rawDiff: string;
+  prTitle?: string;
+  repository?: string;
+  prNumber?: number;
+  author?: string;
+  baseBranch?: string;
+  headBranch?: string;
+  commitSha?: string;
+  source?: 'cli' | 'github' | 'gitlab' | 'playground';
+  config?: OpenRabbitConfig;
+}
+
+export async function runPullRequestReview(
+  options: RunReviewOptions
+): Promise<ReviewResult> {
+  const startTime = Date.now();
+  const config = options.config || DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG;
+  const prTitle = options.prTitle || 'Pull Request Changes';
+  const repository = options.repository || 'local/repository';
+  const source = options.source || 'cli';
+
+  const parsed = parseUnifiedDiff(options.rawDiff);
+
+  // Filter files according to `.openrabbit.yaml` path_filters
+  const filteredFiles = parsed.files.filter((f) =>
+    shouldReviewFile(f.newPath, config.reviews.path_filters)
+  );
+
+  const activeProviderInfo = resolveActiveProvider(
+    config.llm.provider,
+    config.llm.model
+  );
+
+  // Always run deterministic heuristic rules first for high-precision security & async bug detection
+  let findings: InlineFinding[] = runHeuristicInlineReview(filteredFiles, config);
+  let walkthrough: PRWalkthrough = buildHeuristicWalkthrough(
+    prTitle,
+    filteredFiles,
+    findings,
+    config
+  );
+  let providerUsed: string = activeProviderInfo.provider;
+  let modelUsed: string = activeProviderInfo.model;
+
+  if (activeProviderInfo.provider !== 'heuristic' && filteredFiles.length > 0) {
+    try {
+      const llmOutput = await runLLMTwoStageReview(
+        prTitle,
+        filteredFiles,
+        config,
+        activeProviderInfo.provider,
+        activeProviderInfo.model
+      );
+      if (llmOutput.findings.length > 0) {
+        findings = mergeAndSnapFindings(
+          findings,
+          llmOutput.findings,
+          filteredFiles,
+          config
+        );
+      }
+      walkthrough = {
+        ...walkthrough,
+        ...llmOutput.walkthrough,
+        fileSummaries:
+          llmOutput.walkthrough.fileSummaries &&
+          llmOutput.walkthrough.fileSummaries.length > 0
+            ? llmOutput.walkthrough.fileSummaries
+            : walkthrough.fileSummaries,
+        mermaidDiagram:
+          llmOutput.walkthrough.mermaidDiagram || walkthrough.mermaidDiagram,
+        poem: config.reviews.poem
+          ? llmOutput.walkthrough.poem || walkthrough.poem
+          : '',
+      };
+      providerUsed = llmOutput.provider;
+      modelUsed = llmOutput.model;
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn(
+        `[OpenRabbit] External LLM provider (${activeProviderInfo.provider}) unavailable, falling back to built-in AST/Heuristic engine:`,
+        (err as Error).message
+      );
+      providerUsed = 'heuristic';
+      modelUsed = 'openrabbit-ast-v1 (fallback)';
+    }
+  }
+
+  const durationMs = Math.max(12, Date.now() - startTime);
+
+  const markdownWalkthrough = formatWalkthroughMarkdown(
+    walkthrough,
+    findings,
+    config,
+    {
+      provider: providerUsed,
+      model: modelUsed,
+      durationMs,
+    }
+  );
+
+  const criticalCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical').length;
+  const warningCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'warning').length;
+  const suggestionCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'suggestion').length;
+  const nitpickCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'nitpick').length;
+  const praiseCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'praise').length;
+
+  return {
+    id: `rev-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    source,
+    repository,
+    prNumber: options.prNumber,
+    prTitle,
+    author: options.author || 'developer',
+    baseBranch: options.baseBranch || 'main',
+    headBranch: options.headBranch || 'feat/branch',
+    commitSha: options.commitSha || crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex'),
+    providerUsed,
+    modelUsed,
+    durationMs,
+    stats: {
+      filesReviewed: filteredFiles.length,
+      additions: filteredFiles.reduce((s, f) => s + f.additions, 0),
+      deletions: filteredFiles.reduce((s, f) => s + f.deletions, 0),
+      findingsCount: findings.length,
+      criticalCount,
+      warningCount,
+      suggestionCount,
+      nitpickCount,
+      praiseCount,
+    },
+    walkthrough,
+    findings,
+    markdownWalkthrough,
+    rawDiff: options.rawDiff,
+  };
+}
+
+async function runLLMTwoStageReview(
+  prTitle: string,
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  provider: Exclude<OpenRabbitConfig['llm']['provider'], 'auto'>,
+  model: string
+): Promise<{
+  walkthrough: Partial<PRWalkthrough>;
+  findings: InlineFinding[];
+  provider: string;
+  model: string;
+}> {
+  const annotatedFiles = files.map((file) => {
+    const matchedRules = getMatchingPathInstructions(
+      file.newPath,
+      config.reviews.path_instructions
+    );
+    const rulesText =
+      matchedRules.length > 0
+        ? `\nPath-Specific Instructions for \`${file.newPath}\`:\n` +
+          matchedRules.map((r) => `- (${r.path}): ${r.instructions}`).join('\n')
+        : '';
+    return formatAnnotatedFileDiff(file) + rulesText;
+  });
+
+  const systemPrompt = `You are OpenRabbit, an elite open-source AI code reviewer modeled after the best practices of CodeRabbit.
+Profile mode: ${config.profile.toUpperCase()}
+Tone instructions: ${config.tone_instructions}
+Language: ${config.language}
+
+Respond ONLY with a valid JSON object matching this exact schema:
+{
+  "executiveSummary": "Concise 2-3 sentence overview of the PR changes and key risks",
+  "effortScore": 3,
+  "estimatedMinutes": 5,
+  "riskLevel": "low" | "moderate" | "high" | "critical",
+  "mermaidDiagram": "sequenceDiagram\\n  autonumber\\n  ...",
+  "poem": "4-line rabbit-themed poem about the code changes",
+  "findings": [
+    {
+      "file": "exact file path from diff",
+      "startLine": 12,
+      "endLine": 12,
+      "severity": "critical" | "warning" | "suggestion" | "nitpick" | "praise",
+      "category": "security" | "bug" | "performance" | "maintainability" | "type-safety" | "logic",
+      "title": "Short actionable title",
+      "body": "Clear explanation of the bug or improvement",
+      "suggestionCode": "Exact replacement code for the line(s) without surrounding backticks"
+    }
+  ]
+}`;
+
+  const userPrompt = `Pull Request Title: ${prTitle}\n\nAnnotated Unified Diff:\n\n${annotatedFiles.join(
+    '\n\n---\n\n'
+  )}`;
+
+  const res = await generateLLMCompletion({
+    systemPrompt,
+    userPrompt,
+    temperature: config.llm.temperature,
+    jsonMode: true,
+    preferredProvider: provider,
+    preferredModel: model,
+  });
+
+  const cleaned = res.content
+    .replace(/^```json\s*/i, '')
+    .replace(/```\s*$/i, '')
+    .trim();
+  const parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned);
+
+  const llmFindings: InlineFinding[] = (parsed.findings || []).map((f: any) => ({
+    id: `finding-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+    file: String(f.file || files[0]?.newPath || ''),
+    startLine: Number(f.startLine) || 1,
+    endLine: Number(f.endLine || f.startLine) || 1,
+    severity: f.severity || 'suggestion',
+    category: f.category || 'bug',
+    title: String(f.title || 'Code Review Finding'),
+    body: String(f.body || ''),
+    suggestionCode: f.suggestionCode ? String(f.suggestionCode) : undefined,
+  }));
+
+  return {
+    walkthrough: {
+      executiveSummary: parsed.executiveSummary,
+      effortScore: parsed.effortScore,
+      estimatedMinutes: parsed.estimatedMinutes,
+      riskLevel: parsed.riskLevel,
+      mermaidDiagram: parsed.mermaidDiagram,
+      poem: parsed.poem,
+    },
+    findings: llmFindings,
+    provider: res.provider,
+    model: res.model,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Ensures all findings reference valid line numbers present in the diff hunks
+ * and deduplicates overlapping findings on the same file & line.
+ */
+function mergeAndSnapFindings(
+  heuristicFindings: InlineFinding[],
+  llmFindings: InlineFinding[],
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig
+): InlineFinding[] {
+  const combined = [...heuristicFindings.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'praise')];
+  const existingKeys = new Set(
+    combined.map((f) => `${f.file}:${f.startLine}`)
+  );
+
+  for (const lf of llmFindings) {
+    if (config.profile === 'chill' && lf.severity === 'nitpick') continue;
+    const fileObj = files.find((f) => f.newPath === lf.file) || files[0];
+    if (!fileObj) continue;
+
+    // Snap line number to nearest valid newLineNumber in file hunks
+    const validLines: number[] = [];
+    for (const h of fileObj.hunks) {
+      for (const l of h.lines) {
+        if (l.newLineNumber !== undefined) validLines.push(l.newLineNumber);
+      }
+    }
+    let snappedLine = lf.startLine;
+    if (validLines.length > 0 && !validLines.includes(snappedLine)) {
+      snappedLine = validLines.reduce((prev, curr) =>
+        Math.abs(curr - lf.startLine) < Math.abs(prev - lf.startLine) ? curr : prev
+      );
+    }
+
+    const key = `${fileObj.newPath}:${snappedLine}`;
+    if (!existingKeys.has(key)) {
+      existingKeys.add(key);
+      combined.push({
+        ...lf,
+        file: fileObj.newPath,
+        startLine: snappedLine,
+        endLine: Math.max(snappedLine, lf.endLine),
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  return combined;
+}

+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  parseYamlConfig,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import {
+  formatInlineCommentMarkdown,
+  WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER,
+} from '../core/markdown-formatter.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import type {
+  InlineFinding,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+  ReviewResult,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+
+export function verifyGitHubWebhookSignature(
+  rawBody: string,
+  signatureHeader: string | undefined,
+  secret: string | undefined
+): boolean {
+  if (!secret) return true; // No secret configured => allow in local/dev mode
+  if (!signatureHeader || !signatureHeader.startsWith('sha256=')) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  const expected =
+    'sha256=' +
+    crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody, 'utf8').digest('hex');
+
+  const sigBuf = Buffer.from(signatureHeader);
+  const expBuf = Buffer.from(expected);
+  if (sigBuf.length !== expBuf.length) return false;
+  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(sigBuf, expBuf);
+}
+
+export async function fetchGitHubPRDiff(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  pullNumber: number,
+  token?: string
+): Promise<string> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github.v3.diff',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
+
+  const res = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/pulls/${pullNumber}`,
+    { headers }
+  );
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch GitHub PR diff (${res.status}): ${await res.text()}`);
+  }
+  return await res.text();
+}
+
+export async function fetchGitHubRepoConfig(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  ref: string,
+  token?: string
+): Promise<OpenRabbitConfig> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github.v3.raw',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
+
+  for (const filename of ['.openrabbit.yaml', '.openrabbit.yml', '.coderabbit.yaml']) {
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch(
+        `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/contents/${filename}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(
+          ref
+        )}`,
+        { headers }
+      );
+      if (res.ok) {
+        const rawYaml = await res.text();
+        return parseYamlConfig(rawYaml);
+      }
+    } catch {
+      // Ignore and try next
+    }
+  }
+  return structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG);
+}
+
+export async function upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  pullNumber: number,
+  markdownBody: string,
+  token: string
+): Promise<{ commentId: number; updated: boolean }> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+
+  // Check if a sticky walkthrough comment already exists
+  const listRes = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${pullNumber}/comments?per_page=100`,
+    { headers }
+  );
+  if (listRes.ok) {
+    const comments = (await listRes.json()) as any[];
+    const existing = comments.find(
+      (c) => typeof c.body === 'string' && c.body.includes(WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER)
+    );
+    if (existing) {
+      const patchRes = await fetch(
+        `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/comments/${existing.id}`,
+        {
+          method: 'PATCH',
+          headers,
+          body: JSON.stringify({ body: markdownBody }),
+        }
+      );
+      if (!patchRes.ok) {
+        throw new Error(`Failed to update walkthrough comment (${patchRes.status})`);
+      }
+      return { commentId: existing.id, updated: true };
+    }
+  }
+
+  const createRes = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${pullNumber}/comments`,
+    {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify({ body: markdownBody }),
+    }
+  );
+  if (!createRes.ok) {
+    throw new Error(`Failed to post walkthrough comment (${createRes.status})`);
+  }
+  const created = (await createRes.json()) as any;
+  return { commentId: created.id, updated: false };
+}
+
+export async function postGitHubInlineReview(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  pullNumber: number,
+  commitSha: string,
+  findings: InlineFinding[],
+  token: string
+): Promise<{ reviewId: number; commentsPosted: number }> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+
+  const inlineComments = findings.map((f) => ({
+    path: f.file,
+    line: f.endLine || f.startLine || 1,
+     ...(f.startLine && f.endLine && f.startLine < f.endLine
+      ? { start_line: f.startLine, start_side: 'RIGHT' }
+      : {}),
+    side: 'RIGHT',
+    body: formatInlineCommentMarkdown(f, 'github'),
+  }));
+
+  const res = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/pulls/${pullNumber}/reviews`,
+    {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        commit_id: commitSha,
+        event: 'COMMENT',
+        body: `🐇 **OpenRabbit** completed an inline code review with **${inlineComments.length}** comment(s).`,
+        comments: inlineComments,
+      }),
+    }
+  );
+
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    throw new Error(
+      `Failed to post GitHub inline review (${res.status}): ${await res.text()}`
+    );
+  }
+  const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+  return {
+    reviewId: data.id,
+    commentsPosted: inlineComments.length,
+  };
+}
+
+export interface GitHubWebhookResult {
+  handled: boolean;
+  action: string;
+  reviewResult?: ReviewResult;
+  chatReply?: string;
+  postedToGitHub: boolean;
+}
+
+export async function handleGitHubWebhookEvent(
+  eventName: string,
+  payload: any,
+  fallbackConfig: OpenRabbitConfig = DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG
+): Promise<GitHubWebhookResult> {
+  const token = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
+
+  // 1. Handle Pull Request opened / synchronize / reopened
+  if (eventName === 'pull_request') {
+    const action = payload.action;
+    if (!['opened', 'synchronize', 'reopened', 'ready_for_review'].includes(action)) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: `Ignored pull_request.${action}`,
+        postedToGitHub: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const pr = payload.pull_request || {};
+    const repoFull = payload.repository?.full_name || 'org/repo';
+    const [owner, repo] = repoFull.split('/');
+    const pullNumber = Number(pr.number || payload.number || 1);
+    const prTitle = pr.title || 'Pull Request';
+    const commitSha = pr.head?.sha || 'HEAD';
+    const baseBranch = pr.base?.ref || 'main';
+    const headBranch = pr.head?.ref || 'feat/update';
+    const author = pr.user?.login || 'developer';
+
+    if (pr.draft && !fallbackConfig.reviews.auto_review.drafts) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: 'Skipped draft PR (reviews.auto_review.drafts is false)',
+        postedToGitHub: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    let rawDiff = payload.simulated_diff || '';
+    let config = fallbackConfig;
+
+    if (!rawDiff && owner && repo) {
+      rawDiff = await fetchGitHubPRDiff(owner, repo, pullNumber, token);
+      if (token) {
+        config = await fetchGitHubRepoConfig(owner, repo, commitSha, token);
+      }
+    }
+
+    const reviewResult = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff,
+      prTitle,
+      repository: repoFull,
+      prNumber: pullNumber,
+      author,
+      baseBranch,
+      headBranch,
+      commitSha,
+      source: 'github',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    let postedToGitHub = false;
+    if (token && !payload.simulated_diff && owner && repo) {
+      await upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+        owner,
+        repo,
+        pullNumber,
+        reviewResult.markdownWalkthrough,
+        token
+      );
+      if (reviewResult.findings.length > 0) {
+        await postGitHubInlineReview(
+          owner,
+          repo,
+          pullNumber,
+          commitSha,
+          reviewResult.findings,
+          token
+        );
+      }
+      postedToGitHub = true;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Reviewed PR #${pullNumber} (${action})`,
+      reviewResult,
+      postedToGitHub,
+    };
+  }
+
+  // 2. Handle @openrabbit interactive comments on PRs
+  if (
+    eventName === 'issue_comment' ||
+    eventName === 'pull_request_review_comment'
+  ) {
+    const commentBody: string = payload.comment?.body || '';
+    if (
+      !/(@openrabbit|@coderabbitai)\b/i.test(commentBody) ||
+      payload.action !== 'created'
+    ) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: 'Comment did not mention @openrabbit',
+        postedToGitHub: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const chatRes = await handlePRChat(
+      {
+        query: commentBody,
+        file: payload.comment?.path,
+        line: payload.comment?.line || payload.comment?.original_line,
+        diff: payload.comment?.diff_hunk || payload.simulated_diff,
+        prTitle: payload.issue?.title || payload.pull_request?.title,
+      },
+      fallbackConfig
+    );
+
+    let postedToGitHub = false;
+    const repoFull = payload.repository?.full_name || '';
+    const [owner, repo] = repoFull.split('/');
+    const issueNumber = payload.issue?.number || payload.pull_request?.number;
+
+    if (token && !payload.simulated_diff && owner && repo && issueNumber) {
+      const apiUrl = (
+        process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com'
+      ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+      await fetch(`${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${issueNumber}/comments`, {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: {
+          Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+          'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+        },
+        body: JSON.stringify({ body: chatRes.replyMarkdown }),
+      });
+      postedToGitHub = true;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Processed @openrabbit ${chatRes.commandDetected} command`,
+      chatReply: chatRes.replyMarkdown,
+      postedToGitHub,
+    };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    handled: false,
+    action: `Unsupported GitHub event: ${eventName}`,
+    postedToGitHub: false,
+  };
+}

+import { DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG } from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import {
+  formatInlineCommentMarkdown,
+  WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER,
+} from '../core/markdown-formatter.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import type { OpenRabbitConfig, ReviewResult } from '../types/index.js';
+
+export function verifyGitLabWebhookToken(
+  headerToken: string | undefined,
+  secret: string | undefined
+): boolean {
+  if (!secret) return true;
+  return headerToken === secret;
+}
+
+export async function fetchGitLabMRDiff(
+  projectId: string | number,
+  mrIid: number,
+  token?: string
+): Promise<string> {
+  const apiUrl = (
+    process.env.GITLAB_API_URL || 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4'
+  ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
+  if (token) headers['PRIVATE-TOKEN'] = token;
+
+  const res = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
+      String(projectId)
+    )}/merge_requests/${mrIid}/changes`,
+    { headers }
+  );
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch GitLab MR changes (${res.status})`);
+  }
+  const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+  const changes: any[] = data.changes || [];
+
+  return changes
+    .map(
+      (c) =>
+        `diff --git a/${c.old_path} b/${c.new_path}\n--- a/${c.old_path}\n+++ b/${c.new_path}\n${c.diff}`
+    )
+    .join('\n');
+}
+
+export interface GitLabWebhookResult {
+  handled: boolean;
+  action: string;
+  reviewResult?: ReviewResult;
+  chatReply?: string;
+  postedToGitLab: boolean;
+}
+
+export async function handleGitLabWebhookEvent(
+  eventHeader: string,
+  payload: any,
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig = DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG
+): Promise<GitLabWebhookResult> {
+  const token = process.env.GITLAB_TOKEN;
+  const objectKind = payload.object_kind;
+
+  if (
+    objectKind === 'merge_request' ||
+    eventHeader === 'Merge Request Hook'
+  ) {
+    const attrs = payload.object_attributes || {};
+    const action = attrs.action || 'open';
+    if (!['open', 'reopen', 'update'].includes(action)) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: `Ignored GitLab MR action: ${action}`,
+        postedToGitLab: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const projectId = payload.project?.id || '1';
+    const repoName = payload.project?.path_with_namespace || 'gitlab-org/project';
+    const mrIid = Number(attrs.iid || 1);
+    const prTitle = attrs.title || 'Merge Request';
+    const baseBranch = attrs.target_branch || 'main';
+    const headBranch = attrs.source_branch || 'feat/branch';
+    const commitSha = attrs.last_commit?.id || 'HEAD';
+    const author = payload.user?.username || 'developer';
+
+    let rawDiff = payload.simulated_diff || '';
+    if (!rawDiff) {
+      rawDiff = await fetchGitLabMRDiff(projectId, mrIid, token);
+    }
+
+    const reviewResult = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff,
+      prTitle,
+      repository: repoName,
+      prNumber: mrIid,
+      author,
+      baseBranch,
+      headBranch,
+      commitSha,
+      source: 'gitlab',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    let postedToGitLab = false;
+    if (token && !payload.simulated_diff) {
+      const apiUrl = (
+        process.env.GITLAB_API_URL || 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4'
+      ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+      const headers = {
+        'PRIVATE-TOKEN': token,
+        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+      };
+
+      // Post Walkthrough Note
+      await fetch(
+        `${apiUrl}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
+          String(projectId)
+        )}/merge_requests/${mrIid}/notes`,
+        {
+          method: 'POST',
+          headers,
+          body: JSON.stringify({
+            body:
+              reviewResult.markdownWalkthrough +
+              '\n\n' +
+              reviewResult.findings
+                .map(
+                  (f) =>
+                    `#### \`${f.file}:${f.startLine}\`\n` +
+                    formatInlineCommentMarkdown(f, 'gitlab')
+                )
+                .join('\n\n---\n\n'),
+          }),
+        }
+      );
+      postedToGitLab = true;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Reviewed GitLab MR !${mrIid} (${action})`,
+      reviewResult,
+      postedToGitLab,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (objectKind === 'note' || eventHeader === 'Note Hook') {
+    const noteBody: string = payload.object_attributes?.note || '';
+    if (!/@openrabbit\b/i.test(noteBody)) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: 'Note did not mention @openrabbit',
+        postedToGitLab: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const chatRes = await handlePRChat(
+      {
+        query: noteBody,
+        prTitle: payload.merge_request?.title,
+        diff: payload.simulated_diff,
+      },
+      config
+    );
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Processed GitLab @openrabbit ${chatRes.commandDetected} command`,
+      chatReply: chatRes.replyMarkdown,
+      postedToGitLab: false,
+    };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    handled: false,
+    action: `Unsupported GitLab event: ${eventHeader || objectKind}`,
+    postedToGitLab: false,
+  };
+}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import http from 'node:http';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import {
+  loadConfig,
+  mergeConfig,
+  parseYamlConfig,
+  serializeConfigToYaml,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import { parseUnifiedDiff } from '../core/diff-parser.js';
+import { getLocalGitDiff } from '../core/git-utils.js';
+import {
+  getProvidersStatus,
+  resolveActiveProvider,
+} from '../core/llm-provider.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import {
+  handleGitHubWebhookEvent,
+  verifyGitHubWebhookSignature,
+} from '../integrations/github.js';
+import {
+  handleGitLabWebhookEvent,
+  verifyGitLabWebhookToken,
+} from '../integrations/gitlab.js';
+import {
+  ReviewStore,
+  SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES,
+} from '../storage/review-store.js';
+
+const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
+const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
+
+export interface ServerInstance {
+  server: http.Server;
+  store: ReviewStore;
+  port: number;
+  close: () => Promise<void>;
+}
+
+function readBody(req: http.IncomingMessage): Promise<string> {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
+    req.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk)));
+    req.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')));
+    req.on('error', reject);
+  });
+}
+
+function sendJson(
+  res: http.ServerResponse,
+  status: number,
+  payload: unknown
+): void {
+  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
+  res.writeHead(status, {
+    'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
+    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
+    'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS',
+    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':
+      'Content-Type, X-GitHub-Event, X-Hub-Signature-256, X-Gitlab-Event, X-Gitlab-Token',
+  });
+  res.end(body);
+}
+
+const MIME_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
+  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
+  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
+  '.js': 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8',
+  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
+  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
+  '.ico': 'image/x-icon',
+};
+
+export async function createOpenRabbitServer(options: {
+  port?: number;
+  workspaceDir?: string;
+  storageDir?: string;
+} = {}): Promise<ServerInstance> {
+  const workspaceDir = options.workspaceDir || process.cwd();
+  const store = new ReviewStore(
+    options.storageDir || path.join(workspaceDir, 'data')
+  );
+  await store.init();
+
+  const publicDirCandidates = [
+    path.join(workspaceDir, 'public'),
+    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../public'),
+  ];
+  const publicDir =
+    publicDirCandidates.find((d) => fs.existsSync(d)) || publicDirCandidates[0];
+
+  const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
+    try {
+      if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
+        res.writeHead(204, {
+          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
+          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS',
+          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':
+            'Content-Type, X-GitHub-Event, X-Hub-Signature-256, X-Gitlab-Event, X-Gitlab-Token',
+        });
+        res.end();
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const url = new URL(req.url || '/', `http://${req.headers.host || 'localhost'}`);
+      const pathname = url.pathname;
+
+      // ======================================================================
+      // API Routes
+      // ======================================================================
+      if (pathname === '/api/status' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const { config, configPath } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const activeProvider = resolveActiveProvider(
+          config.llm.provider,
+          config.llm.model
+        );
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+        sendJson(res, 200, {
+          version: '1.0.0',
+          activeProvider,
+          providers: getProvidersStatus(),
+          config,
+          configPath,
+          yamlConfig: serializeConfigToYaml(config),
+          analytics,
+          webhooks: {
+            githubConfigured: Boolean(process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN),
+            gitlabConfigured: Boolean(process.env.GITLAB_TOKEN),
+          },
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/templates' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        sendJson(res, 200, { templates: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/reviews' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const reviews = await store.listReviews();
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+        sendJson(res, 200, { reviews, analytics });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname.startsWith('/api/reviews/') && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const id = pathname.slice('/api/reviews/'.length);
+        const review = await store.getReviewById(id);
+        if (!review) {
+          sendJson(res, 404, { error: 'Review not found' });
+          return;
+        }
+        const parsedDiff = review.rawDiff
+          ? parseUnifiedDiff(review.rawDiff)
+          : { files: [], totalAdditions: 0, totalDeletions: 0, totalFiles: 0 };
+        sendJson(res, 200, { review, parsedDiff });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/review' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const diff = String(body.diff || '');
+        if (!diff.trim()) {
+          sendJson(res, 400, { error: 'Diff content is required.' });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const { config: baseConfig } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        let effectiveConfig = structuredClone(baseConfig);
+        if (body.yamlConfig && typeof body.yamlConfig === 'string') {
+          effectiveConfig = parseYamlConfig(body.yamlConfig);
+        }
+        if (body.profile) {
+          effectiveConfig.profile = body.profile;
+        }
+        if (body.provider) {
+          effectiveConfig.llm.provider = body.provider;
+        }
+        if (body.model) {
+          effectiveConfig.llm.model = body.model;
+        }
+
+        const review = await runPullRequestReview({
+          rawDiff: diff,
+          prTitle: body.prTitle || 'Interactive PR Review',
+          repository: body.repository || 'local/playground',
+          prNumber: body.prNumber ? Number(body.prNumber) : undefined,
+          author: body.author || 'developer',
+          source: body.source || 'playground',
+          config: effectiveConfig,
+        });
+
+        await store.addReview(review);
+        const parsedDiff = parseUnifiedDiff(diff);
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, { review, parsedDiff, analytics });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/review/local' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const localInfo = getLocalGitDiff({
+          cwd: workspaceDir,
+          staged: Boolean(body.staged),
+          baseBranch: body.baseBranch,
+        });
+
+        if (!localInfo.diff.trim()) {
+          sendJson(res, 200, {
+            empty: true,
+            message:
+              'No uncommitted git changes or commits found in the local repository. Try loading one of the sample PR diffs or modifying a file!',
+          });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const review = await runPullRequestReview({
+          rawDiff: localInfo.diff,
+          prTitle: `Local Review: ${localInfo.description} (${localInfo.branch})`,
+          repository: localInfo.repoName,
+          author: localInfo.author,
+          headBranch: localInfo.branch,
+          source: 'cli',
+          config,
+        });
+
+        await store.addReview(review);
+        const parsedDiff = parseUnifiedDiff(localInfo.diff);
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, { review, parsedDiff, analytics, localInfo });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/chat' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        if (body.provider) {
+          config.llm.provider = body.provider;
+        }
+
+        const chatResponse = await handlePRChat(
+          {
+            query: String(body.query || '@openrabbit explain'),
+            diff: body.diff,
+            file: body.file,
+            line: body.line,
+            findingContext: body.findingContext,
+            prTitle: body.prTitle,
+          },
+          config
+        );
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, chatResponse);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/config' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const { config, configPath } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        sendJson(res, 200, {
+          config,
+          configPath,
+          yaml: serializeConfigToYaml(config),
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/config' && req.method === 'PUT') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config: currentConfig } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+
+        const updatedConfig = body.yaml
+          ? parseYamlConfig(String(body.yaml))
+          : mergeConfig(currentConfig, body.config || {});
+
+        const targetPath = path.join(workspaceDir, '.openrabbit.yaml');
+        const yamlString = serializeConfigToYaml(updatedConfig);
+        fs.writeFileSync(targetPath, yamlString, 'utf8');
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, {
+          saved: true,
+          configPath: targetPath,
+          config: updatedConfig,
+          yaml: yamlString,
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      // ======================================================================
+      // GitHub & GitLab Webhook Endpoints
+      // ======================================================================
+      if (pathname === '/api/webhooks/github' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const sigHeader = req.headers['x-hub-signature-256'] as
+          | string
+          | undefined;
+        const eventName =
+          (req.headers['x-github-event'] as string) || 'pull_request';
+
+        if (
+          !verifyGitHubWebhookSignature(
+            rawBody,
+            sigHeader,
+            process.env.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
+          )
+        ) {
+          sendJson(res, 401, { error: 'Invalid GitHub webhook signature' });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const result = await handleGitHubWebhookEvent(eventName, payload, config);
+        if (result.reviewResult) {
+          await store.addReview(result.reviewResult);
+        }
+        sendJson(res, 200, result);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/webhooks/gitlab' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const tokenHeader = req.headers['x-gitlab-token'] as string | undefined;
+        const eventHeader =
+          (req.headers['x-gitlab-event'] as string) || 'Merge Request Hook';
+
+        if (
+          !verifyGitLabWebhookToken(
+            tokenHeader,
+            process.env.GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
+          )
+        ) {
+          sendJson(res, 401, { error: 'Invalid GitLab webhook token' });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const result = await handleGitLabWebhookEvent(
+          eventHeader,
+          payload,
+          config
+        );
+        if (result.reviewResult) {
+          await store.addReview(result.reviewResult);
+        }
+        sendJson(res, 200, result);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      // ======================================================================
+      // Static Files (Web Dashboard & Interactive Playground)
+      // ======================================================================
+      const safePath = pathname === '/' ? '/index.html' : pathname;
+      const resolvedFile = path.join(publicDir, path.normalize(safePath));
+      if (
+        resolvedFile.startsWith(publicDir) &&
+        fs.existsSync(resolvedFile) &&
+        fs.statSync(resolvedFile).isFile()
+      ) {
+        const ext = path.extname(resolvedFile).toLowerCase();
+        const contentType = MIME_TYPES[ext] || 'application/octet-stream';
+        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': contentType });
+        fs.createReadStream(resolvedFile).pipe(res);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      sendJson(res, 404, { error: `Not found: ${pathname}` });
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('[OpenRabbit Server Error]', err);
+      sendJson(res, 500, {
+        error: (err as Error).message || 'Internal Server Error',
+      });
+    }
+  });
+
+  const requestedPort =
+    options.port !== undefined
+      ? options.port
+      : Number(process.env.PORT || 3847);
+
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    server.on('error', reject);
+    server.listen(requestedPort, () => {
+      const addr = server.address();
+      const actualPort =
+        typeof addr === 'object' && addr ? addr.port : requestedPort;
+      resolve({
+        server,
+        store,
+        port: actualPort,
+        close: () =>
+          new Promise<void>((resClose, rejClose) =>
+            server.close((e) => (e ? rejClose(e) : resClose()))
+          ),
+      });
+    });
+  });
+}

+export class ReviewStore {

+    this.reviews = seeded;

+    return this.reviews.find((r) => r.id === id);

+  public async addReview(review: ReviewResult): Promise<ReviewResult> {
+    await this.init();
+    this.reviews.unshift(review);

+      this.reviews = this.reviews.slice(0, 100);
+    }
+    this.persist();
+    return review;
+  }
+
+  public async getAnalyticsSummary() {
+    await this.init();
+    const totalReviews = this.reviews.length;
+    const totalFiles = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.filesReviewed,
+      0
+    );
+    const totalFindings = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.findingsCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const criticalCaught = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.criticalCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const warningsCaught = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.warningCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const suggestionsMade = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.suggestionCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const avgDurationMs =
+      totalReviews > 0
+        ? Math.round(
+            this.reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.durationMs, 0) / totalReviews
+          )
+        : 0;
+
+    const categoryBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
+    for (const r of this.reviews) {
+      for (const f of r.findings) {

+      }
+    }
+
+    return {
+      totalReviews,
+      totalFiles,
+      totalFindings,
+      criticalCaught,
+      warningsCaught,
+      suggestionsMade,
+      avgDurationMs,
+      estimatedHoursSaved: +(totalReviews * 0.45 + totalFindings * 0.15).toFixed(1),
+      categoryBreakdown,
+    };
+  }

+  private persist(): void {
+    try {
+      fs.writeFileSync(
+        this.filePath,
+        JSON.stringify(this.reviews, null, 2),
+        'utf8'
+      );
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn('[OpenRabbit] Failed to persist reviews:', err);
+    }
+  }

+export type ReviewProfile = 'chill' | 'assertive' | 'security-focused';
+
+export type ReviewSeverity =
+  | 'critical'
+  | 'warning'
+  | 'suggestion'
+  | 'nitpick'
+  | 'praise';
+
+export type ReviewCategory =
+  | 'security'
+  | 'bug'
+  | 'performance'
+  | 'maintainability'
+  | 'type-safety'
+  | 'logic'
+  | 'architecture'
+  | 'testing';
+
+export interface PathInstruction {

+  language: string;
+  profile: ReviewProfile;

+  llm: {

+    temperature: number;
+  };
+}
+
+export interface DiffLine {

+  content: string;
+  oldLineNumber?: number;
+  newLineNumber?: number;
+}
+
+export interface DiffHunk {
+  header: string;
+  oldStart: number;

+  newStart: number;
+  newLines: number;

+
+export interface FileDiff {

+  newPath: string;
+  status: 'added' | 'modified' | 'deleted' | 'renamed';
+  language: string;
+  additions: number;
+  deletions: number;

+export interface ParsedDiff {

+  totalFiles: number;
+}
+
+export interface FileWalkthroughSummary {
+  path: string;
+  status: 'added' | 'modified' | 'deleted' | 'renamed';
+  additions: number;
+  deletions: number;
+  component: string;
+  summary: string;
+  impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
+}
+
+export interface InlineFinding {
+  id: string;
+  file: string;
+  startLine: number;
+  endLine: number;
+  severity: ReviewSeverity;
+  category: ReviewCategory;
+  title: string;
+  body: string;
+  suggestionCode?: string;
+  originalCode?: string;
+  ruleMatched?: string;
+}
+
+export interface PRWalkthrough {
+  title: string;
+  executiveSummary: string;
+  releaseNotes: {
+    category: string;
+    items: string[];
+  }[];
+  fileSummaries: FileWalkthroughSummary[];
+  mermaidDiagram: string;
+  poem: string;
+  effortScore: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;
+  estimatedMinutes: number;
+  riskLevel: 'low' | 'moderate' | 'high' | 'critical';
+  securityConcerns: string[];
+}
+
+export interface ReviewResult {
+  id: string;
+  createdAt: string;
+  source: 'cli' | 'github' | 'gitlab' | 'playground';
+  repository: string;
+  prNumber?: number;
+  prTitle: string;
+  author?: string;
+  baseBranch?: string;
+  headBranch?: string;
+  commitSha?: string;
+  providerUsed: string;
+  modelUsed: string;
+  durationMs: number;
+  stats: {
+    filesReviewed: number;
+    additions: number;
+    deletions: number;
+    findingsCount: number;
+    criticalCount: number;
+    warningCount: number;
+    suggestionCount: number;
+    nitpickCount: number;
+    praiseCount: number;
+  };
+  walkthrough: PRWalkthrough;
+  findings: InlineFinding[];
+  markdownWalkthrough: string;
+  rawDiff?: string;
+}
+
+export type ChatCommandType =
+  | 'explain'
+  | 'test'
+  | 'fix'
+  | 'docstring'
+  | 'summary'
+  | 'config'
+  | 'resolve'
+  | 'question';
+
+export interface ChatRequest {
+  query: string;
+  diff?: string;
+  file?: string;
+  line?: number;
+  findingContext?: InlineFinding;
+  prTitle?: string;
+}
+
+export interface ChatResponse {
+  commandDetected: ChatCommandType;
+  replyMarkdown: string;
+  suggestedCode?: string;
+  providerUsed: string;
+  modelUsed: string;
+}

+name: OpenRabbit AI PR Review
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  issue_comment:
+    types: [created]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: write
+  issues: write
+
+jobs:
+  openrabbit:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.comment.body, '@openrabbit') }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout Repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Setup Node.js 22
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+          cache: 'npm'
+
+      - name: Install Dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Run OpenRabbit PR Walkthrough & Inline Review
+        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
+        run: |
+          npx tsx src/cli/index.ts review \
+            --base origin/${{ github.base_ref }} \
+            --title "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" \
+            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
+            --pr "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" \
+            --post-github "${{ github.repository }}#${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
+          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
+          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}

+# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://openrabbit.dev/schema/v1.json
+# ============================================================================
+# OpenRabbit Configuration (.openrabbit.yaml)
+# Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer & Interactive PR Companion
+# ============================================================================
+
+language: en-US
+profile: chill
+tone_instructions: Be constructive, concise, and high-signal. Prioritize real bugs, security vulnerabilities, race conditions, and performance bottlenecks over stylistic nitpicks.
+early_access: true
+reviews:
+  high_level_summary: true
+  poem: true
+  review_status: true
+  collapse_walkthrough: false
+  sequence_diagrams: true
+  auto_review:
+    enabled: true
+    drafts: false
+    base_branches:
+      - main
+      - master
+      - develop
+  path_filters:
+    - "!dist/**"
+    - "!node_modules/**"
+    - "!*.lock"
+    - "!package-lock.json"
+    - "!pnpm-lock.yaml"
+    - "!**/*.min.js"
+    - "!**/*.snap"
+  path_instructions:
+    - path: src/api/**
+      instructions: Verify authentication checks, input validation, rate limiting, and SQL/command injection safety on all endpoints.
+    - path: "**/*.tsx"
+      instructions: Check for React hook dependency array bugs, stale closures, memory leaks in useEffect, and accessibility attributes.
+    - path: tests/**
+      instructions: Ensure tests cover edge cases, error paths, and avoid brittle timing assumptions.
+chat:
+  auto_reply: true
+llm:
+  provider: auto
+  temperature: 0.2

+# 🐇 OpenRabbit
+
+**Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer, Walkthrough Generator & Interactive PR Companion**  
+*An open-source, self-hostable, multi-provider BYOK alternative to CodeRabbit.*
+
+---
+
+## ✨ Why OpenRabbit?
+
+Code reviews shouldn't require surrendering your proprietary source code to a closed SaaS or paying per-seat enterprise fees. **OpenRabbit** brings the signature capabilities developers love about CodeRabbit into a fast, transparent, open-source platform:
+
+1. **🧭 Two-Stage PR Walkthroughs**:
+   - Executive Summary & Release Notes grouped by module
+   - File-by-File Walkthrough Table with component detection & impact badges (`🟢 Low`, `🟡 Med`, `🔴 High`)
+   - Auto-generated **Mermaid Sequence Diagrams** (`sequenceDiagram`) visualizing how PR changes interact at runtime
+   - **Review Effort Score** (`1/5` to `5/5`) & Risk Assessment
+   - Configurable **Rabbit Poem** summarizing every PR 🐇🥕
+   - Updates a single sticky comment (`<!-- openrabbit-walkthrough -->`) on new commits instead of spamming your PR!
+2. **📝 Line-by-Line Inline Code Reviews with One-Click Committable Suggestions**:
+   - Pinpoints exact diff lines and emits GitHub (` ```suggestion `) and GitLab (` ```suggestion:-0+0 `) committable code blocks.
+   - Combines a built-in deterministic **Static + AST Security/Concurrency Analyzer** with **Multi-Provider LLMs**.
+3. **💬 Interactive `@openrabbit` PR Chat & Commands**:
+   - Reply in any PR or inline review thread with:
+     - `@openrabbit explain` — Deep-dive explanation of the hunk & execution flow
+     - `@openrabbit test` — Generates ready-to-run unit test suites (`Vitest`/`Jest`) for the modified functions
+     - `@openrabbit fix` — Produces a committable replacement patch
+     - `@openrabbit docstring` — Generates JSDoc/TSDoc for changed symbols
+     - `@openrabbit resolve` — Marks the review discussion resolved
+4. **🔑 Multi-Provider BYOK + 100% Private Local Mode**:
+   - **OpenAI** (`gpt-4o`, `o3-mini`, or any compatible endpoint like Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter)
+   - **Anthropic Claude** (`claude-3-7-sonnet-latest`)
+   - **Google Gemini** (`gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`)
+   - **Ollama** (`qwen2.5-coder`, `deepseek-r1`, `llama3.3` for 100% air-gapped private reviews)
+   - **Built-in Static/AST Heuristic Engine** (works immediately with zero API keys!)
+5. **⚙️ Drop-in `.openrabbit.yaml` & `.coderabbit.yaml` Compatibility**:
+   - Supports `profile: chill | assertive | security-focused`, glob `path_filters`, and per-directory `path_instructions`.
+
+---
+
+## 🏗️ Architecture
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+  subgraph Triggers["Triggers & Sources"]
+    GH["GitHub Webhook / Action"]
+    GL["GitLab MR Webhook"]
+    CLI["OpenRabbit CLI (git diff)"]
+    UI["Interactive Web Studio"]
+  end
+
+  subgraph Core["OpenRabbit Core Engine"]
+    DP["Unified Diff & Symbol Parser"]
+    CFG[".openrabbit.yaml Matcher"]
+    AST["Static & Security AST Rules"]
+    LLM["Multi-Provider LLM Router"]
+    CHAT["@openrabbit Chat Engine"]
+  end
+
+  subgraph Outputs["Outputs"]
+    WK["Sticky PR Walkthrough + Mermaid Diagram"]
+    INL["Inline Review + Committable Suggestions"]
+    DASH["Analytics & Rule Studio Dashboard"]
+  end
+
+  Triggers --> DP
+  DP --> CFG
+  CFG --> AST
+  CFG --> LLM
+  AST --> WK
+  LLM --> WK
+  AST --> INL
+  LLM --> INL
+  CHAT --> INL
+  WK --> Outputs
+  INL --> Outputs
+```
+
+---
+
+## 🚀 Quickstart
+
+### 1. Run a Terminal PR Review (`openrabbit review`)
+
+```bash
+# Install dependencies
+npm install
+
+# Run a live terminal review on a sample PR (or your local uncommitted git diff)
+npm run review -- --demo auth-jwt-sqli
+
+# Review your staged git changes
+npx tsx src/cli/index.ts review --staged
+
+# Ask @openrabbit to generate unit tests from the CLI
+npx tsx src/cli/index.ts chat "@openrabbit generate unit tests"
+```
+
+### 2. Launch the Interactive Web Dashboard & Webhook Server (`openrabbit serve`)
+
+```bash
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Then open **`http://localhost:3847`** to explore:
+- **🔎 PR Review Studio**: Paste any `git diff`, switch between curated PR scenarios, inspect the rendered **Mermaid Sequence Diagram**, click **✨ Apply Fix to Diff & Re-Verify** on committable suggestions, and chat with `@openrabbit` inline!
+- **📊 Reviews & Analytics**: Track PRs reviewed, critical vulnerabilities caught, and engineering hours saved.
+- **⚙️ `.openrabbit.yaml` Studio**: Visually configure `chill` vs `assertive` profiles, `path_instructions`, and BYOK LLM providers.
+- **🔌 Webhook Simulator**: Test GitHub (`pull_request`, `issue_comment`) and GitLab (`Merge Request Hook`) webhooks with one click.
+
+---
+
+## ⚙️ Configuration (`.openrabbit.yaml`)
+
+```yaml
+language: en-US
+profile: chill # chill | assertive | security-focused
+tone_instructions: Be constructive, concise, and high-signal.
+reviews:
+  high_level_summary: true
+  poem: true
+  sequence_diagrams: true
+  collapse_walkthrough: false
+  path_filters:
+    - "!dist/**"
+    - "!*.lock"
+  path_instructions:
+    - path: "src/api/**"
+      instructions: "Verify authentication checks, input validation, and parameterized SQL queries."
+    - path: "**/*.tsx"
+      instructions: "Check for React hook dependency bugs and memory leaks."
+chat:
+  auto_reply: true
+llm:
+  provider: auto # auto | openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama | heuristic
+  temperature: 0.2
+```
+
+---
+
+## 🧪 Running Tests & Building
+
+```bash
+# Run the automated unit & webhook integration test suite
+npm test
+
+# Compile TypeScript to dist/
+npm run build
+```
+
+## 📄 License
+
+MIT

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  loadConfig,
+  serializeConfigToYaml,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import { getLocalGitDiff } from '../core/git-utils.js';
+import { getProvidersStatus } from '../core/llm-provider.js';
+import { renderEffortBar } from '../core/markdown-formatter.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import {
+  postGitHubInlineReview,
+  upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment,
+} from '../integrations/github.js';
+import { createOpenRabbitServer } from '../server/app.js';
+import {
+  ReviewStore,
+  SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES,
+} from '../storage/review-store.js';
+import type {
+  LLMProviderType,
+  ReviewProfile,
+  ReviewResult,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+
+const ANSI = {
+  reset: '\x1b[0m',
+  bold: '\x1b[1m',
+  dim: '\x1b[2m',
+  italic: '\x1b[3m',
+  orange: '\x1b[38;5;208m',
+  green: '\x1b[32m',
+  red: '\x1b[31m',
+  yellow: '\x1b[33m',
+  cyan: '\x1b[36m',
+  magenta: '\x1b[35m',
+  blue: '\x1b[34m',
+  gray: '\x1b[90m',
+};
+
+function printBanner(): void {
+  console.log(
+    `${ANSI.orange}${ANSI.bold}
+   (\\(\\     OpenRabbit v1.0.0
+   ( -.-)   ${ANSI.reset}${ANSI.cyan}Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer & Interactive PR Companion${ANSI.reset}${ANSI.orange}${ANSI.bold}
+   o_(")(") ${ANSI.reset}${ANSI.dim}Walkthroughs · Committable Suggestions · @openrabbit Chat · Multi-LLM BYOK${ANSI.reset}\n`
+  );
+}
+
+function parseFlags(args: string[]): Record<string, string | boolean> {
+  const flags: Record<string, string | boolean> = {};
+  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
+    const arg = args[i];
+    if (arg.startsWith('--')) {
+      const key = arg.slice(2);
+      const next = args[i + 1];
+      if (next && !next.startsWith('--')) {
+        flags[key] = next;
+        i++;
+      } else {
+        flags[key] = true;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return flags;
+}
+
+export function renderTerminalReview(result: ReviewResult): string {
+  const lines: string[] = [];
+  const w = result.walkthrough;
+
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.orange}━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}🐇 OPENRABBIT PR WALKTHROUGH:${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.bold}${result.prTitle}${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.dim}Repo: ${result.repository} · Engine: ${result.providerUsed}/${result.modelUsed} · Time: ${result.durationMs}ms${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.orange}━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(`${ANSI.bold}📋 Executive Summary${ANSI.reset}`);
+  lines.push(`   ${w.executiveSummary.replace(/\*\*/g, '')}`);
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(
+    `   ${ANSI.bold}Effort:${ANSI.reset} ${renderEffortBar(w.effortScore)} (~${
+      w.estimatedMinutes
+    } min)   ${ANSI.bold}Risk:${ANSI.reset} ${
+      w.riskLevel === 'critical'
+        ? `${ANSI.red}${ANSI.bold}CRITICAL${ANSI.reset}`
+        : w.riskLevel === 'high'
+        ? `${ANSI.yellow}${ANSI.bold}HIGH${ANSI.reset}`
+        : w.riskLevel === 'moderate'
+        ? `${ANSI.yellow}MODERATE${ANSI.reset}`
+        : `${ANSI.green}LOW${ANSI.reset}`
+    }   ${ANSI.bold}Changes:${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.green}+${
+      result.stats.additions
+    }${ANSI.reset}/${ANSI.red}-${result.stats.deletions}${ANSI.reset} (${
+      result.stats.filesReviewed
+    } files)`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+
+  if (w.fileSummaries.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(`${ANSI.bold}🧭 File Changes Walkthrough${ANSI.reset}`);
+    for (const f of w.fileSummaries) {
+      const badge =
+        f.impact === 'high'
+          ? `${ANSI.red}[HIGH]${ANSI.reset}`
+          : f.impact === 'medium'
+          ? `${ANSI.yellow}[MED] ${ANSI.reset}`
+          : `${ANSI.green}[LOW] ${ANSI.reset}`;
+      lines.push(
+        `   ${badge} ${ANSI.cyan}${f.path}${ANSI.reset} (${ANSI.green}+${f.additions}${ANSI.reset}/${ANSI.red}-${f.deletions}${ANSI.reset}) — ${f.summary}`
+      );
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  lines.push(
+    `${ANSI.bold}🔎 Inline Code Review Findings (${result.findings.length})${ANSI.reset}`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+
+  for (const finding of result.findings) {
+    const sevBadge =
+      finding.severity === 'critical'
+        ? `${ANSI.red}${ANSI.bold}🛑 CRITICAL${ANSI.reset}`
+        : finding.severity === 'warning'
+        ? `${ANSI.yellow}${ANSI.bold}⚠️  WARNING${ANSI.reset}`
+        : finding.severity === 'suggestion'
+        ? `${ANSI.cyan}${ANSI.bold}💡 SUGGESTION${ANSI.reset}`
+        : finding.severity === 'praise'
+        ? `${ANSI.green}${ANSI.bold}🙌 PRAISE${ANSI.reset}`
+        : `${ANSI.gray}🧹 NITPICK${ANSI.reset}`;
+
+    lines.push(
+      `  ┌─ ${sevBadge} ${ANSI.magenta}[${finding.category}]${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.bold}${finding.title}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    lines.push(
+      `  │  ${ANSI.cyan}${finding.file}:${finding.startLine}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    lines.push(`  │  ${finding.body.replace(/\*\*/g, '')}`);
+
+    if (finding.originalCode) {
+      lines.push(`  │  ${ANSI.red}- ${finding.originalCode.trim()}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+    if (finding.suggestionCode) {
+      for (const sLine of finding.suggestionCode.split('\n')) {
+        lines.push(`  │  ${ANSI.green}+ ${sLine.trim()}${ANSI.reset}`);
+      }
+    }
+    lines.push(`  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────`);
+  }
+
+  if (w.poem) {
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push(`${ANSI.bold}🥕 Rabbit Poem${ANSI.reset}`);
+    for (const pLine of w.poem.split('\n')) {
+      lines.push(`   ${ANSI.italic}${ANSI.orange}❝ ${pLine}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  lines.push('');
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+async function runCli(): Promise<void> {
+  const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
+  const command = argv[0] && !argv[0].startsWith('--') ? argv[0] : 'help';
+  const flags = parseFlags(argv);
+
+  if (command === 'serve' || command === 'dashboard') {
+    printBanner();
+    const requestedPort = flags.port
+      ? Number(flags.port)
+      : Number(process.env.PORT || 3847);
+    const instance = await createOpenRabbitServer({ port: requestedPort });
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.green}${ANSI.bold}✔ OpenRabbit Server & Interactive Dashboard running at:${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.cyan}${ANSI.bold}http://localhost:${instance.port}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.dim}  ├─ Web Dashboard & PR Playground : http://localhost:${instance.port}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.dim}  ├─ GitHub Webhook Endpoint       : http://localhost:${instance.port}/api/webhooks/github${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.dim}  └─ GitLab Webhook Endpoint       : http://localhost:${instance.port}/api/webhooks/gitlab${ANSI.reset}\n`
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'init') {
+    printBanner();
+    const targetYaml = path.join(process.cwd(), '.openrabbit.yaml');
+    if (fs.existsSync(targetYaml) && !flags.force) {
+      console.log(
+        `${ANSI.yellow}ℹ️  .openrabbit.yaml already exists at ${targetYaml} (use --force to overwrite).${ANSI.reset}`
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    fs.writeFileSync(
+      targetYaml,
+      serializeConfigToYaml(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG),
+      'utf8'
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.green}${ANSI.bold}✔ Created .openrabbit.yaml${ANSI.reset} at ${ANSI.cyan}${targetYaml}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `  Customize ${ANSI.bold}profile${ANSI.reset} (chill | assertive | security-focused), ${ANSI.bold}path_instructions${ANSI.reset}, and ${ANSI.bold}llm.provider${ANSI.reset}.`
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'review') {
+    const format = String(flags.format || 'terminal');
+    if (format === 'terminal') printBanner();
+
+    const { config } = loadConfig(process.cwd());
+    if (typeof flags.profile === 'string') {
+      config.profile = flags.profile as ReviewProfile;
+    }
+    if (typeof flags.provider === 'string') {
+      config.llm.provider = flags.provider as LLMProviderType;
+    }
+    if (typeof flags.model === 'string') {
+      config.llm.model = flags.model;
+    }
+
+    let rawDiff = '';
+    let prTitle = String(flags.title || 'Local Pull Request Review');
+    let repository = String(flags.repo || 'local/openrabbit');
+
+    if (flags.file && typeof flags.file === 'string') {
+      rawDiff = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(flags.file), 'utf8');
+      prTitle = `Patch Review: ${path.basename(flags.file)}`;
+    } else if (flags.demo) {
+      const tplId =
+        typeof flags.demo === 'string' ? flags.demo : SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].id;
+      const tpl =
+        SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === tplId) ||
+        SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0];
+      rawDiff = tpl.diff;
+      prTitle = tpl.prTitle;
+      repository = tpl.repository;
+    } else {
+      const localGit = getLocalGitDiff({
+        staged: Boolean(flags.staged),
+        baseBranch: typeof flags.base === 'string' ? flags.base : undefined,
+      });
+      if (localGit.diff.trim()) {
+        rawDiff = localGit.diff;
+        prTitle = `Local Review: ${localGit.description}`;
+        repository = localGit.repoName;
+      } else {
+        // Fallback to demo template 1 if repo has no uncommitted changes yet
+        const tpl = SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0];
+        rawDiff = tpl.diff;
+        prTitle = `${tpl.prTitle} (Demo PR — no local uncommitted changes detected)`;
+        repository = tpl.repository;
+      }
+    }
+
+    const result = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff,
+      prTitle,
+      repository,
+      prNumber: flags.pr ? Number(flags.pr) : undefined,
+      source: 'cli',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    const store = new ReviewStore();
+    await store.addReview(result);
+
+    // Optional: post directly to a live GitHub PR if --post-github owner/repo#123 is passed
+    if (typeof flags['post-github'] === 'string' && process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN) {
+      const match = flags['post-github'].match(/^([^/]+)\/([^#]+)#(\d+)$/);
+      if (match) {
+        const [, owner, repo, prNumStr] = match;
+        const prNum = Number(prNumStr);
+        await upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+          owner,
+          repo,
+          prNum,
+          result.markdownWalkthrough,
+          process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+        );
+        if (result.findings.length > 0 && result.commitSha) {
+          await postGitHubInlineReview(
+            owner,
+            repo,
+            prNum,
+            result.commitSha,
+            result.findings,
+            process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+          );
+        }
+        console.log(
+          `${ANSI.green}✔ Posted walkthrough & inline comments to GitHub PR ${flags['post-github']}${ANSI.reset}`
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (format === 'json') {
+      console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
+    } else if (format === 'markdown') {
+      console.log(result.markdownWalkthrough);
+    } else {
+      console.log(renderTerminalReview(result));
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'chat') {
+    printBanner();
+    const query =
+      argv
+        .slice(1)
+        .filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--'))
+        .join(' ') || '@openrabbit explain';
+    const { config } = loadConfig(process.cwd());
+    const localGit = getLocalGitDiff();
+    const diff = localGit.diff.trim() || SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff;
+
+    const res = await handlePRChat({ query, diff }, config);
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.cyan}🤖 @openrabbit (${res.commandDetected} · ${res.providerUsed}/${res.modelUsed}):${ANSI.reset}\n`
+    );
+    console.log(res.replyMarkdown);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'providers') {
+    printBanner();
+    console.log(`${ANSI.bold}Configured LLM Providers (BYOK):${ANSI.reset}\n`);
+    for (const p of getProvidersStatus()) {
+      const status = p.configured
+        ? `${ANSI.green}● Ready${ANSI.reset}`
+        : `${ANSI.gray}○ Missing API Key${ANSI.reset}`;
+      console.log(
+        `  ${status}  ${ANSI.bold}${p.name}${ANSI.reset} (${ANSI.cyan}${p.id}${ANSI.reset}, default: \`${p.defaultModel}\`)`
+      );
+      console.log(`           ${ANSI.dim}${p.description}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+    console.log('');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  // Help output
+  printBanner();
+  console.log(`${ANSI.bold}Usage:${ANSI.reset}
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit review${ANSI.reset} [options]       Run AI PR walkthrough & line-by-line review
+    ${ANSI.dim}--staged${ANSI.reset}                        Review staged git changes
+    ${ANSI.dim}--base <branch>${ANSI.reset}                 Review branch diff against base (e.g. main)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--file <patch>${ANSI.reset}                  Review a specific .diff / .patch file
+    ${ANSI.dim}--demo [id]${ANSI.reset}                     Run against a sample PR diff (auth-jwt-sqli | react-billing-hook | clean-stream-worker)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--profile <mode>${ANSI.reset}                Override profile (chill | assertive | security-focused)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--provider <llm>${ANSI.reset}                Override LLM (auto | openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama | heuristic)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--format <fmt>${ANSI.reset}                  Output format (terminal | markdown | json)
+
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit chat "<query>"${ANSI.reset}          Ask @openrabbit to explain, write unit tests, or fix code
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit serve${ANSI.reset} [--port 3847]    Start Webhook Bot Server & Interactive Web Dashboard
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit init${ANSI.reset}                   Generate a .openrabbit.yaml config file in current repo
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit providers${ANSI.reset}              List supported BYOK LLM providers and readiness status
+`);
+}
+
+// Run CLI when invoked directly
+const isDirectExecution =
+  process.argv[1] &&
+  (process.argv[1].endsWith('cli/index.ts') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli\\index.ts') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli/index.js') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli\\index.js'));
+
+if (isDirectExecution) {
+  runCli().catch((err) => {
+    console.error(`${ANSI.red}Error:${ANSI.reset}`, err);
+    process.exit(1);
+  });
+}
