+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import YAML from 'yaml';
+import type { OpenRabbitConfig, PathInstruction } from '../types/index.js';
+
+export const DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG: OpenRabbitConfig = {
+  language: 'en-US',
+  profile: 'chill',
+  tone_instructions:
+    'Be constructive, concise, and high-signal. Prioritize real bugs, security vulnerabilities, race conditions, and performance bottlenecks over stylistic nitpicks.',
+  early_access: true,
+  reviews: {
+    high_level_summary: true,
+    poem: true,
+    review_status: true,
+    collapse_walkthrough: false,
+    sequence_diagrams: true,
+    auto_review: {
+      enabled: true,
+      drafts: false,
+      base_branches: ['main', 'master', 'develop'],
+    },
+    path_filters: [
+      '!dist/**',
+      '!node_modules/**',
+      '!*.lock',
+      '!package-lock.json',
+      '!pnpm-lock.yaml',
+      '!**/*.min.js',
+      '!**/*.snap',
+    ],
+    path_instructions: [
+      {
+        path: 'src/api/**',
+        instructions:
+          'Verify authentication checks, input validation, rate limiting, and SQL/command injection safety on all endpoints.',
+      },
+      {
+        path: '**/*.tsx',
+        instructions:
+          'Check for React hook dependency array bugs, stale closures, memory leaks in useEffect, and accessibility attributes.',
+      },
+      {
+        path: 'tests/**',
+        instructions:
+          'Ensure tests cover edge cases, error paths, and avoid brittle timing assumptions.',
+      },
+    ],
+  },
+  chat: {
+    auto_reply: true,
+  },
+  llm: {
+    provider: 'auto',
+    temperature: 0.2,
+  },
+};
+
+const CONFIG_FILENAMES = [
+  '.openrabbit.yaml',
+  '.openrabbit.yml',
+  'openrabbit.yaml',
+  '.coderabbit.yaml',
+  '.coderabbit.yml',
+];
+
+export function loadConfig(workspaceDir: string = process.cwd()): {
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig;
+  configPath: string | null;
+} {
+  for (const filename of CONFIG_FILENAMES) {
+    const candidate = path.join(workspaceDir, filename);
+    if (fs.existsSync(candidate)) {
+      try {
+        const raw = fs.readFileSync(candidate, 'utf8');
+        const parsed = YAML.parse(raw) || {};
+        return {
+          config: mergeConfig(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG, parsed),
+          configPath: candidate,
+        };
+      } catch (err) {
+        console.warn(`Warning: Failed to parse ${candidate}, using defaults.`, err);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    config: structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG),
+    configPath: null,
+  };
+}
+
+export function parseYamlConfig(yamlContent: string): OpenRabbitConfig {
+  const parsed = YAML.parse(yamlContent) || {};
+  return mergeConfig(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG, parsed);
+}
+
+export function serializeConfigToYaml(config: OpenRabbitConfig): string {
+  const header = `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://openrabbit.dev/schema/v1.json
+# ============================================================================
+# OpenRabbit Configuration (.openrabbit.yaml)
+# Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer & Interactive PR Companion
+# ============================================================================
+
+`;
+  return header + YAML.stringify(config, { indent: 2 });
+}
+
+export function mergeConfig(
+  base: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  override: Record<string, any>
+): OpenRabbitConfig {
+  const merged = structuredClone(base);
+
+  if (typeof override.language === 'string') merged.language = override.language;
+  if (
+    override.profile === 'chill' ||
+    override.profile === 'assertive' ||
+    override.profile === 'security-focused'
+  ) {
+    merged.profile = override.profile;
+  }
+  if (typeof override.tone_instructions === 'string') {
+    merged.tone_instructions = override.tone_instructions;
+  }
+  if (typeof override.early_access === 'boolean') {
+    merged.early_access = override.early_access;
+  }
+
+  if (override.reviews && typeof override.reviews === 'object') {
+    const r = override.reviews;
+    if (typeof r.high_level_summary === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.high_level_summary = r.high_level_summary;
+    if (typeof r.poem === 'boolean') merged.reviews.poem = r.poem;
+    if (typeof r.review_status === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.review_status = r.review_status;
+    if (typeof r.collapse_walkthrough === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.collapse_walkthrough = r.collapse_walkthrough;
+    if (typeof r.sequence_diagrams === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.sequence_diagrams = r.sequence_diagrams;
+
+    if (r.auto_review && typeof r.auto_review === 'object') {
+      if (typeof r.auto_review.enabled === 'boolean')
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.enabled = r.auto_review.enabled;
+      if (typeof r.auto_review.drafts === 'boolean')
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.drafts = r.auto_review.drafts;
+      if (Array.isArray(r.auto_review.base_branches))
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.base_branches = r.auto_review.base_branches;
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(r.path_filters)) {
+      merged.reviews.path_filters = r.path_filters;
+    }
+    if (Array.isArray(r.path_instructions)) {
+      merged.reviews.path_instructions = r.path_instructions.filter(
+        (item: any) => item && typeof item.path === 'string' && typeof item.instructions === 'string'
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (override.chat && typeof override.chat === 'object') {
+    if (typeof override.chat.auto_reply === 'boolean') {
+      merged.chat.auto_reply = override.chat.auto_reply;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (override.llm && typeof override.llm === 'object') {
+    if (override.llm.provider) merged.llm.provider = override.llm.provider;
+    if (override.llm.model !== undefined) merged.llm.model = override.llm.model;
+    if (typeof override.llm.temperature === 'number') {
+      merged.llm.temperature = override.llm.temperature;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return merged;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Converts a glob pattern like `src/api/**` or `*.lock` into a RegExp.
+ */
+export function globToRegex(glob: string): RegExp {
+  const normalized = glob.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  let regexStr = '^';
+  let i = 0;
+  while (i < normalized.length) {
+    const c = normalized[i];
+    if (c === '*') {
+      if (normalized[i + 1] === '*') {
+        if (normalized[i + 2] === '/') {
+          regexStr += '(?:.+/)?';
+          i += 3;
+          continue;
+        } else {
+          regexStr += '.*';
+          i += 2;
+          continue;
+        }
+      } else {
+        regexStr += '[^/]*';
+      }
+    } else if (c === '?') {
+      regexStr += '[^/]';
+    } else if ('.+^$()|[]\\{}'.includes(c)) {
+      regexStr += '\\' + c;
+    } else {
+      regexStr += c;
+    }
+    i++;
+  }
+  regexStr += '$';
+  return new RegExp(regexStr, 'i');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a file path should be included according to `reviews.path_filters`.
+ * Supports positive globs (`src/**`) and negative exclusion globs (`!dist/**`).
+ */
+export function shouldReviewFile(filePath: string, pathFilters: string[]): boolean {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  if (!pathFilters || pathFilters.length === 0) return true;
+
+  const positiveFilters = pathFilters.filter((f) => !f.startsWith('!'));
+  const negativeFilters = pathFilters
+    .filter((f) => f.startsWith('!'))
+    .map((f) => f.slice(1));
+
+  // Check exclusions first
+  for (const neg of negativeFilters) {
+    if (globToRegex(neg).test(normalized) || globToRegex(`**/${neg}`).test(normalized)) {
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // If positive filters exist, file must match at least one
+  if (positiveFilters.length > 0) {
+    return positiveFilters.some((pos) => globToRegex(pos).test(normalized));
+  }
+
+  return true;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns all matching path_instructions for a given file path.
+ */
+export function getMatchingPathInstructions(
+  filePath: string,
+  instructions: PathInstruction[]
+): PathInstruction[] {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  return (instructions || []).filter((inst) =>
+    globToRegex(inst.path).test(normalized)
+  );
+}

+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,

+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import type {
+  ChatCommandType,
+  ChatRequest,
+  ChatResponse,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+import { parseUnifiedDiff } from './diff-parser.js';
+import {
+  generateLLMCompletion,
+  resolveActiveProvider,
+} from './llm-provider.js';
+
+export function detectChatCommand(query: string): ChatCommandType {
+  const cleaned = query
+    .replace(/@openrabbit\b/gi, '')
+    .replace(/@coderabbitai\b/gi, '')
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+
+  if (/\b(?:test|tests|unit\s+test|spec|vitest|jest)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'test';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:fix|patch|refactor|suggestion|apply)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'fix';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:docstring|jsdoc|tsdoc|comment|document)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'docstring';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:explain|how\s+does|walk\s+me\s+through|why)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'explain';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:summary|summarize|tldr|walkthrough)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'summary';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:config|configuration|yaml|rules)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'config';
+  }
+  if (/\b(?:resolve|lgtm|fixed|done)\b/.test(cleaned)) {
+    return 'resolve';
+  }
+  return 'question';
+}
+
+export async function handlePRChat(
+  req: ChatRequest,
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig = DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG
+): Promise<ChatResponse> {
+  const commandDetected = detectChatCommand(req.query);
+  const active = resolveActiveProvider(config.llm.provider, config.llm.model);
+
+  if (commandDetected === 'config') {
+    return {
+      commandDetected,
+      replyMarkdown: `### ⚙️ Active \`.openrabbit.yaml\` Configuration\n\n\`\`\`yaml\n${serializeConfigToYaml(
+        config
+      )}\`\`\``,
+      providerUsed: active.provider,
+      modelUsed: active.model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (commandDetected === 'resolve') {
+    return {
+      commandDetected,
+      replyMarkdown: `✅ **Thread Resolved!** Thanks for addressing this finding. I've marked this review discussion as resolved. 🐇🥕`,
+      providerUsed: active.provider,
+      modelUsed: active.model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (active.provider !== 'heuristic') {
+    try {
+      const systemPrompt = `You are @openrabbit, an interactive AI Pull Request assistant embedded in GitHub/GitLab and the OpenRabbit CLI.
+Detected command intent: ${commandDetected.toUpperCase()}
+Tone instructions: ${config.tone_instructions}
+Respond in clear, high-signal GitHub Flavored Markdown. When suggesting code fixes, use \`\`\`suggestion blocks or language-tagged code blocks.`;
+
+      const contextParts: string[] = [];
+      if (req.prTitle) contextParts.push(`PR Title: ${req.prTitle}`);
+      if (req.file) contextParts.push(`Target File: ${req.file}${req.line ? `:${req.line}` : ''}`);
+      if (req.findingContext) {
+        contextParts.push(
+          `Inline Finding Context: [${req.findingContext.severity.toUpperCase()}] ${req.findingContext.title}\n${req.findingContext.body}\nOriginal Code: ${req.findingContext.originalCode || 'N/A'}\nSuggested Code: ${req.findingContext.suggestionCode || 'N/A'}`
+        );
+      }
+      if (req.diff) {
+        contextParts.push(`Diff Context:\n\`\`\`diff\n${req.diff.slice(0, 6000)}\n\`\`\``);
+      }
+
+      const userPrompt = `${contextParts.join('\n\n')}\n\nDeveloper Query: ${req.query}`;
+
+      const llmRes = await generateLLMCompletion({
+        systemPrompt,
+        userPrompt,
+        temperature: 0.2,
+        preferredProvider: active.provider,
+        preferredModel: active.model,
+      });
+
+      return {
+        commandDetected,
+        replyMarkdown: llmRes.content,
+        suggestedCode: req.findingContext?.suggestionCode,
+        providerUsed: llmRes.provider,
+        modelUsed: llmRes.model,
+      };
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn(
+        '[OpenRabbit Chat] External LLM call failed, using deterministic response builder:',
+        (err as Error).message
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  return buildHeuristicChatResponse(req, commandDetected);
+}
+
+function buildHeuristicChatResponse(
+  req: ChatRequest,
+  command: ChatCommandType
+): ChatResponse {
+  const parsed = req.diff ? parseUnifiedDiff(req.diff) : null;
+  const targetFile =
+    req.file ||
+    req.findingContext?.file ||
+    parsed?.files[0]?.newPath ||

+  if (command === 'test') {

+
+describe('${primarySymbol} (${targetFile})', () => {
+  it('handles valid inputs and resolves expected state cleanly', async () => {
+    const result = await ${primarySymbol}({ id: 'usr_101', role: 'member' });
+    expect(result).toBeDefined();

+
+  it('rejects malformed or malicious payloads safely (regression check)', async () => {
+    await expect(
+      ${primarySymbol}({ id: "' OR 1=1 --", role: 'admin' })
+    ).rejects.toThrow();

+
+  it('cleans up async resources when aborted or on error', async () => {
+    const spy = vi.fn();
+    await expect(${primarySymbol}(null as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)).rejects.toThrow();
+    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});`;
+
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'test',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 🧪 Generated Unit Test Suite for \`${targetFile}\``,
+        '',
+        `Here is a comprehensive test suite covering the happy path, security/input validation boundary cases, and error handling for \`${primarySymbol}\`:`,
+        '',
+        '```typescript',
+        testCode,
+        '```',
+        '',
+        `<sub>🐇 *Generated by OpenRabbit · Run via \`npm test\` or copy into \`tests/${
+          targetFile.split('/').pop()?.replace(/\.[jt]sx?$/, '') || 'module'
+        }.test.ts\`*</sub>`,
+      ].join('\n'),
+      suggestedCode: testCode,
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',

+  }
+
+  if (command === 'fix') {
+    const fixedCode =
+      req.findingContext?.suggestionCode ||
+      `// Validated and parameterized implementation for ${primarySymbol}\nconst sanitizedInput = String(input).trim();\nconst result = await db.query('SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE id = $1', [sanitizedInput]);`;
+
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'fix',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 🔧 Committable Fix for \`${targetFile}\`${
+          req.line ? ` (Line ${req.line})` : ''
+        }`,
+        '',
+        req.findingContext
+          ? `Addressing **${req.findingContext.title}** (\`[${req.findingContext.category}]\`):`
+          : `Here is a safe, drop-in replacement patch for \`${targetFile}\`:`,
+        '',
+        '```suggestion',
+        fixedCode,

+        '',
+        `#### Why this fix works:`,
+        `- Eliminates unsafe runtime behavior while preserving the existing function signature.`,
+        `- Prevents unhandled edge cases and ensures strict input safety.`,
+      ].join('\n'),
+      suggestedCode: fixedCode,

+  if (command === 'docstring') {

+
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'docstring',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 📖 Generated TSDoc / JSDoc for \`${primarySymbol}\``,
+        '',
+        '```suggestion',
+        docBlock,
+        '```',
+      ].join('\n'),
+      suggestedCode: docBlock,
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',

+  }
+
+  if (command === 'explain') {
+    return {
+      commandDetected: 'explain',
+      replyMarkdown: [
+        `### 🔍 Deep-Dive Explanation: \`${targetFile}\``,
+        '',
+        req.findingContext
+          ? `**Context:** ${req.findingContext.title} (\`${req.findingContext.severity.toUpperCase()}\` · \`${req.findingContext.category}\`)\n\n${req.findingContext.body}`

+            : `Ensure boundary inputs and async rejections are handled deterministically.`
+        }`,
+      ].join('\n'),
+      providerUsed: 'heuristic',
+      modelUsed: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+    };
+  }
+
+  // Default question / summary response
+  return {
+    commandDetected: command,
+    replyMarkdown: [
+      `### 🐇 OpenRabbit Assistant`,

+      `Regarding your question on \`${targetFile}\`:`,

+      req.findingContext

+            req.findingContext.suggestionCode || 'See inline suggestion above'

+        : `- **Files in scope:** ${

+import type { DiffHunk, DiffLine, FileDiff, ParsedDiff } from '../types/index.js';
+
+const EXTENSION_LANGUAGE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
+  ts: 'TypeScript',
+  tsx: 'TypeScript (React)',
+  js: 'JavaScript',
+  jsx: 'JavaScript (React)',
+  mjs: 'JavaScript',
+  cjs: 'JavaScript',
+  py: 'Python',
+  go: 'Go',
+  rs: 'Rust',
+  java: 'Java',
+  kt: 'Kotlin',
+  rb: 'Ruby',
+  php: 'PHP',
+  cs: 'C#',
+  cpp: 'C++',
+  c: 'C',
+  h: 'C/C++ Header',
+  swift: 'Swift',
+  sql: 'SQL',
+  sh: 'Shell',
+  yaml: 'YAML',
+  yml: 'YAML',
+  json: 'JSON',
+  md: 'Markdown',
+  css: 'CSS',
+  html: 'HTML',
+};
+
+export function detectLanguage(filePath: string): string {
+  const ext = filePath.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
+  return EXTENSION_LANGUAGE_MAP[ext] || 'Code';
+}
+
+export function inferComponentName(filePath: string): string {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  const parts = normalized.split('/');
+  if (parts.length === 1) return 'Root';
+  if (parts[0] === 'src' && parts.length >= 3) {
+    return parts[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + parts[1].slice(1);
+  }
+  return parts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + parts[0].slice(1);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Extracts function, class, method, or hook names from hunk headers and diff lines.
+ */
+export function extractChangedSymbols(hunks: DiffHunk[]): string[] {
+  const symbols = new Set<string>();
+  const patterns = [
+    /(?:export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/,
+    /(?:export\s+)?class\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/,
+    /(?:export\s+)?interface\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/,
+    /(?:export\s+)?const\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\([^)]*\)|[A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s*=>/,
+    /^\s*(?:async\s+)?([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(?::\s*[^{]+)?\{/,
+    /def\s+([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(/,
+    /func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(/,
+    /fn\s+([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*[<(]/,
+  ];
+
+  for (const hunk of hunks) {
+    if (hunk.sectionHeading) {
+      for (const regex of patterns) {
+        const m = hunk.sectionHeading.match(regex);
+        if (m && m[1] && !['if', 'for', 'while', 'switch', 'catch'].includes(m[1])) {
+          symbols.add(m[1]);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    for (const line of hunk.lines) {
+      for (const regex of patterns) {
+        const m = line.content.match(regex);
+        if (m && m[1] && !['if', 'for', 'while', 'switch', 'catch'].includes(m[1])) {
+          symbols.add(m[1]);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return Array.from(symbols).slice(0, 12);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Parses a standard unified git diff string into structured FileDiff and DiffHunk objects.
+ */
+export function parseUnifiedDiff(rawDiff: string): ParsedDiff {
+  if (!rawDiff || !rawDiff.trim()) {
+    return {
+      files: [],
+      totalAdditions: 0,
+      totalDeletions: 0,
+      totalFiles: 0,
+    };
+  }
+
+  const normalized = rawDiff.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
+  const lines = normalized.split('\n');
+  const files: FileDiff[] = [];
+
+  let currentFile: FileDiff | null = null;
+  let currentHunk: DiffHunk | null = null;
+  let oldLineCounter = 0;
+  let newLineCounter = 0;
+  let currentPatchLines: string[] = [];
+
+  const flushFile = () => {
+    if (currentFile) {
+      currentFile.rawPatch = currentPatchLines.join('\n').trim();
+      currentFile.symbolsChanged = extractChangedSymbols(currentFile.hunks);
+      files.push(currentFile);
+    }
+    currentFile = null;
+    currentHunk = null;
+    currentPatchLines = [];
+  };
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+    const line = lines[i];
+
+    if (line.startsWith('diff --git ')) {
+      flushFile();
+      const match = line.match(/^diff --git a\/(.+?) b\/(.+)$/);
+      const oldPath = match ? match[1] : 'unknown';
+      const newPath = match ? match[2] : oldPath;
+      currentFile = {
+        oldPath,
+        newPath,
+        status: 'modified',
+        language: detectLanguage(newPath),
+        additions: 0,
+        deletions: 0,
+        hunks: [],
+        rawPatch: '',
+        symbolsChanged: [],
+      };
+      currentPatchLines.push(line);
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    // Support diffs that start directly with --- a/file and +++ b/file without `diff --git`
+    if (!currentFile && line.startsWith('--- ')) {
+      const nextLine = lines[i + 1] || '';
+      if (nextLine.startsWith('+++ ')) {
+        const oldRaw = line.slice(4).trim().replace(/^a\//, '');
+        const newRaw = nextLine.slice(4).trim().replace(/^b\//, '');
+        const resolvedPath = newRaw === '/dev/null' ? oldRaw : newRaw;
+        currentFile = {
+          oldPath: oldRaw,
+          newPath: resolvedPath,
+          status:
+            oldRaw === '/dev/null'
+              ? 'added'
+              : newRaw === '/dev/null'
+              ? 'deleted'
+              : 'modified',
+          language: detectLanguage(resolvedPath),
+          additions: 0,
+          deletions: 0,
+          hunks: [],
+          rawPatch: '',
+          symbolsChanged: [],
+        };
+        currentPatchLines.push(line);
+        continue;
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (!currentFile) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    currentPatchLines.push(line);
+
+    if (line.startsWith('new file mode')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'added';
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('deleted file mode')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'deleted';
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('rename from ')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'renamed';
+      currentFile.oldPath = line.slice('rename from '.length).trim();
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('rename to ')) {
+      currentFile.status = 'renamed';
+      currentFile.newPath = line.slice('rename to '.length).trim();
+      currentFile.language = detectLanguage(currentFile.newPath);
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('--- ')) {
+      const oldRaw = line.slice(4).trim();
+      if (oldRaw === '/dev/null') {
+        currentFile.status = 'added';
+      } else {
+        currentFile.oldPath = oldRaw.replace(/^a\//, '');
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('+++ ')) {
+      const newRaw = line.slice(4).trim();
+      if (newRaw === '/dev/null') {
+        currentFile.status = 'deleted';
+      } else {
+        currentFile.newPath = newRaw.replace(/^b\//, '');
+        currentFile.language = detectLanguage(currentFile.newPath);
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    // Hunk header: @@ -oldStart,oldLines +newStart,newLines @@ optional section
+    if (line.startsWith('@@ ')) {
+      const hunkMatch = line.match(
+        /^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@(.*)$/
+      );
+      if (hunkMatch) {
+        const oldStart = parseInt(hunkMatch[1], 10);
+        const oldLines = hunkMatch[2] !== undefined ? parseInt(hunkMatch[2], 10) : 1;
+        const newStart = parseInt(hunkMatch[3], 10);
+        const newLines = hunkMatch[4] !== undefined ? parseInt(hunkMatch[4], 10) : 1;
+        const sectionHeading = hunkMatch[5]?.trim() || undefined;
+
+        oldLineCounter = oldStart;
+        newLineCounter = newStart;
+
+        currentHunk = {
+          header: line,
+          oldStart,
+          oldLines,
+          newStart,
+          newLines,
+          sectionHeading,
+          lines: [],
+        };
+        currentFile.hunks.push(currentHunk);
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    if (currentHunk) {
+      if (line.startsWith('+')) {
+        const diffLine: DiffLine = {
+          type: 'add',
+          content: line.slice(1),
+          newLineNumber: newLineCounter++,
+        };
+        currentHunk.lines.push(diffLine);
+        currentFile.additions++;
+      } else if (line.startsWith('-')) {
+        const diffLine: DiffLine = {
+          type: 'del',
+          content: line.slice(1),
+          oldLineNumber: oldLineCounter++,
+        };
+        currentHunk.lines.push(diffLine);
+        currentFile.deletions++;
+      } else if (line.startsWith(' ')) {
+        const diffLine: DiffLine = {
+          type: 'context',
+          content: line.slice(1),
+          oldLineNumber: oldLineCounter++,
+          newLineNumber: newLineCounter++,
+        };
+        currentHunk.lines.push(diffLine);
+      } else if (line.startsWith('\\ No newline at end of file')) {
+        // Ignore marker
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  flushFile();
+
+  const totalAdditions = files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.additions, 0);
+  const totalDeletions = files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.deletions, 0);
+
+  return {
+    files,
+    totalAdditions,
+    totalDeletions,
+    totalFiles: files.length,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats a FileDiff with explicit new-file line numbers so LLMs can pinpoint
+ * exact lines for GitHub/GitLab inline review comments and committable suggestions.
+ */
+export function formatAnnotatedFileDiff(file: FileDiff): string {
+  const out: string[] = [];
+  out.push(`### File: \`${file.newPath}\` (${file.status}, +${file.additions}/-${file.deletions}, ${file.language})`);
+  if (file.symbolsChanged.length > 0) {
+    out.push(`Symbols modified: ${file.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`);
+  }
+
+  for (const hunk of file.hunks) {
+    out.push(hunk.header);
+    for (const line of hunk.lines) {
+      if (line.type === 'add') {
+        out.push(`L${String(line.newLineNumber).padEnd(4, ' ')} + | ${line.content}`);
+      } else if (line.type === 'del') {
+        out.push(`OLD${String(line.oldLineNumber).padEnd(2, ' ')} - | ${line.content}`);
+      } else {
+        out.push(`L${String(line.newLineNumber).padEnd(4, ' ')}   | ${line.content}`);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return out.join('\n');
+}

+import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
+
+export interface LocalGitDiffOptions {
+  cwd?: string;
+  staged?: boolean;
+  baseBranch?: string;
+  commitRange?: string;
+}
+
+export function getLocalGitDiff(options: LocalGitDiffOptions = {}): {
+  diff: string;
+  branch: string;
+  repoName: string;
+  author: string;
+  description: string;
+} {
+  const cwd = options.cwd || process.cwd();
+
+  const safeExec = (cmd: string): string => {
+    try {
+      return execSync(cmd, {
+        cwd,
+        encoding: 'utf8',
+        stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'],
+      }).trim();
+    } catch {
+      return '';
+    }
+  };
+
+  const branch = safeExec('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD') || 'main';
+  const remoteUrl = safeExec('git config --get remote.origin.url');
+  let repoName = 'local/openrabbit';
+  if (remoteUrl) {
+    const match = remoteUrl.match(/[:/]([^/:]+\/[^/.]+?)(?:\.git)?$/);
+    if (match) repoName = match[1];
+  } else {
+    const topLevel = safeExec('git rev-parse --show-toplevel');
+    if (topLevel) {
+      const folder = topLevel.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop();
+      if (folder) repoName = `local/${folder}`;
+    }
+  }
+  const author = safeExec('git config user.name') || 'developer';
+
+  let diff = '';
+  let description = '';
+
+  if (options.commitRange) {
+    diff = safeExec(`git diff ${options.commitRange}`);
+    description = `Commit range ${options.commitRange}`;
+  } else if (options.baseBranch) {
+    diff = safeExec(`git diff ${options.baseBranch}...HEAD`);
+    description = `Branch diff against ${options.baseBranch}`;
+  } else if (options.staged) {
+    diff = safeExec('git diff --staged');
+    description = 'Staged changes (git diff --staged)';
+  } else {
+    // Try unstaged + staged against HEAD, or fallback to last commit
+    diff = safeExec('git diff HEAD');
+    description = 'Working tree changes (git diff HEAD)';
+    if (!diff) {
+      diff = safeExec('git diff --staged');
+      description = 'Staged changes';
+    }
+    if (!diff) {
+      diff = safeExec('git show --format= HEAD');
+      description = 'Latest commit (HEAD)';
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    diff: diff ? diff + '\n' : '',
+    branch,
+    repoName,
+    author,
+    description,
+  };
+}

+import crypto from 'node:crypto';

+  ReviewSeverity,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+import { inferComponentName } from './diff-parser.js';
+
+interface HeuristicRule {
+  id: string;
+  title: string;
+  severity: ReviewSeverity;
+  category: ReviewCategory;
+  matchLine: (line: string, file: FileDiff, contextLines: string[]) => boolean;
+  buildFinding: (
+    line: string,
+    lineNumber: number,

+}
+
+const HEURISTIC_RULES: HeuristicRule[] = [
+  {
+    id: 'sec-sql-injection',
+    title: 'Potential SQL Injection via string interpolation',
+    severity: 'critical',
+    category: 'security',
+    matchLine: (line) =>
+      /(?:SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE)\b.*(?:\$\{|['"]\s*\+\s*[a-zA-Z0-9_$.]+)/i.test(

+      ),
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';

+        let idx = 1;
+        const params: string[] = [];
+        const sql = inner.replace(
+          /'?\$\{([^}]+)\}'?/g,
+          (_: string, expr: string) => {
+            params.push(expr.trim());
+            return `$${idx++}`;
+          }

+          ? `\`${sql}\`, [${params.join(', ')}]`

+      });
+
+      return {
+        body: 'Interpolating user-controlled values directly into a raw SQL query exposes the database to **SQL Injection (CWE-89)**. Use parameterized queries or prepared statements with bound placeholders (`$1`, `?`) instead.',
+        suggestionCode:
+          parameterized !== line
+            ? parameterized
+            : `${indent}// Use parameterized query placeholders ($1) instead of string interpolation`,
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'sec-hardcoded-secret',
+    title: 'Hardcoded secret or API credential detected',
+    severity: 'critical',
+    category: 'security',
+    matchLine: (line, file) =>
+      !file.newPath.includes('.example') &&
+      !file.newPath.includes('test') &&
+      /(?:api[_-]?key|secret|password|private[_-]?key|jwt[_-]?secret|token)\s*[:=]\s*['"][A-Za-z0-9_\-./+=]{12,}['"]/i.test(
+        line
+      ),
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const replaced = line.replace(
+        /(['"])[A-Za-z0-9_\-./+=]{12,}\1/,

+        body: 'Hardcoding secrets or API tokens in source code risks credential leakage in git history and build artifacts (**CWE-798**). Load this value from an environment variable or secret manager and fail fast if it is missing.',

+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'sec-eval-exec',
+    title: 'Unsafe dynamic code execution (`eval` / `child_process.exec`)',
+    severity: 'critical',
+    category: 'security',
+    matchLine: (line) =>
+      /\beval\s*\(/.test(line) ||
+      /\bexec(?:Sync)?\s*\(\s*`[^`]*\$\{/.test(line),
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      return {
+        body: 'Dynamic execution of unsanitized strings via `eval()` or shell-interpolated `exec()` allows arbitrary code or command injection (**CWE-78 / CWE-95**). Prefer `execFile` with an explicit argument array or `JSON.parse` for structured data.',
+        suggestionCode: line.includes('eval(')
+          ? line.replace(/\beval\s*\(/, 'JSON.parse(')
+          : `${indent}// Prefer execFile(cmd, [arg1, arg2]) over shell string interpolation`,

+  },

+    id: 'sec-xss-dangerously-set',
+    title: 'Unsanitized HTML injection via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` / `innerHTML`',

+        suggestionCode: line.includes('.innerHTML')
+          ? line.replace(/\.innerHTML\s*=/, '.textContent =')
+          : undefined,
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'bug-async-forEach',
+    title: 'Unawaited `async` callback inside `.forEach()`',
+    severity: 'warning',
+    category: 'bug',
+    matchLine: (line) => /\.forEach\s*\(\s*async\b/.test(line),
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      const match = line.match(
+        /^\s*(?:await\s+)?([a-zA-Z0-9_$.]+)\.forEach\s*\(\s*async\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*=>\s*\{?/

Use `for (const item of items)` for sequential execution or `await Promise.all(items.map(...))` for concurrency.',
+        suggestionCode: suggestion,
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'bug-equality-coercion',
+    title: 'Loose equality operator (`==` / `!=`) may cause unexpected type coercion',
+    severity: 'suggestion',
+    category: 'bug',
+    matchLine: (line, file) =>
+      (file.language.includes('TypeScript') || file.language.includes('JavaScript')) &&
+      /[^=!]==[^=]|[^!]!=[^=]/.test(line) &&
+      !/==\s*null|!=\s*null/.test(line),
+    buildFinding: (line) => ({
+      body: 'Loose equality (`==` / `!=`) performs implicit type coercion in JavaScript/TypeScript, which can mask subtle bugs (e.g., `0 == ""` evaluating to `true`). Prefer strict equality (`===` / `!==`).',
+      suggestionCode: line
+        .replace(/([^=!])==([^=])/g, '$1===$2')
+        .replace(/([^!])!=([^=])/g, '$1!==$2'),
+    }),
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'perf-await-in-loop',
+    title: 'Sequential `await` inside loop may bottleneck throughput',
+    severity: 'suggestion',

+      return /\bfor\s*\(|\bwhile\s*\(/.test(windowText);
+    },
+    buildFinding: (line) => ({
+      body: 'Awaiting independent asynchronous operations sequentially inside a loop increases total latency linearly with the collection size ($O(N)$ round-trips). If order does not strictly matter, consider batching with `await Promise.all(...)` or `Promise.allSettled(...)`.',
+      suggestionCode: line,
+    }),
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'react-missing-cleanup-or-interval',
+    title: 'Timer or event listener registered without clear cleanup guarantee',
+    severity: 'warning',
+    category: 'bug',
+    matchLine: (line, _file, contextLines) => {
+      if (!/\b(?:setInterval|addEventListener)\s*\(/.test(line)) return false;
+      const joined = contextLines.join('\n');
+      return !/clearInterval|removeEventListener/.test(joined);
+    },
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      if (line.includes('setInterval(') && !/const\s+|let\s+/.test(line)) {
+        return {
+          body: '`setInterval` is invoked without storing the timer handle or clearing it on teardown/unmount. This creates a memory leak and duplicate background executions when the component or service re-initializes.',
+          suggestionCode: `${indent}const intervalId = ${line.trim()}\n${indent}// Ensure clearInterval(intervalId) is called during cleanup`,
+        };
+      }
+      return {
+        body: 'Ensure this subscription or interval is paired with a corresponding `clearInterval` / `removeEventListener` cleanup handler to prevent memory leaks.',
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'type-explicit-any',
+    title: 'Avoid explicit `any` type annotation to preserve type safety',
+    severity: 'nitpick',
+    category: 'type-safety',
+    matchLine: (line, file) =>
+      file.language.includes('TypeScript') &&
+      /:\s*any\b|<any>|as\s+any\b/.test(line),
+    buildFinding: (line) => ({
+      body: 'Using `any` disables TypeScript compile-time checks and allows unsafe property access to propagate silently. Prefer `unknown` with type narrowing or a dedicated interface/generic type.',
+      suggestionCode: line
+        .replace(/:\s*any\b/g, ': unknown')
+        .replace(/as\s+any\b/g, 'as unknown'),
+    }),
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'maint-leftover-debug',
+    title: 'Leftover debugging statement (`console.log` / `debugger`)',
+    severity: 'nitpick',
+    category: 'maintainability',
+    matchLine: (line, file) =>
+      !file.newPath.includes('cli') &&
+      !file.newPath.includes('test') &&
+      (/\bdebugger\s*;?/.test(line) || /\bconsole\.log\s*\(/.test(line)),
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      return {
+        body: 'Debug statements or raw `console.log` calls in production code can leak sensitive payloads to stdout and clutter structured logs. Remove before merging or route through a structured logger.',
+        suggestionCode: line.includes('debugger')
+          ? `${indent}// debugger removed`
+          : line.replace(/console\.log\(/, 'logger.debug('),
+      };
+    },
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'bug-empty-catch',
+    title: 'Empty or silent `catch` block swallows runtime exceptions',
+    severity: 'warning',
+    category: 'bug',
+    matchLine: (line, _file, contextLines) => {
+      if (!/\bcatch\b/.test(line)) return false;
+      const joined = contextLines.join(' ');
+      return /catch\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*\{\s*\}/.test(joined);
+    },
+    buildFinding: (line) => {
+      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] || '';
+      return {
+        body: 'Swallowing exceptions in an empty `catch` block hides unexpected failures and makes production debugging difficult. Log the error with context or rethrow a domain-specific error.',
+        suggestionCode: `${indent}} catch (error) {\n${indent}  console.error('Operation failed:', error);\n${indent}  throw error;\n${indent}}`,
+      };
+    },
+  },
+];
+
+/**
+ * Generates high-signal inline findings using deterministic static analysis
+ * and `.openrabbit.yaml` path instruction checks.
+ */
+export function runHeuristicInlineReview(
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig
+): InlineFinding[] {
+  const findings: InlineFinding[] = [];
+  const seenKeys = new Set<string>();
+
+  for (const file of files) {
+    if (file.status === 'deleted') continue;
+
+    for (const hunk of file.hunks) {
+      const addedLinesWithIndex = hunk.lines
+        .map((l, idx) => ({ line: l, idx }))
+        .filter((item) => item.line.type === 'add' && item.line.newLineNumber);
+
+      for (const { line, idx } of addedLinesWithIndex) {
+        const lineNum = line.newLineNumber!;
+        const contextSlice = hunk.lines
+          .slice(Math.max(0, idx - 3), Math.min(hunk.lines.length, idx + 4))
+          .map((l) => l.content);
+
+        for (const rule of HEURISTIC_RULES) {
+          // Filter nitpicks if profile is 'chill'
+          if (config.profile === 'chill' && rule.severity === 'nitpick') {
+            continue;
+          }
+
+          if (rule.matchLine(line.content, file, contextSlice)) {
+            const dedupeKey = `${file.newPath}:${rule.id}:${Math.floor(lineNum / 5)}`;
+            if (seenKeys.has(dedupeKey)) continue;
+            seenKeys.add(dedupeKey);
+
+            const details = rule.buildFinding(
+              line.content,
+              lineNum,
+              file,
+              contextSlice
+            );
+
+            findings.push({
+              id: `finding-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+              file: file.newPath,
+              startLine: lineNum,
+              endLine: lineNum,
+              severity: rule.severity,
+              category: rule.category,
+              title: rule.title,
+              body: details.body,
+              suggestionCode: details.suggestionCode,
+              originalCode: line.content,
+              ruleMatched: rule.id,
+            });
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  // If a PR has clean additions and no issues were flagged, add a constructive architectural observation or praise
+  if (findings.length === 0 && files.length > 0) {
+    const primaryFile = files.find((f) => f.hunks.length > 0) || files[0];
+    const firstHunk = primaryFile.hunks[0];
+    const firstAdd = firstHunk?.lines.find((l) => l.type === 'add');
+    const targetLine = firstAdd?.newLineNumber || firstHunk?.newStart || 1;
+
+    findings.push({
+      id: `finding-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+      file: primaryFile.newPath,
+      startLine: targetLine,
+      endLine: targetLine,
+      severity: 'praise',
+      category: 'architecture',
+      title: 'Clean, well-structured implementation with no high-risk anti-patterns',
+      body: `Reviewed **+${primaryFile.additions}/-${primaryFile.deletions}** lines in \`${primaryFile.newPath}\`${
+        primaryFile.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+          ? ` affecting ${primaryFile.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`
+          : ''
+      }. No security vulnerabilities, unawaited promises, or unsafe type coercions were detected.`,
+    });
+  }
+
+  return findings;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Generates a complete CodeRabbit-style PR Walkthrough (Summary, Release Notes,
+ * File Table, Mermaid Sequence Diagram, Poem, and Risk Score) from the parsed diff.
+ */
+export function buildHeuristicWalkthrough(
+  prTitle: string,
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  findings: InlineFinding[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig
+): PRWalkthrough {
+  const fileSummaries: FileWalkthroughSummary[] = files.map((file) => {
+    const component = inferComponentName(file.newPath);
+    const fileFindings = findings.filter((f) => f.file === file.newPath);
+    const hasCritical = fileFindings.some((f) => f.severity === 'critical');
+    const hasWarning = fileFindings.some((f) => f.severity === 'warning');
+    const churn = file.additions + file.deletions;
+
+    const impact: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' =
+      hasCritical || churn > 80 ? 'high' : hasWarning || churn > 25 ? 'medium' : 'low';
+
+    let summary = '';
+    if (file.status === 'added') {
+      summary = `Introduces new ${file.language} module${
+        file.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+          ? ` defining ${file.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')}`
+          : ''
+      } (+${file.additions} lines).`;
+    } else if (file.status === 'deleted') {
+      summary = `Removes legacy ${file.language} file (-${file.deletions} lines).`;
+    } else if (file.symbolsChanged.length > 0) {
+      summary = `Updates ${file.symbolsChanged.map((s) => `\`${s}\``).join(', ')} in ${component} (+${file.additions}/-${file.deletions}).`;
+    } else {
+      summary = `Refines ${component.toLowerCase()} logic and configuration (+${file.additions}/-${file.deletions} lines).`;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      path: file.newPath,
+      status: file.status,
+      additions: file.additions,
+      deletions: file.deletions,
+      component,
+      summary,
+      impact,
+    };
+  });
+
+  const totalAdditions = files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.additions, 0);
+  const totalDeletions = files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.deletions, 0);
+  const components = Array.from(new Set(fileSummaries.map((f) => f.component)));
+
+  const criticalFindings = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical');
+  const warningFindings = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'warning');
+
+  const riskLevel: PRWalkthrough['riskLevel'] =
+    criticalFindings.length > 0
+      ? 'critical'
+      : warningFindings.length >= 2
+      ? 'high'
+      : warningFindings.length === 1 || totalAdditions + totalDeletions > 150
+      ? 'moderate'
+      : 'low';
+
+  const totalChurn = totalAdditions + totalDeletions;
+  const effortScore: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 =
+    totalChurn > 400 || criticalFindings.length >= 2
+      ? 5
+      : totalChurn > 200 || criticalFindings.length === 1
+      ? 4
+      : totalChurn > 75 || warningFindings.length >= 1
+      ? 3
+      : totalChurn > 20
+      ? 2
+      : 1;
+
+  const estimatedMinutes = Math.max(2, Math.min(45, Math.ceil(totalChurn / 18) + findings.length * 2));
+
+  // Build Mermaid sequence diagram reflecting the actual components/files changed
+  const mermaidDiagram = generateMermaidDiagramForDiff(files, fileSummaries);
+
+  // Build rabbit poem
+  const poem = config.reviews.poem
+    ? generateRabbitPoem(files, criticalFindings.length, warningFindings.length)
+    : '';
+
+  const executiveSummary = `This pull request modifies **${files.length} file${
+    files.length === 1 ? '' : 's'
+  }** across **${components.join(', ') || 'the repository'}** (+${totalAdditions}/-${totalDeletions} lines). ${
+    criticalFindings.length > 0
+      ? `OpenRabbit identified **${criticalFindings.length} critical issue(s)** and **${warningFindings.length} warning(s)** that should be addressed prior to merge.`
+      : warningFindings.length > 0
+      ? `OpenRabbit surfaced **${warningFindings.length} actionable warning(s)** with committable code suggestions.`
+      : `The changes are clean and well-scoped with no blocking defects found.`
+  }`;
+
+  const releaseNotes = [
+    {
+      category: files.some((f) => f.status === 'added') ? 'New Features & Modules' : 'Enhancements & Refactoring',
+      items: fileSummaries.slice(0, 5).map((f) => `${f.component}: ${f.summary}`),
+    },
+  ];
+
+  const securityConcerns = findings
+    .filter((f) => f.category === 'security')
+    .map((f) => `${f.file}:L${f.startLine} — ${f.title}`);
+
+  return {
+    title: prTitle || 'Pull Request Review',
+    executiveSummary,
+    releaseNotes,
+    fileSummaries,
+    mermaidDiagram,
+    poem,
+    effortScore,
+    estimatedMinutes,
+    riskLevel,
+    securityConcerns,
+  };
+}
+
+function sanitizeMermaidId(raw: string): string {
+  return raw.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'Node';
+}
+
+function generateMermaidDiagramForDiff(
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  summaries: FileWalkthroughSummary[]
+): string {
+  if (files.length === 0) {
+    return `sequenceDiagram\n  participant Dev as Developer\n  participant OR as OpenRabbit\n  Dev->>OR: Submit Pull Request\n  OR-->>Dev: Walkthrough & Inline Review`;
+  }
+
+  const lines: string[] = ['sequenceDiagram', '  autonumber', '  actor Caller as Caller / Client'];
+
+  const topFiles = files.slice(0, 4);
+  topFiles.forEach((f, idx) => {
+    const shortName = f.newPath.split('/').pop() || f.newPath;
+    const participantId = `M${idx}_${sanitizeMermaidId(shortName)}`;
+    lines.push(`  participant ${participantId} as ${shortName}`);
+  });
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < topFiles.length; i++) {
+    const f = topFiles[i];
+    const shortName = f.newPath.split('/').pop() || f.newPath;
+    const participantId = `M${i}_${sanitizeMermaidId(shortName)}`;
+    const symbolLabel =
+      f.symbolsChanged.length > 0
+        ? `${f.symbolsChanged[0]}()`
+        : `${summaries[i]?.status || 'update'} (+${f.additions}/-${f.deletions})`;
+
+    if (i === 0) {
+      lines.push(`  Caller->>+${participantId}: Invoke ${symbolLabel}`);
+    } else {
+      const prevShort = topFiles[i - 1].newPath.split('/').pop() || topFiles[i - 1].newPath;
+      const prevId = `M${i - 1}_${sanitizeMermaidId(prevShort)}`;
+      lines.push(`  ${prevId}->>+${participantId}: Call ${symbolLabel}`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (let i = topFiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+    const f = topFiles[i];
+    const shortName = f.newPath.split('/').pop() || f.newPath;
+    const participantId = `M${i}_${sanitizeMermaidId(shortName)}`;
+    if (i === 0) {
+      lines.push(`  ${participantId}-->>-Caller: Return result`);
+    } else {
+      const prevShort = topFiles[i - 1].newPath.split('/').pop() || topFiles[i - 1].newPath;
+      const prevId = `M${i - 1}_${sanitizeMermaidId(prevShort)}`;
+      lines.push(`  ${participantId}-->>-${prevId}: Propagate state`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+function generateRabbitPoem(
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  criticalCount: number,
+  warningCount: number
+): string {
+  const firstFile = files[0]?.newPath.split('/').pop() || 'the codebase';
+  if (criticalCount > 0) {
+    return [
+      `A twitch of the ear at \`${firstFile}\` in flight,`,
+      `Green lines of ambition, bold changes in sight—`,
+      `Yet traps in the burrow lurk under the clover,`,
+      `Let's patch up the hazards before hopping over! 🐇🛡️`,
+    ].join('\n');
+  }
+  if (warningCount > 0) {
+    return [
+      `Through hunks of \`${firstFile}\` the swift rabbit hops,`,
+      `Inspecting each promise and loop before stops.`,
+      `A few gentle tweaks make the burrow secure—`,
+      `Commit the suggestions for code clean and pure! 🐇✨`,
+    ].join('\n');
+  }
+  return [
+    `Across \`${firstFile}\` the fresh patches gleam,`,
+    `As crisp as a carrot beside a clear stream.`,
+    `No tangles or snares in the logic we find—`,
+    `Hop onward to merge with a confident mind! 🐇🥕`,
+  ].join('\n');
+}

+import type { LLMProviderType } from '../types/index.js';
+
+export interface LLMCompletionRequest {
+  systemPrompt: string;
+  userPrompt: string;
+  temperature?: number;
+  jsonMode?: boolean;
+  preferredProvider?: LLMProviderType;
+  preferredModel?: string;
+}
+
+export interface LLMCompletionResponse {
+  content: string;
+  provider: string;
+  model: string;
+}
+
+export interface ProviderStatusInfo {
+  id: LLMProviderType;
+  name: string;
+  configured: boolean;
+  defaultModel: string;
+  description: string;
+}
+
+export function getProvidersStatus(): ProviderStatusInfo[] {
+  return [
+    {
+      id: 'openai',
+      name: 'OpenAI / Compatible API',
+      configured: Boolean(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY),
+      defaultModel: process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'gpt-4o',
+      description: 'GPT-4o, o3-mini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter)',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'anthropic',
+      name: 'Anthropic Claude',
+      configured: Boolean(process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY),
+      defaultModel: process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'claude-3-7-sonnet-latest',
+      description: 'Claude 3.7 Sonnet / Claude 3.5 Sonnet for deep architectural & security review',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'gemini',
+      name: 'Google Gemini',
+      configured: Boolean(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY),
+      defaultModel: process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'gemini-2.5-pro',
+      description: 'Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash with 1M+ token repository context window',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'ollama',
+      name: 'Ollama (Local / Private)',
+      configured: Boolean(process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || process.env.OLLAMA_BASE_URL),
+      defaultModel: process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen2.5-coder:7b',
+      description: '100% air-gapped local code review via Ollama (Qwen2.5-Coder, DeepSeek-R1, Llama 3.3)',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'heuristic',
+      name: 'OpenRabbit Static + AST Engine',
+      configured: true,
+      defaultModel: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+      description: 'Zero-key deterministic security, async/concurrency, and AST pattern analyzer (Always ready)',
+    },
+  ];
+}
+
+export function resolveActiveProvider(
+  preferred: LLMProviderType = 'auto',
+  preferredModel?: string
+): { provider: Exclude<LLMProviderType, 'auto'>; model: string } {
+  const envProvider = (process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_PROVIDER as LLMProviderType) || preferred;
+  const target = preferred !== 'auto' ? preferred : envProvider;
+
+  if (target === 'openai' && process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'openai',
+      model: preferredModel || process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'gpt-4o',
+    };
+  }
+  if (target === 'anthropic' && process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'anthropic',
+      model:
+        preferredModel ||
+        process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL ||
+        'claude-3-7-sonnet-latest',
+    };
+  }
+  if (target === 'gemini' && process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'gemini',
+      model: preferredModel || process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'gemini-2.5-pro',
+    };
+  }
+  if (target === 'ollama') {
+    return {
+      provider: 'ollama',
+      model: preferredModel || process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen2.5-coder:7b',
+    };
+  }
+  if (target === 'heuristic') {
+    return {
+      provider: 'heuristic',
+      model: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+    };
+  }
+
+  // Auto-detect based on available credentials
+  if (process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'anthropic',
+      model:
+        preferredModel ||
+        process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL ||
+        'claude-3-7-sonnet-latest',
+    };
+  }
+  if (process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'openai',
+      model: preferredModel || process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'gpt-4o',
+    };
+  }
+  if (process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'gemini',
+      model: preferredModel || process.env.OPENRABBIT_LLM_MODEL || 'gemini-2.5-pro',
+    };
+  }
+  if (process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL) {
+    return {
+      provider: 'ollama',
+      model: preferredModel || process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen2.5-coder:7b',
+    };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    provider: 'heuristic',
+    model: 'openrabbit-ast-v1',
+  };
+}
+
+export async function generateLLMCompletion(
+  req: LLMCompletionRequest
+): Promise<LLMCompletionResponse> {
+  const { provider, model } = resolveActiveProvider(
+    req.preferredProvider,
+    req.preferredModel
+  );
+  const temperature = req.temperature ?? 0.2;
+
+  if (provider === 'openai') {
+    const baseUrl = (
+      process.env.OPENAI_BASE_URL || 'https://api.openai.com/v1'
+    ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/chat/completions`, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: {
+        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+        Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY}`,
+      },
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        model,
+        temperature,
+        ...(req.jsonMode ? { response_format: { type: 'json_object' } } : {}),
+        messages: [
+          { role: 'system', content: req.systemPrompt },
+          { role: 'user', content: req.userPrompt },
+        ],
+      }),
+    });
+
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      const errText = await res.text();
+      throw new Error(`OpenAI API error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
+    }
+    const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+    return {
+      content: data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '',
+      provider: 'openai',
+      model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (provider === 'anthropic') {
+    const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: {
+        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+        'x-api-key': process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || '',
+        'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
+      },
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        model,
+        max_tokens: 4096,
+        temperature,
+        system: req.systemPrompt,
+        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: req.userPrompt }],
+      }),
+    });
+
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      const errText = await res.text();
+      throw new Error(`Anthropic API error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
+    }
+    const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+    const textBlock = data.content?.find((c: any) => c.type === 'text');
+    return {
+      content: textBlock?.text || '',
+      provider: 'anthropic',
+      model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (provider === 'gemini') {
+    const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || '';
+    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(
+      model
+    )}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey)}`;
+
+    const res = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: req.systemPrompt }] },
+        contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: req.userPrompt }] }],
+        generationConfig: {
+          temperature,
+          ...(req.jsonMode ? { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } : {}),
+        },
+      }),
+    });
+
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      const errText = await res.text();
+      throw new Error(`Gemini API error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
+    }
+    const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+    const text =
+      data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map((p: any) => p.text).join('') || '';
+    return {
+      content: text,
+      provider: 'gemini',
+      model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (provider === 'ollama') {
+    const baseUrl = (
+      process.env.OLLAMA_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:11434'
+    ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/chat`, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        model,
+        stream: false,
+        ...(req.jsonMode ? { format: 'json' } : {}),
+        options: { temperature },
+        messages: [
+          { role: 'system', content: req.systemPrompt },
+          { role: 'user', content: req.userPrompt },
+        ],
+      }),
+    });
+
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      const errText = await res.text();
+      throw new Error(`Ollama API error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
+    }
+    const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+    return {
+      content: data.message?.content || '',
+      provider: 'ollama',
+      model,
+    };
+  }
+
+  throw new Error('Heuristic provider handles analysis directly without remote LLM calls.');
+}

+import type {
+  InlineFinding,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+  PRWalkthrough,
+  ReviewSeverity,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+
+export const WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER = '<!-- openrabbit-walkthrough -->';
+
+const SEVERITY_BADGES: Record<ReviewSeverity, { icon: string; label: string }> = {
+  critical: { icon: '🛑', label: 'Critical' },
+  warning: { icon: '⚠️', label: 'Warning' },
+  suggestion: { icon: '💡', label: 'Suggestion' },
+  nitpick: { icon: '🧹', label: 'Nitpick' },
+  praise: { icon: '🙌', label: 'Praise' },
+};
+
+export function renderEffortBar(score: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5): string {
+  const filled = '🟦'.repeat(score);
+  const empty = '⬜'.repeat(5 - score);
+  return `${filled}${empty} (${score}/5)`;
+}
+
+export function formatWalkthroughMarkdown(
+  walkthrough: PRWalkthrough,
+  findings: InlineFinding[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  meta?: { provider: string; model: string; durationMs: number }
+): string {
+  const actionableCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'praise').length;
+  const criticalCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical').length;
+  const warningCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'warning').length;
+
+  const lines: string[] = [WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER];
+  lines.push(`## 🐇 OpenRabbit PR Walkthrough`);
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(walkthrough.executiveSummary);
+  lines.push('');
+
+  // Release Notes / Summary by Category
+  if (walkthrough.releaseNotes && walkthrough.releaseNotes.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(`### 📋 Summary by OpenRabbit`);
+    for (const group of walkthrough.releaseNotes) {
+      lines.push(`- **${group.category}**`);
+      for (const item of group.items) {
+        lines.push(`  - ${item}`);
+      }
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  // Review Status & Effort Header
+  lines.push(
+    `| Metric | Value |`
+  );
+  lines.push(`| :--- | :--- |`);
+  lines.push(`| **Review Effort** | ${renderEffortBar(walkthrough.effortScore)} (~${walkthrough.estimatedMinutes} min) |`);
+  lines.push(
+    `| **Risk Assessment** | **${walkthrough.riskLevel.toUpperCase()}** ${
+      criticalCount > 0
+        ? `(${criticalCount} critical, ${warningCount} warnings)`
+        : warningCount > 0
+        ? `(${warningCount} warnings)`
+        : '(No blocking issues)'
+    } |`
+  );
+  lines.push(
+    `| **Actionable Comments** | **${actionableCount}** inline finding${
+      actionableCount === 1 ? '' : 's'
+    } |`
+  );
+  if (meta) {
+    lines.push(
+      `| **Engine** | \`${meta.provider}/${meta.model}\` (${(
+        meta.durationMs / 1000
+      ).toFixed(2)}s) |`
+    );
+  }
+  lines.push('');
+
+  // Collapsible Walkthrough details
+  const openAttr = config.reviews.collapse_walkthrough ? '' : ' open';
+  lines.push(`<details${openAttr}>`);
+  lines.push(`<summary><strong>🧭 Detailed File Walkthrough (${walkthrough.fileSummaries.length} files)</strong></summary>`);
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(`| File | Component | Changes | Impact | Summary |`);
+  lines.push(`| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |`);
+  for (const f of walkthrough.fileSummaries) {
+    const impactIcon =
+      f.impact === 'high' ? '🔴 High' : f.impact === 'medium' ? '🟡 Med' : '🟢 Low';
+    lines.push(
+      `| \`${f.path}\` | ${f.component} | \`+${f.additions}/-${f.deletions}\` | ${impactIcon} | ${f.summary} |`
+    );
+  }
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(`</details>`);
+  lines.push('');
+
+  // Mermaid Sequence Diagram
+  if (config.reviews.sequence_diagrams && walkthrough.mermaidDiagram) {
+    lines.push(`<details open>`);
+    lines.push(`<summary><strong>🔄 Sequence Diagram</strong></summary>`);
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push('```mermaid');
+    lines.push(walkthrough.mermaidDiagram.trim());
+    lines.push('```');
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push(`</details>`);
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  // Security callout if any
+  if (walkthrough.securityConcerns && walkthrough.securityConcerns.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(`> [!WARNING]`);
+    lines.push(`> **Security Advisories Detected**`);
+    for (const sec of walkthrough.securityConcerns) {
+      lines.push(`> - ${sec}`);
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  // Poem
+  if (config.reviews.poem && walkthrough.poem) {
+    lines.push(`### 🥕 Poem`);
+    for (const poemLine of walkthrough.poem.split('\n')) {
+      lines.push(`> ${poemLine}`);
+    }
+    lines.push('');
+  }
+
+  lines.push(`---`);
+  lines.push(
+    `<sub>💬 **Tip:** Mention \`@openrabbit explain\`, \`@openrabbit test\`, \`@openrabbit fix\`, or ask any question in a review comment! Configured via \`.openrabbit.yaml\`.</sub>`
+  );
+
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats an individual inline finding as a GitHub/GitLab PR review comment
+ * with a one-click committable suggestion block.
+ */
+export function formatInlineCommentMarkdown(
+  finding: InlineFinding,
+  platform: 'github' | 'gitlab' = 'github'
+): string {
+  const sev = SEVERITY_BADGES[finding.severity] || SEVERITY_BADGES.suggestion;
+  const lines: string[] = [];
+
+  lines.push(
+    `${sev.icon} **${sev.label}** · \`[${finding.category}]\` — **${finding.title}**`
+  );
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(finding.body);
+
+  if (finding.suggestionCode && finding.suggestionCode.trim().length > 0) {
+    lines.push('');
+    lines.push('**📝 Committable Suggestion:**');
+    if (platform === 'gitlab') {
+      lines.push('```suggestion:-0+0');
+    } else {
+      lines.push('```suggestion');
+    }
+    lines.push(finding.suggestionCode);
+    lines.push('```');
+  }
+
+  lines.push('');
+  lines.push(
+    `<sub>🤖 *OpenRabbit${
+      finding.ruleMatched ? ` · Rule \`${finding.ruleMatched}\`` : ''
+    } · Reply \`@openrabbit explain\` or \`@openrabbit test\`*</sub>`
+  );
+
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}

+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  getMatchingPathInstructions,
+  shouldReviewFile,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import type {
+  FileDiff,
+  InlineFinding,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+  PRWalkthrough,
+  ReviewResult,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+import { formatAnnotatedFileDiff, parseUnifiedDiff } from './diff-parser.js';
+import {
+  buildHeuristicWalkthrough,
+  runHeuristicInlineReview,
+} from './heuristic-analyzer.js';
+import {
+  generateLLMCompletion,
+  resolveActiveProvider,
+} from './llm-provider.js';
+import { formatWalkthroughMarkdown } from './markdown-formatter.js';
+
+export interface RunReviewOptions {
+  rawDiff: string;
+  prTitle?: string;
+  repository?: string;
+  prNumber?: number;
+  author?: string;
+  baseBranch?: string;
+  headBranch?: string;
+  commitSha?: string;
+  source?: 'cli' | 'github' | 'gitlab' | 'playground';
+  config?: OpenRabbitConfig;
+}
+
+export async function runPullRequestReview(
+  options: RunReviewOptions
+): Promise<ReviewResult> {
+  const startTime = Date.now();
+  const config = options.config || DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG;
+  const prTitle = options.prTitle || 'Pull Request Changes';
+  const repository = options.repository || 'local/repository';
+  const source = options.source || 'cli';
+
+  const parsed = parseUnifiedDiff(options.rawDiff);
+
+  // Filter files according to `.openrabbit.yaml` path_filters
+  const filteredFiles = parsed.files.filter((f) =>
+    shouldReviewFile(f.newPath, config.reviews.path_filters)
+  );
+
+  const activeProviderInfo = resolveActiveProvider(
+    config.llm.provider,
+    config.llm.model
+  );
+
+  // Always run deterministic heuristic rules first for high-precision security & async bug detection
+  let findings: InlineFinding[] = runHeuristicInlineReview(filteredFiles, config);
+  let walkthrough: PRWalkthrough = buildHeuristicWalkthrough(
+    prTitle,
+    filteredFiles,
+    findings,
+    config
+  );
+  let providerUsed: string = activeProviderInfo.provider;
+  let modelUsed: string = activeProviderInfo.model;
+
+  if (activeProviderInfo.provider !== 'heuristic' && filteredFiles.length > 0) {
+    try {
+      const llmOutput = await runLLMTwoStageReview(
+        prTitle,
+        filteredFiles,
+        config,
+        activeProviderInfo.provider,
+        activeProviderInfo.model
+      );
+      if (llmOutput.findings.length > 0) {
+        findings = mergeAndSnapFindings(
+          findings,
+          llmOutput.findings,
+          filteredFiles,
+          config
+        );
+      }
+      walkthrough = {
+        ...walkthrough,
+        ...llmOutput.walkthrough,
+        fileSummaries:
+          llmOutput.walkthrough.fileSummaries &&
+          llmOutput.walkthrough.fileSummaries.length > 0
+            ? llmOutput.walkthrough.fileSummaries
+            : walkthrough.fileSummaries,
+        mermaidDiagram:
+          llmOutput.walkthrough.mermaidDiagram || walkthrough.mermaidDiagram,
+        poem: config.reviews.poem
+          ? llmOutput.walkthrough.poem || walkthrough.poem
+          : '',
+      };
+      providerUsed = llmOutput.provider;
+      modelUsed = llmOutput.model;
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn(
+        `[OpenRabbit] External LLM provider (${activeProviderInfo.provider}) unavailable, falling back to built-in AST/Heuristic engine:`,
+        (err as Error).message
+      );
+      providerUsed = 'heuristic';
+      modelUsed = 'openrabbit-ast-v1 (fallback)';
+    }
+  }
+
+  const durationMs = Math.max(12, Date.now() - startTime);
+
+  const markdownWalkthrough = formatWalkthroughMarkdown(
+    walkthrough,
+    findings,
+    config,
+    {
+      provider: providerUsed,
+      model: modelUsed,
+      durationMs,
+    }
+  );
+
+  const criticalCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical').length;
+  const warningCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'warning').length;
+  const suggestionCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'suggestion').length;
+  const nitpickCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'nitpick').length;
+  const praiseCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'praise').length;
+
+  return {
+    id: `rev-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    source,
+    repository,
+    prNumber: options.prNumber,
+    prTitle,
+    author: options.author || 'developer',
+    baseBranch: options.baseBranch || 'main',
+    headBranch: options.headBranch || 'feat/branch',
+    commitSha: options.commitSha || crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex'),
+    providerUsed,
+    modelUsed,
+    durationMs,
+    stats: {
+      filesReviewed: filteredFiles.length,
+      additions: filteredFiles.reduce((s, f) => s + f.additions, 0),
+      deletions: filteredFiles.reduce((s, f) => s + f.deletions, 0),
+      findingsCount: findings.length,
+      criticalCount,
+      warningCount,
+      suggestionCount,
+      nitpickCount,
+      praiseCount,
+    },
+    walkthrough,
+    findings,
+    markdownWalkthrough,
+    rawDiff: options.rawDiff,
+  };
+}
+
+async function runLLMTwoStageReview(
+  prTitle: string,
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  provider: Exclude<OpenRabbitConfig['llm']['provider'], 'auto'>,
+  model: string
+): Promise<{
+  walkthrough: Partial<PRWalkthrough>;
+  findings: InlineFinding[];
+  provider: string;
+  model: string;
+}> {
+  const annotatedFiles = files.map((file) => {
+    const matchedRules = getMatchingPathInstructions(
+      file.newPath,
+      config.reviews.path_instructions
+    );
+    const rulesText =
+      matchedRules.length > 0
+        ? `\nPath-Specific Instructions for \`${file.newPath}\`:\n` +
+          matchedRules.map((r) => `- (${r.path}): ${r.instructions}`).join('\n')
+        : '';
+    return formatAnnotatedFileDiff(file) + rulesText;
+  });
+
+  const systemPrompt = `You are OpenRabbit, an elite open-source AI code reviewer modeled after the best practices of CodeRabbit.
+Profile mode: ${config.profile.toUpperCase()}
+Tone instructions: ${config.tone_instructions}
+Language: ${config.language}
+
+Respond ONLY with a valid JSON object matching this exact schema:
+{
+  "executiveSummary": "Concise 2-3 sentence overview of the PR changes and key risks",
+  "effortScore": 3,
+  "estimatedMinutes": 5,
+  "riskLevel": "low" | "moderate" | "high" | "critical",
+  "mermaidDiagram": "sequenceDiagram\\n  autonumber\\n  ...",
+  "poem": "4-line rabbit-themed poem about the code changes",
+  "findings": [
+    {
+      "file": "exact file path from diff",
+      "startLine": 12,
+      "endLine": 12,
+      "severity": "critical" | "warning" | "suggestion" | "nitpick" | "praise",
+      "category": "security" | "bug" | "performance" | "maintainability" | "type-safety" | "logic",
+      "title": "Short actionable title",
+      "body": "Clear explanation of the bug or improvement",
+      "suggestionCode": "Exact replacement code for the line(s) without surrounding backticks"
+    }
+  ]
+}`;
+
+  const userPrompt = `Pull Request Title: ${prTitle}\n\nAnnotated Unified Diff:\n\n${annotatedFiles.join(
+    '\n\n---\n\n'
+  )}`;
+
+  const res = await generateLLMCompletion({
+    systemPrompt,
+    userPrompt,
+    temperature: config.llm.temperature,
+    jsonMode: true,
+    preferredProvider: provider,
+    preferredModel: model,
+  });
+
+  const cleaned = res.content
+    .replace(/^```json\s*/i, '')
+    .replace(/```\s*$/i, '')
+    .trim();
+  const parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned);
+
+  const llmFindings: InlineFinding[] = (parsed.findings || []).map((f: any) => ({
+    id: `finding-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
+    file: String(f.file || files[0]?.newPath || ''),
+    startLine: Number(f.startLine) || 1,
+    endLine: Number(f.endLine || f.startLine) || 1,
+    severity: f.severity || 'suggestion',
+    category: f.category || 'bug',
+    title: String(f.title || 'Code Review Finding'),
+    body: String(f.body || ''),
+    suggestionCode: f.suggestionCode ? String(f.suggestionCode) : undefined,
+  }));
+
+  return {
+    walkthrough: {
+      executiveSummary: parsed.executiveSummary,
+      effortScore: parsed.effortScore,
+      estimatedMinutes: parsed.estimatedMinutes,
+      riskLevel: parsed.riskLevel,
+      mermaidDiagram: parsed.mermaidDiagram,
+      poem: parsed.poem,
+    },
+    findings: llmFindings,
+    provider: res.provider,
+    model: res.model,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Ensures all findings reference valid line numbers present in the diff hunks
+ * and deduplicates overlapping findings on the same file & line.
+ */
+function mergeAndSnapFindings(
+  heuristicFindings: InlineFinding[],
+  llmFindings: InlineFinding[],
+  files: FileDiff[],
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig
+): InlineFinding[] {
+  const combined = [...heuristicFindings.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'praise')];
+  const existingKeys = new Set(
+    combined.map((f) => `${f.file}:${f.startLine}`)
+  );
+
+  for (const lf of llmFindings) {
+    if (config.profile === 'chill' && lf.severity === 'nitpick') continue;
+    const fileObj = files.find((f) => f.newPath === lf.file) || files[0];
+    if (!fileObj) continue;
+
+    // Snap line number to nearest valid newLineNumber in file hunks
+    const validLines: number[] = [];
+    for (const h of fileObj.hunks) {
+      for (const l of h.lines) {
+        if (l.newLineNumber !== undefined) validLines.push(l.newLineNumber);
+      }
+    }
+    let snappedLine = lf.startLine;
+    if (validLines.length > 0 && !validLines.includes(snappedLine)) {
+      snappedLine = validLines.reduce((prev, curr) =>
+        Math.abs(curr - lf.startLine) < Math.abs(prev - lf.startLine) ? curr : prev
+      );
+    }
+
+    const key = `${fileObj.newPath}:${snappedLine}`;
+    if (!existingKeys.has(key)) {
+      existingKeys.add(key);
+      combined.push({
+        ...lf,
+        file: fileObj.newPath,
+        startLine: snappedLine,
+        endLine: Math.max(snappedLine, lf.endLine),
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  return combined;
+}

+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  parseYamlConfig,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import {
+  formatInlineCommentMarkdown,
+  WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER,
+} from '../core/markdown-formatter.js';
